🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #8 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Supreme Court bars Tamil Nadu government from coercive action against SASTRA University over land dispute

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 01:25:23 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: A Bench headed by CJI Surya Kant made absolute its interim order staying any coercive measures over 31.37 acres of government land allegedly encroached upon by the Thanjavur university

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Supreme Court on Monday (November 23, 2026) admitted an appeal filed by Shanmugha Arts Science Technology and Research Academy (SASTRA), a deemed university based in Thanjavur, against a Madras High Court direction to the Tamil Nadu government to evict it from 31.37 acres of public land in its occupation for nearly 40 years. The Court had already stayed the eviction of the university in an order passed on January 15, 2026, and had allowed the institution to carry out its activities without any hindrance. At that hearing, the Court asked the State government to consider three options of alternative lands offered by the university, instead of the land occupied and already utilised by it, represented by senior advocate Mukul Rohatgi. A Bench headed by Chief Justice of India Surya Kant had found the three options “just and fair”, and asked the State to consider the offer “sympathetically and take an appropriate decision by ensuring that no loss is caused to the public exchequer”. It also suggested that a high-powered committee of three senior officers of the State government accord a personal hearing to the university to “explain all the attending circumstances and also to persuade the authorities to accept one of the three options”. On August 10, 2026, the Court gave the State, represented by senior advocate Jaideep Gupta and Tamil Nadu Additional Advocate General Haripriya Padmanabhan, a “free hand in determining the actual market value of land” under dispute, with the university obligated to pay. The August order also recorded the university’s offer to pay the sale price of any land the State required for a public purpose, in this case the establishment of a prison, for which it wanted the disputed 31.37-acre property. The Court asked the State to take a “reasonably fair decision and apprise this court”. However, at the next hearing on September 21, 2026, the State sought more time to “consider the different options”. At the September 21 hearing, the Court noted that the land in dispute was used by an educational institution serving a public purpose, and asked why the State was so “obstinate” on eviction and demolition of the institution.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The State government had contended that the alternate parcels were inferior to the disputed land in terms of value, accessibility and contiguity, and that settling for alternative land could amount to putting a premium on encroachment.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Institutional (Adjective)
संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।
✓ Syn: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional  |  ✖ Ant: Individual, Informal, Unorganized
Establishment (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Establishment' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Accessibility (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Accessibility' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Encroachment (Adjective)
अतिक्रमण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Encroachment' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Supreme Court bars Tamil Nadu government from coercive action against SASTRA University over land dispute", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. A Bench headed by CJI Surya Kant made absolute its interim order staying any coercive measures over 31.37 acres of government land allegedly...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Supreme Court bars Tamil Nadu government from co' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Supreme Court bars Tamil Nadu government from' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Supreme Court bars Tamil Nadu government from' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "A Bench headed by CJI Surya Kant made absolute its interim order staying any coercive measures over 31.37 acres of government land allegedly..." (Hinglish Arth: सीजेआई सूर्यकांत की अध्यक्षता वाली पीठ ने तंजावुर विश्वविद्यालय द्वारा कथित रूप से अतिक्रमण की गई 31.37 एकड़ सरकारी भूमि पर किसी भी कठोर कदम पर रोक लगाने के अपने अंतरिम आदेश को निरस्त कर दिया।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Supreme Court bars Tamil Nadu government from coercive action against SASTRA University over land dispute"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. The State government had contended that the alternate parcels were inferior to the disputed land in terms of value, accessibility and contiguity, and...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The State government had contended that the alternate parcels were inferior to the disputed land in terms of value, accessibility and contiguity, and..." (Hinglish Arth: राज्य सरकार ने तर्क दिया था कि वैकल्पिक भूखंड मूल्य, पहुंच और निकटता के मामले में विवादित भूमि से कमतर थे, और वैकल्पिक भूमि के लिए निपटान का मतलब उस पर प्रीमियम लगाना हो सकता है।)

articles.title: Supreme Court asks petitioner to move Allahabad High Court over ‘demolition’ of 100-year-old mosque at Saharanpur
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Declining to directly examine the allegations, the Supreme Court asked the petitioner to approach the jurisdictional High Court, saying that every alleged violation of a Supreme Court judgment cannot be brought directly before the apex court

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Supreme Court on Monday (November 23, 2026) declined to entertain a plea alleging that the demolition of a 100-year-old mosque in Uttar Pradesh's Saharanpur district violated the demolition guidelines laid down by it in a landmark 2024 judgment on the use of bulldozers . A Bench comprising Chief Justice of India Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V. Mohana was hearing a plea filed by Imran Ahmad against Uttar Pradesh Chief Secretary Shashi Prakash Goyal, alleging non-compliance with the apex court's directions. Declining to undertake a direct examination of the allegations, the Bench asked the petitioner to approach the jurisdictional High Court, saying that every alleged violation of a Supreme Court judgment cannot be brought directly before the apex court. "Every order violating a Supreme Court judgment cannot come back to the Supreme Court itself. You have to go to the respective high court," CJI said. The Bench said determining whether the demolition guidelines had been violated would require an examination of the specific facts and circumstances surrounding the alleged demolition, a task more appropriately undertaken by the jurisdictional High Court. "We have laid down the principles, but then wherever these principles have been violated, in what factual context and background? Please go to the concerned high court, establish your case on facts, and if the high court doesn't grant you necessary relief, then come to us," the CJI said. The Bench further clarified that it could not undertake a factual inquiry into the allegations in the contempt proceedings. ALSO WATCH Watch: How the Supreme Court clamped down on ‘bulldozer’ demolitions | Explained However, the Bench made it clear that if the High Court, upon examining the matter, finds that the Supreme Court's directions have been violated, appropriate consequences would follow.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The petitioner was asked to approach the jurisdictional High Court and seek appropriate relief.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Supreme Court asks petitioner to move Allahabad High Court over ‘demolition’ of 100-year-old mosque at Saharanpur

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 01:20:27 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Declining to directly examine the allegations, the Supreme Court asked the petitioner to approach the jurisdictional High Court, saying that every alleged violation of a Supreme Court judgment cannot be brought directly before the apex court

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Supreme Court on Monday (November 23, 2026) declined to entertain a plea alleging that the demolition of a 100-year-old mosque in Uttar Pradesh's Saharanpur district violated the demolition guidelines laid down by it in a landmark 2024 judgment on the use of bulldozers . A Bench comprising Chief Justice of India Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V. Mohana was hearing a plea filed by Imran Ahmad against Uttar Pradesh Chief Secretary Shashi Prakash Goyal, alleging non-compliance with the apex court's directions. Declining to undertake a direct examination of the allegations, the Bench asked the petitioner to approach the jurisdictional High Court, saying that every alleged violation of a Supreme Court judgment cannot be brought directly before the apex court. "Every order violating a Supreme Court judgment cannot come back to the Supreme Court itself. You have to go to the respective high court," CJI said. The Bench said determining whether the demolition guidelines had been violated would require an examination of the specific facts and circumstances surrounding the alleged demolition, a task more appropriately undertaken by the jurisdictional High Court. "We have laid down the principles, but then wherever these principles have been violated, in what factual context and background? Please go to the concerned high court, establish your case on facts, and if the high court doesn't grant you necessary relief, then come to us," the CJI said. The Bench further clarified that it could not undertake a factual inquiry into the allegations in the contempt proceedings. ALSO WATCH Watch: How the Supreme Court clamped down on ‘bulldozer’ demolitions | Explained However, the Bench made it clear that if the High Court, upon examining the matter, finds that the Supreme Court's directions have been violated, appropriate consequences would follow.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The petitioner was asked to approach the jurisdictional High Court and seek appropriate relief.

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: Declining to directly examine the allegations, the Supreme Court asked the petitioner to approach the jurisdictional High Court, saying that every alleged violation of a Supreme Court judgment cannot be brought directly before the apex court
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Supreme Court on Monday (November 23, 2026) declined to entertain a plea alleging that the demolition of a 100-year-old mosque in Uttar Pradesh's Saharanpur district violated the demolition guidelines laid down by it in a landmark 2024 judgment on the use of bulldozers . A Bench comprising Chief Justice of India Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V. Mohana was hearing a plea filed by Imran Ahmad against Uttar Pradesh Chief Secretary Shashi Prakash Goyal, alleging non-compliance with the apex court's directions. Declining to undertake a direct examination of the allegations, the Bench asked the petitioner to approach the jurisdictional High Court, saying that every alleged violation of a Supreme Court judgment cannot be brought directly before the apex court. "Every order violating a Supreme Court judgment cannot come back to the Supreme Court itself. You have to go to the respective high court," CJI said. The Bench said determining whether the demolition guidelines had been violated would require an examination of the specific facts and circumstances surrounding the alleged demolition, a task more appropriately undertaken by the jurisdictional High Court. "We have laid down the principles, but then wherever these principles have been violated, in what factual context and background? Please go to the concerned high court, establish your case on facts, and if the high court doesn't grant you necessary relief, then come to us," the CJI said. The Bench further clarified that it could not undertake a factual inquiry into the allegations in the contempt proceedings. ALSO WATCH Watch: How the Supreme Court clamped down on ‘bulldozer’ demolitions | Explained However, the Bench made it clear that if the High Court, upon examining the matter, finds that the Supreme Court's directions have been violated, appropriate consequences would follow.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The petitioner was asked to approach the jurisdictional High Court and seek appropriate relief.

articles.title: Earthmover at Amarnath Yatra stopover Sheshnag lake draws outrage from parties and locals

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Demands are growing to stop such heavy machines in the ecologically fragile region

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A viral video of an earthmover operating at Sheshnag — the high-altitude and inaccessible glacial lake located 11,780 feet above sea level in south Kashmir’s Pahalgam — evoked outrage from political parties and locals on Monday (November 23). Demands are growing to stop such heavy machines in the ecologically fragile region. The undated video shows an earthmover filling a site at the lake's edge, which spans 1.1 kilometres in length and 0.7 kilometres in width. Sheshnag is a stopover for pilgrims heading to the annual Amarnath Yatra in south Kashmir’s Anantnag. A macadamised road for the pilgrims ends at Chandanwari. In the past, pilgrims trekked 12 to 13 kilometres on an unpaved mountain track to reach the lake. The Amarnath cave is 18-20 km from the stopover. Opposition People’s Democratic Party (PDP) spokesman Mohit Bhan said Sheshnag was not just another lake in the mountains of Kashmir. “In Hinduism, it is the sacred landscape where Lord Shiva is believed to have left behind the serpents before proceeding towards the Amarnath Cave to narrate the Amar Katha to Goddess Parvati. There is a profound contradiction in invoking Hindu faith while allowing the very landscape associated with that faith to be disturbed through unnecessary construction, road cutting and surface levelling,” said Mr. Bhan. The visuals and reports of heavy machinery operating near the pristine Sheshnag Lake, in the glacial zone of Pahalgam are very disturbing, raising serious concern among people about the ecological impact of construction in this fragile Himalayan region. With our glaciers already retreating, and recent devastating glacier-related floods in neighbouring Nepal reminding us of the growing vulnerability of the Himalayas, such activities raise alarm. Kashmir has always warmly welcomed Amarnath Yatra pilgrims, and improving facilities for them has never been an issue. But not at the cost of our fragile ecosystem. Those governing owe answers to people for the serious environmental concerns created by such "developmental projects"! Our precious mountains, glaciers and water bodies need protection not plunder, for now and for the future generations. So this must be immediately stopped. He said what is being projected as development must not come at the cost of a fragile alpine ecosystem and a landscape deeply embedded in Hindu religious belief. “Faith and ecology are not competing interests. Both demand protection. You cannot celebrate the sanctity of a pilgrimage while disregarding the sanctity of the landscape through which it passes. If we cannot respect Sacred Sheshnag, what exactly are we preserving in the name of the Amarnath Yatra?” he said. Kashmir’s chief cleric Mirwaiz Umar Farooq said the visuals and reports of heavy machinery operating near the pristine lake, in the glacial zone of Pahalgam, were “very disturbing”, “raising serious concern among people about the ecological impact of construction in this fragile Himalayan region”. “With our glaciers already retreating, and recent devastating glacier-related floods in neighbouring Nepal reminding us of the growing vulnerability of the Himalayas, such activities raise alarm. Kashmir has always warmly welcomed Amarnath Yatra pilgrims, and improving facilities for them has never been an issue. But not at the cost of our fragile ecosystem. Those governing owe answers to people for the serious environmental concerns created by such ‘developmental projects’! Our precious mountains, glaciers and water bodies need protection, not plunder, for now and for future generations. So, this must be immediately stopped,” said the Mirwaiz. Many commented on the video, which went viral on social media platforms in the past 24 hours. “Sheshnag Lake is one of the 14 officially identified high-risk glacial lakes in J&K for GLOF (glacial lake outburst flood). Heavy machinery is being run on its shoreline with zero transparency on environmental clearance or risk assessment. This is not development. This is deliberate endangerment of a fragile alpine ecosystem and downstream communities,” said Suhail Ahmed Khan, from Kashmir.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Raja Muzaffar Bhat, a prominent environmentalist and activist, termed the earthmover at the high-altitude lake a “disaster”. “How does such a heavy machine reach our glaciers of Kashmir?” he asked.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Earthmover at Amarnath Yatra stopover Sheshnag lake draws outrage from parties and locals

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 01:17:32 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Demands are growing to stop such heavy machines in the ecologically fragile region

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A viral video of an earthmover operating at Sheshnag — the high-altitude and inaccessible glacial lake located 11,780 feet above sea level in south Kashmir’s Pahalgam — evoked outrage from political parties and locals on Monday (November 23). Demands are growing to stop such heavy machines in the ecologically fragile region. The undated video shows an earthmover filling a site at the lake's edge, which spans 1.1 kilometres in length and 0.7 kilometres in width. Sheshnag is a stopover for pilgrims heading to the annual Amarnath Yatra in south Kashmir’s Anantnag. A macadamised road for the pilgrims ends at Chandanwari. In the past, pilgrims trekked 12 to 13 kilometres on an unpaved mountain track to reach the lake. The Amarnath cave is 18-20 km from the stopover. Opposition People’s Democratic Party (PDP) spokesman Mohit Bhan said Sheshnag was not just another lake in the mountains of Kashmir. “In Hinduism, it is the sacred landscape where Lord Shiva is believed to have left behind the serpents before proceeding towards the Amarnath Cave to narrate the Amar Katha to Goddess Parvati. There is a profound contradiction in invoking Hindu faith while allowing the very landscape associated with that faith to be disturbed through unnecessary construction, road cutting and surface levelling,” said Mr. Bhan. The visuals and reports of heavy machinery operating near the pristine Sheshnag Lake, in the glacial zone of Pahalgam are very disturbing, raising serious concern among people about the ecological impact of construction in this fragile Himalayan region. With our glaciers already retreating, and recent devastating glacier-related floods in neighbouring Nepal reminding us of the growing vulnerability of the Himalayas, such activities raise alarm. articles.title: TMC MLA Sabina Yeasmin appears before NIA in connection with ‘attacks’ on judicial officers
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The NIA has been probing the alleged attacks on judicial officers and a judge's vehicle during violence in the Kaliachak and Mothabari areas on April 1

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: TMC MLA Sabina Yeasmin and her husband appeared before the National Investigation Agency (NIA) on Monday (November 23, 2026) in connection with its investigation into alleged attacks on judicial magistrates during the SIR exercise in West Bengal's Malda district. The NIA has been probing the alleged attacks on judicial officers and a judge's vehicle during violence in the Kaliachak and Mothabari areas on April 1. Demonstrators had blocked National Highway 12 at Kaliachak to protest against the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. Ms. Yeasmin, along with her husband Mehebub Alam, appeared before NIA officials at the agency's New Town office and claimed that they had no knowledge of the alleged attacks and violence on April 1 and that they were not present at the site. "This is a politically motivated move," she told reporters before entering the NIA office. Ms. Yeasmin claimed that her husband was at the collector's office regarding her nomination papers, which were to be filed the next day (on April 2) for the assembly elections, when the violence occurred. She won the Sujapur seat in the assembly polls this year. The MLA said she was at the BDO office, staging a demonstration along with some party supporters. "Neither my husband nor I had any role in the road blockade," she said. Ms. Yeasmin had joined the Ritabrata Banerjee-led faction of Trinamool Congress, following the West Bengal assembly elections, which the BJP won.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Later, she resigned from her post as president of the Democratic Trinamool Congress women’s wing in October and expressed her personal allegiance to former West Bengal chief minister Mamata Banerjee.

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — बाद में, उन्होंने अक्टूबर में डेमोक्रेटिक तृणमूल कांग्रेस महिला विंग के अध्यक्ष पद से इस्तीफा दे दिया और पश्चिम बंगाल की पूर्व मुख्यमंत्री ममता बनर्जी के प्रति अपनी व्यक्तिगत निष्ठा व्यक्त की।।

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 TMC MLA Sabina Yeasmin appears before NIA in connection with ‘attacks’ on judicial officers

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 01:16:00 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The NIA has been probing the alleged attacks on judicial officers and a judge's vehicle during violence in the Kaliachak and Mothabari areas on April 1

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: TMC MLA Sabina Yeasmin and her husband appeared before the National Investigation Agency (NIA) on Monday (November 23, 2026) in connection with its investigation into alleged attacks on judicial magistrates during the SIR exercise in West Bengal's Malda district. The NIA has been probing the alleged attacks on judicial officers and a judge's vehicle during violence in the Kaliachak and Mothabari areas on April 1. Demonstrators had blocked National Highway 12 at Kaliachak to protest against the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. Ms. Yeasmin, along with her husband Mehebub Alam, appeared before NIA officials at the agency's New Town office and claimed that they had no knowledge of the alleged attacks and violence on April 1 and that they were not present at the site. "This is a politically motivated move," she told reporters before entering the NIA office. Ms. Yeasmin claimed that her husband was at the collector's office regarding her nomination papers, which were to be filed the next day (on April 2) for the assembly elections, when the violence occurred. She won the Sujapur seat in the assembly polls this year. The MLA said she was at the BDO office, staging a demonstration along with some party supporters. "Neither my husband nor I had any role in the road blockade," she said. Ms. Yeasmin had joined the Ritabrata Banerjee-led faction of Trinamool Congress, following the West Bengal assembly elections, which the BJP won.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Later, she resigned from her post as president of the Democratic Trinamool Congress women’s wing in October and expressed her personal allegiance to former West Bengal chief minister Mamata Banerjee.

articles.title: Rahul Gandhi’s Gaza remarks expose old fault lines between Congress and Left

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The backlash from Left parties to the Congress leader’s comments on Israel and Gaza underscores enduring ideological differences within the Opposition alliance

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The recent remarks of Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi hyphenating the October 7 Hamas attack on Israel with the deaths of tens of thousands of Palestinians in Gaza have triggered a sharp backlash from Left parties, exposing ideological fault lines within the Indian National Developmental, Inclusive Alliance. The controversy has highlighted the distance that continues to separate the Congress and the Left on questions of international politics, despite their present-day electoral cooperation. The disagreement echoes earlier tensions that culminated in the Left withdrawing support to the United Progressive Alliance government over the India-U.S. nuclear deal in 2008. The CPI(M) had walked out of the alliance, denouncing what it described as the Indian government’s subservient position to the U.S. While the current dispute is unlikely to threaten the alliance in the immediate future, it is a reminder that Opposition unity often coexists with significant ideological divergence. Within the Congress , some leaders privately view the episode as a correction to what they saw as the party leadership’s growing proximity to sections of the Left. A senior Congress leader argued that the controversy is unlikely to have significant political consequences for the party, noting that Palestine is no longer a mass political issue in India beyond activist circles and sections of campuses. The leadership expects the storm to subside as public attention shifts elsewhere. The controversy stems from remarks made by Mr. Gandhi during an interaction at the University of Chicago last week. Responding to a question on foreign policy, he said: “India’s foreign policy must be guided by what is good for India… I support a strong relationship with Israel. We have strategic interests, including buying the best weapons for our armed forces.”
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: India / Palestine / Israel-Palestine Conflict / Israel / Rahul Gandhi / politics / government / Analysis

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Rahul Gandhi’s Gaza remarks expose old fault lines between Congress and Left

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 01:15:47 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The backlash from Left parties to the Congress leader’s comments on Israel and Gaza underscores enduring ideological differences within the Opposition alliance

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The recent remarks of Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi hyphenating the October 7 Hamas attack on Israel with the deaths of tens of thousands of Palestinians in Gaza have triggered a sharp backlash from Left parties, exposing ideological fault lines within the Indian National Developmental, Inclusive Alliance. The controversy has highlighted the distance that continues to separate the Congress and the Left on questions of international politics, despite their present-day electoral cooperation. The disagreement echoes earlier tensions that culminated in the Left withdrawing support to the United Progressive Alliance government over the India-U.S. nuclear deal in 2008. The CPI(M) had walked out of the alliance, denouncing what it described as the Indian government’s subservient position to the U.S. While the current dispute is unlikely to threaten the alliance in the immediate future, it is a reminder that Opposition unity often coexists with significant ideological divergence. Within the Congress , some leaders privately view the episode as a correction to what they saw as the party leadership’s growing proximity to sections of the Left. A senior Congress leader argued that the controversy is unlikely to have significant political consequences for the party, noting that Palestine is no longer a mass political issue in India beyond activist circles and sections of campuses. The leadership expects the storm to subside as public attention shifts elsewhere. The controversy stems from remarks made by Mr. Gandhi during an interaction at the University of Chicago last week. Responding to a question on foreign policy, he said: “India’s foreign policy must be guided by what is good for India… I support a strong relationship with Israel. We have strategic interests, including buying the best weapons for our armed forces.”

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: India / Palestine / Israel-Palestine Conflict / Israel / Rahul Gandhi / politics / government / Analysis

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Rampur Bushahr’s Lavi Fair in Himachal Pradesh traces a Himalayan journey from wool and barter to women entrepreneurs and digital payments

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: What Disneyland is to children today, Lavi Fair in Rampur Bushahr, in Himachal Pradesh’s Shimla district, was to my family in the 1980s. I recall wandering through the fair as an eight-year-old, watching an old man smoking a chillum beside heaps of black sheep fleece and stacks of white woollen pattus (traditional garments of Kinnaur and Kullu women). Mother and her friends carefully chose shawls for their daughters’ and future daughters-in-law’s trousseaux. Years later, I received a beautiful black sheep wool and pashmina shawl for my wedding. Wool finds pride of place at the fair. The name Lavi is linked to “Loe”, a sheet of woollen cloth and the practice of shearing sheep.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The Hindu Sunday Magazine / trade policy / trade dispute / trade agreements / international (foreign) trade / Himachal Pradesh / economy / business (general) / taxes and duties / travelogues / travel and commuting

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The All India Gem & Jewellery Domestic Council (GJC) argued that the gold jewellery sector contributes nearly 7-8% to the economy and supports millions of livelihoods

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: While welcoming Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s call for prioritising locally-made products and reducing gold imports, the All India Gem & Jewellery Domestic Council (GJC) has said that India must balance “economic patriotism” and its cultural traditions when it comes to gold jewellery. It argued that the sector contributes “nearly 7-8%” to the economy and supports “millions of livelihoods”. The GJC was reacting to Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s recent and repeated appeal to all Indians to stop foreign trips and weddings, to buy local, and to only buy gold if necessary. “The Prime Minister’s appeal for economic patriotism and greater preference for Swadeshi products is timely and welcome,” Rajesh Rokde, Chairman of the All India Gem & Jewellery Domestic Council (GJC) said. “While we fully support the Prime Minister’s call for restraint when gold is viewed purely as bullion or an investment instrument, jewellery consumption remains closely linked to culture, craftsmanship, and livelihoods,” Mr. Rokde added. He said that gold and jewellery hold a unique place in India’s cultural heritage, particularly during festive and wedding seasons, such as the period that India will soon enter in October-December. “The jewellery industry, contributing nearly 7-8% to the economy and supporting millions of livelihoods, is an integral part of India’s growth story,” Mr. Rokde asserted. ‘People bought less gold, prices fell’: Modi recalls year-old appeal

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “As a ₹10 lakh crore industry, the Indian jewellery sector must continue to grow responsibly, with greater transparency, value creation, and alignment with national priorities — balancing economic patriotism with India’s enduring cultural traditions,” he added.

📈 Economic, Banking & Finance Paragraph #14 of 30 (22 NOV)

📰 Must balance ‘economic patriotism’ with cultural heritage: GJC on PM Modi’s call to stop gold purchases

📌 Published: 22 Nov 2026, 04:53:51 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The All India Gem & Jewellery Domestic Council (GJC) argued that the gold jewellery sector contributes nearly 7-8% to the economy and supports millions of livelihoods

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: While welcoming Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s call for prioritising locally-made products and reducing gold imports, the All India Gem & Jewellery Domestic Council (GJC) has said that India must balance “economic patriotism” and its cultural traditions when it comes to gold jewellery. It argued that the sector contributes “nearly 7-8%” to the economy and supports “millions of livelihoods”. The GJC was reacting to Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s recent and repeated appeal to all Indians to stop foreign trips and weddings, to buy local, and to only buy gold if necessary. “The Prime Minister’s appeal for economic patriotism and greater preference for Swadeshi products is timely and welcome,” Rajesh Rokde, Chairman of the All India Gem & Jewellery Domestic Council (GJC) said. “While we fully support the Prime Minister’s call for restraint when gold is viewed purely as bullion or an investment instrument, jewellery consumption remains closely linked to culture, craftsmanship, and livelihoods,” Mr. Rokde added. He said that gold and jewellery hold a unique place in India’s cultural heritage, particularly during festive and wedding seasons, such as the period that India will soon enter in October-December. “The jewellery industry, contributing nearly 7-8% to the economy and supporting millions of livelihoods, is an integral part of India’s growth story,” Mr. Rokde asserted. ‘People bought less gold, prices fell’: Modi recalls year-old appeal

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “As a ₹10 lakh crore industry, the Indian jewellery sector must continue to grow responsibly, with greater transparency, value creation, and alignment with national priorities — balancing economic patriotism with India’s enduring cultural traditions,” he added.

निवेश — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Investment' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

articles.title: India, Finland seek to deepen economic ties through startup cooperation: Envoy Mikko Kivikoski
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-III & IBPS/SBI/RBI/SSC: RBI Monetary Policy, GDP Growth, Inflation, Fiscal Deficit & Trade Balance
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: "We want to engage more with the Indian startup actors. And here we see the startup sector, startup ecosystems, as an important part of that cooperation," Mikki Kivikoski said

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: “India and Finland are looking to deepen economic cooperation by strengthening ties between their startup ecosystems and promoting greater two-way investment,” Finnish Ambassador to India Mikko Kivikoski has said. "We want to engage more with the Indian startup actors. And of course, at the end of the day, this is all about advancing the economic cooperation between our countries. And here we see the startup sector, startup ecosystems, as an important part of that cooperation," Mr. Kivikoski told PTI . The Ambassador was speaking at an unconventional startup event held at the Embassy of Finland in New Delhi on Friday (November 20, 2026), where entrepreneurs stepped into an ice-cold pool to pitch their ideas, drawing on Finland's winter-swimming tradition. "We have quite a long tradition in Finland for these kinds of events," Mr. Kivikoski said. "This year has been record-high when it comes to interaction and engagement between Finland and India," he said, referring to visits by the Finnish Prime Minister and President, as well as meetings between the leaders of the two countries. The Ambassador said the two sides agreed to elevate their bilateral relationship to a Strategic Partnership in Digitalisation and Sustainability during Finnish President Alexander Stubb's state visit to India in March. Prime Minister Narendra Modi met his Finnish counterpart, Petteri Orpo, in New Delhi on the sidelines of the AI Impact Summit in February and in Oslo on the margins of the 3rd India-Nordic Summit in May. Mr. Kivikoski also referred to the visits to Finland by India's External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar and Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal during the summer. "We see India as a trusted partner when it comes to the Indo-Pacific area," he said. The Ambassador said the India-Finland relationship was increasingly moving beyond conventional trade towards a partnership involving investments and people-to-people exchanges. "What we are seeing already, and what is happening between the European Union and India and between India and Finland, is that we are now talking about partnership. It's not anymore about me selling something to you and you selling something to me," he said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: "There are more and more Finnish companies coming to the Indian market and more and more Indian companies going to the Finnish market. And of course we hope, and we are confident, that this dynamism will continue in the future," he said.

📈 Economic, Banking & Finance Paragraph #15 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 India, Finland seek to deepen economic ties through startup cooperation: Envoy Mikko Kivikoski

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 06:39:21 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: "We want to engage more with the Indian startup actors. And here we see the startup sector, startup ecosystems, as an important part of that cooperation," Mikki Kivikoski said

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: “India and Finland are looking to deepen economic cooperation by strengthening ties between their startup ecosystems and promoting greater two-way investment,” Finnish Ambassador to India Mikko Kivikoski has said. "We want to engage more with the Indian startup actors. And of course, at the end of the day, this is all about advancing the economic cooperation between our countries. And here we see the startup sector, startup ecosystems, as an important part of that cooperation," Mr. Kivikoski told PTI . The Ambassador was speaking at an unconventional startup event held at the Embassy of Finland in New Delhi on Friday (November 20, 2026), where entrepreneurs stepped into an ice-cold pool to pitch their ideas, drawing on Finland's winter-swimming tradition. "We have quite a long tradition in Finland for these kinds of events," Mr. Kivikoski said. "This year has been record-high when it comes to interaction and engagement between Finland and India," he said, referring to visits by the Finnish Prime Minister and President, as well as meetings between the leaders of the two countries. The Ambassador said the two sides agreed to elevate their bilateral relationship to a Strategic Partnership in Digitalisation and Sustainability during Finnish President Alexander Stubb's state visit to India in March. Prime Minister Narendra Modi met his Finnish counterpart, Petteri Orpo, in New Delhi on the sidelines of the AI Impact Summit in February and in Oslo on the margins of the 3rd India-Nordic Summit in May. Mr. Kivikoski also referred to the visits to Finland by India's External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar and Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal during the summer. "We see India as a trusted partner when it comes to the Indo-Pacific area," he said. The Ambassador said the India-Finland relationship was increasingly moving beyond conventional trade towards a partnership involving investments and people-to-people exchanges. "What we are seeing already, and what is happening between the European Union and India and between India and Finland, is that we are now talking about partnership. It's not anymore about me selling something to you and you selling something to me," he said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: "There are more and more Finnish companies coming to the Indian market and more and more Indian companies going to the Finnish market. And of course we hope, and we are confident, that this dynamism will continue in the future," he said.

• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: “India and Finland are looking to deepen economic cooperation by strengthening ties between their startup ecosystems and promoting greater two-way investment,” Finnish Ambassador to India Mikko Kivikoski has said. "We want to engage more with the Indian startup actors. And of course, at the end of the day, this is all about advancing the economic cooperation between our countries. And here we see the startup sector, startup ecosystems, as an important part of that cooperation," Mr. Kivikoski told PTI . The Ambassador was speaking at an unconventional startup event held at the Embassy of Finland in New Delhi on Friday (November 20, 2026), where entrepreneurs stepped into an ice-cold pool to pitch their ideas, drawing on Finland's winter-swimming tradition. "We have quite a long tradition in Finland for these kinds of events," Mr. Kivikoski said. "This year has been record-high when it comes to interaction and engagement between Finland and India," he said, referring to visits by the Finnish Prime Minister and President, as well as meetings between the leaders of the two countries. The Ambassador said the two sides agreed to elevate their bilateral relationship to a Strategic Partnership in Digitalisation and Sustainability during Finnish President Alexander Stubb's state visit to India in March. Prime Minister Narendra Modi met his Finnish counterpart, Petteri Orpo, in New Delhi on the sidelines of the AI Impact Summit in February and in Oslo on the margins of the 3rd India-Nordic Summit in May. Mr. Kivikoski also referred to the visits to Finland by India's External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar and Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal during the summer. "We see India as a trusted partner when it comes to the Indo-Pacific area," he said. The Ambassador said the India-Finland relationship was increasingly moving beyond conventional trade towards a partnership involving investments and people-to-people exchanges. "What we are seeing already, and what is happening between the European Union and India and between India and Finland, is that we are now talking about partnership. It's not anymore about me selling something to you and you selling something to me," he said.

articles.title: Infra push and low base effect pushes core sector growth to series-high of 10.9% in October 2026
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-III & IBPS/SBI/RBI/SSC: RBI Monetary Policy, GDP Growth, Inflation, Fiscal Deficit & Trade Balance
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: While the coal and electricity sectors saw growth shoot up, a large part of this was due to a statistical effect rather than growth in actual output. On the other hand, fuel-related sectors contracted again

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Growth in the core industrial sectors of the economy climbed to a series-high of 10.9% in October 2026, driven by a surge in electricity generation, and coal, cement, and iron ore production, and a low base effect, official data released on Friday (November 20, 2026) showed. Data released by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry on the Index of Core Industries shows that growth in October surpassed the 8.2% in September, the previous series high. The new index, released this year with a base year of 2022-23, has data that goes back only up to April 2024. However, the data also shows that the strong growth figure in October was also likely aided by the fact that the index grew a relatively poor 0.8% in October last year. “While core output surged by 10.9% in October 2026, the fastest pace in the new series, this was supported by a low base related to the shift in the festive calendar, with output having expanded by a marginal 0.8% in the year ago month,” Aditi Nayar, chief economist at ICRA said. “While the growth print for October 2026 signals a strong start for the third quarter of FY2027, this is largely optical,” Ms. Nayar added. “The average performance for October-November 2026 would provide a better assessment, as this would adjust for festive base effects.” Within the index, the coal sector saw growth accelerating to 23.05% in October 2026, far faster than the 10.7% registered in September. October’s performance, however, is likely also due to low base effect, since the sector contracted 8.4% in October last year. The growth in the index, however, is in line with what the industry itself has reported. Coal India, the country’s largest coal company, reported that production increased about 19% to 67.2 million tonnes (MT) in October. A major reason for the growth in coal production was likely demand from the power sector, which saw electricity generation jump by 21.6% in October 2026, up from 12.6% in the previous month. However, this sector too could have benefited from a low base effect, since it contracted nearly 7% in October 2025. Within the index, the infrastructure-related sectors were the only ones that grew strongly without the aid of a statistical low base effect.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The iron ore sector, for example, grew at a three-month high of 23.4% in October 2026, compared to 18.4% in September and 8.7% in October last year. One of the factors driving this strong growth was that steel production grew at 7.3% in October, the fastest rate in seven months.

hinglishTracks.en: While the coal and electricity sectors saw growth shoot up, a large part of this was due to a statistical effect rather than growth in actual output.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — जबकि कोयला और बिजली क्षेत्रों में वृद्धि देखी गई, इसका एक बड़ा हिस्सा वास्तविक उत्पादन में वृद्धि के बजाय सांख्यिकीय प्रभाव के कारण था।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Electricity' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Electricity' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: On the other hand, fuel-related sectors contracted again
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — दूसरी ओर, ईंधन से संबंधित क्षेत्रों में फिर से संकुचन हुआ।

hinglishTracks.en: Growth in the core industrial sectors of the economy climbed to a series-high of 10.9% in October 2026, driven by a surge in electricity generation, and coal, cement, and iron ore production, and a low base effect, official data released on Friday (November 20, 2026) showed.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — शुक्रवार (नवंबर 20, 2026) को जारी आधिकारिक आंकड़ों से पता चलता है कि बिजली उत्पादन, कोयला, सीमेंट और लौह अयस्क उत्पादन में वृद्धि और कम आधार प्रभाव के कारण अक्टूबर 2026 में अर्थव्यवस्था के मुख्य औद्योगिक क्षेत्रों में वृद्धि 10.9% के उच्च स्तर पर पहुंच गई।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Electricity' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Electricity' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Data released by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry on the Index of Core Industries shows that growth in October surpassed the 8.2% in September, the previous series high.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — वाणिज्य और उद्योग मंत्रालय द्वारा कोर इंडस्ट्रीज के सूचकांक पर जारी आंकड़ों से पता चलता है कि अक्टूबर में विकास सितंबर में 8.2% से अधिक हो गया, जो पिछली श्रृंखला का उच्चतम स्तर था।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Industrial' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Industrial' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: The new index, released this year with a base year of 2022-23, has data that goes back only up to April 2024.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — इस वर्ष 2022-23 के आधार वर्ष के साथ जारी किए गए नए सूचकांक में केवल अप्रैल 2024 तक का डेटा है।।

hinglishTracks.en: However, the data also shows that the strong growth figure in October was also likely aided by the fact that the index grew a relatively poor 0.8% in October last year.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — हालाँकि, आंकड़ों से यह भी पता चलता है कि अक्टूबर में मजबूत वृद्धि के आंकड़े को इस तथ्य से भी मदद मिली कि पिछले साल अक्टूबर में सूचकांक अपेक्षाकृत खराब 0.8% बढ़ा था।।

hinglishTracks.en: “While core output surged by 10.9% in October 2026, the fastest pace in the new series, this was supported by a low base related to the shift in the festive calendar, with output having expanded by a marginal 0.8% in the year ago month,” Aditi Nayar, chief economist at ICRA said.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — आईसीआरए की मुख्य अर्थशास्त्री अदिति नायर ने कहा, "अक्टूबर 2026 में कोर आउटपुट में 10.9% की वृद्धि हुई, जो नई श्रृंखला में सबसे तेज गति है, इसे त्योहारी कैलेंडर में बदलाव से संबंधित कम आधार द्वारा समर्थित किया गया था, जिसमें आउटपुट में एक साल पहले महीने में 0.8% की मामूली वृद्धि हुई थी।"।

hinglishTracks.en: “While the growth print for October 2026 signals a strong start for the third quarter of FY2027, this is largely optical,” Ms.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — “हालांकि अक्टूबर 2026 का विकास प्रिंट वित्त वर्ष 2027 की तीसरी तिमाही के लिए एक मजबूत शुरुआत का संकेत देता है, यह काफी हद तक ऑप्टिकल है,” सुश्री।।

hinglishTracks.en: “The average performance for October-November 2026 would provide a better assessment, as this would adjust for festive base effects.”
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — “अक्टूबर-नवंबर 2026 का औसत प्रदर्शन बेहतर मूल्यांकन प्रदान करेगा, क्योंकि यह त्योहारी आधार प्रभावों के लिए समायोजित होगा।”। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Performance' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Performance' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Within the index, the coal sector saw growth accelerating to 23.05% in October 2026, far faster than the 10.7% registered in September.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — सूचकांक के भीतर, कोयला क्षेत्र में अक्टूबर 2026 में 23.05% की वृद्धि देखी गई, जो सितंबर में दर्ज 10.7% से कहीं अधिक तेज है।।

hinglishTracks.en: October’s performance, however, is likely also due to low base effect, since the sector contracted 8.4% in October last year.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — हालाँकि, अक्टूबर का प्रदर्शन कम आधार प्रभाव के कारण भी होने की संभावना है, क्योंकि पिछले साल अक्टूबर में इस क्षेत्र में 8.4% की गिरावट आई थी।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Performance' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Performance' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: The growth in the index, however, is in line with what the industry itself has reported.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — हालाँकि, सूचकांक में वृद्धि उद्योग द्वारा स्वयं रिपोर्ट की गई जानकारी के अनुरूप है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Industrial' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Industrial' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: Coal India, the country’s largest coal company, reported that production increased about 19% to 67.2 million tonnes (MT) in October.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — देश की सबसे बड़ी कोयला कंपनी कोल इंडिया ने बताया कि अक्टूबर में उत्पादन लगभग 19% बढ़कर 67.2 मिलियन टन (MT) हो गया।।

hinglishTracks.en: A major reason for the growth in coal production was likely demand from the power sector, which saw electricity generation jump by 21.6% in October 2026, up from 12.6% in the previous month.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — कोयला उत्पादन में वृद्धि का एक प्रमुख कारण बिजली क्षेत्र की संभावित मांग थी, जिसमें अक्टूबर 2026 में बिजली उत्पादन में 21.6% की वृद्धि देखी गई, जो पिछले महीने में 12.6% थी।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Electricity' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Electricity' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: However, this sector too could have benefited from a low base effect, since it contracted nearly 7% in October 2025.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — हालाँकि, इस क्षेत्र को भी कम आधार प्रभाव से लाभ हो सकता था, क्योंकि अक्टूबर 2025 में इसमें लगभग 7% की गिरावट आई थी।।

hinglishTracks.en: Within the index, the infrastructure-related sectors were the only ones that grew strongly without the aid of a statistical low base effect.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — सूचकांक के भीतर, बुनियादी ढांचे से संबंधित क्षेत्र ही एकमात्र ऐसे क्षेत्र थे जो सांख्यिकीय कम आधार प्रभाव की सहायता के बिना मजबूती से बढ़े।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Statistical' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Statistical' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: The iron ore sector, for example, grew at a three-month high of 23.4% in October 2026, compared to 18.4% in September and 8.7% in October last year.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — उदाहरण के लिए, लौह अयस्क क्षेत्र की वृद्धि अक्टूबर 2026 में तीन महीने के उच्चतम 23.4% पर हुई, जबकि सितंबर में 18.4% और पिछले साल अक्टूबर में 8.7% थी।।

hinglishTracks.en: One of the factors driving this strong growth was that steel production grew at 7.3% in October, the fastest rate in seven months.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — इस मजबूत वृद्धि को चलाने वाले कारकों में से एक यह था कि अक्टूबर में इस्पात उत्पादन 7.3% की दर से बढ़ा, जो सात महीनों में सबसे तेज़ दर थी।।

📈 Economic, Banking & Finance Paragraph #17 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Infra push and low base effect pushes core sector growth to series-high of 10.9% in October 2026

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 01:18:11 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: While the coal and electricity sectors saw growth shoot up, a large part of this was due to a statistical effect rather than growth in actual output. On the other hand, fuel-related sectors contracted again

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Growth in the core industrial sectors of the economy climbed to a series-high of 10.9% in October 2026, driven by a surge in electricity generation, and coal, cement, and iron ore production, and a low base effect, official data released on Friday (November 20, 2026) showed. Data released by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry on the Index of Core Industries shows that growth in October surpassed the 8.2% in September, the previous series high. The new index, released this year with a base year of 2022-23, has data that goes back only up to April 2024. However, the data also shows that the strong growth figure in October was also likely aided by the fact that the index grew a relatively poor 0.8% in October last year. “While core output surged by 10.9% in October 2026, the fastest pace in the new series, this was supported by a low base related to the shift in the festive calendar, with output having expanded by a marginal 0.8% in the year ago month,” Aditi Nayar, chief economist at ICRA said. “While the growth print for October 2026 signals a strong start for the third quarter of FY2027, this is largely optical,” Ms. Nayar added. “The average performance for October-November 2026 would provide a better assessment, as this would adjust for festive base effects.” Within the index, the coal sector saw growth accelerating to 23.05% in October 2026, far faster than the 10.7% registered in September. October’s performance, however, is likely also due to low base effect, since the sector contracted 8.4% in October last year. The growth in the index, however, is in line with what the industry itself has reported. Coal India, the country’s largest coal company, reported that production increased about 19% to 67.2 million tonnes (MT) in October. A major reason for the growth in coal production was likely demand from the power sector, which saw electricity generation jump by 21.6% in October 2026, up from 12.6% in the previous month. However, this sector too could have benefited from a low base effect, since it contracted nearly 7% in October 2025. Within the index, the infrastructure-related sectors were the only ones that grew strongly without the aid of a statistical low base effect.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The iron ore sector, for example, grew at a three-month high of 23.4% in October 2026, compared to 18.4% in September and 8.7% in October last year. One of the factors driving this strong growth was that steel production grew at 7.3% in October, the fastest rate in seven months.

🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 📈 Economic, Banking & Finance passage on "Infra push and low base effect pushes core sector growth to series-high of 10.9% in October 2026", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. While the coal and electricity sectors saw growth shoot up, a large part of this was due to a statistical effect rather than growth in actual output.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Infra push and low base effect pushes core secto' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Infra push and low base effect pushes core se' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Infra push and low base effect pushes core se' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "While the coal and electricity sectors saw growth shoot up, a large part of this was due to a statistical effect rather than growth in actual output." (Hinglish Arth: जबकि कोयला और बिजली क्षेत्रों में वृद्धि देखी गई, इसका एक बड़ा हिस्सा वास्तविक उत्पादन में वृद्धि के बजाय सांख्यिकीय प्रभाव के कारण था।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Infra push and low base effect pushes core sector growth to series-high of 10.9% in October 2026"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. One of the factors driving this strong growth was that steel production grew at 7.3% in October, the fastest rate in seven months.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "One of the factors driving this strong growth was that steel production grew at 7.3% in October, the fastest rate in seven months." (Hinglish Arth: इस मजबूत वृद्धि को चलाने वाले कारकों में से एक यह था कि अक्टूबर में इस्पात उत्पादन 7.3% की दर से बढ़ा, जो सात महीनों में सबसे तेज़ दर थी।)

articles.title: Coal auction rounds attract 85 bids; 20 first-time players enter sector

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The 16th round of commercial mine auctions put forth 25 blocks, comprising 21 fully explored and four partially explored mines.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The 16th round of commercial coal mine auctions has attracted 83 bids for 17 coal blocks with 20 first-time bidders seeking to enter commercial coal mining, signalling fresh interest in the sector. The Union Coal Ministry said on Friday that 17 blocks offered in the latest round received 83 bids. In addition, the second attempt to auction one coal block from the 15th round attracted two bids. Taking the 26 blocks covered by the auction process into account, the number of bids has quadrupled compared with the previous round, the ministry said. The 16th round of commercial coal mine auctions was launched on September 17, offering 25 blocks, comprising 21 fully explored and four partially explored mines. “Competition in the current round has been intense, with 16 of the 26 blocks attracting multiple bids. The round has also brought 20 first-time bidders into the commercial coal mining regime, a clear sign that the sector continues to draw new capital and new players,” the ministry said in a statement. Since the introduction of the commercial coal mining auction regime in June 2020, the government has auctioned 145 coal mines across 15 rounds. These mines are estimated to generate annual revenues of around ₹47,500 crore, according to government estimates.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: coal / economy (general) / business (general) / minerals (general) / metal and mineral / mining / natural resources (general) / energy resources / energy and resource

📈 Economic, Banking & Finance Paragraph #18 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Coal auction rounds attract 85 bids; 20 first-time players enter sector

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 01:31:27 PM IST
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The 16th round of commercial mine auctions put forth 25 blocks, comprising 21 fully explored and four partially explored mines.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The 16th round of commercial coal mine auctions has attracted 83 bids for 17 coal blocks with 20 first-time bidders seeking to enter commercial coal mining, signalling fresh interest in the sector. The Union Coal Ministry said on Friday that 17 blocks offered in the latest round received 83 bids. In addition, the second attempt to auction one coal block from the 15th round attracted two bids. Taking the 26 blocks covered by the auction process into account, the number of bids has quadrupled compared with the previous round, the ministry said. The 16th round of commercial coal mine auctions was launched on September 17, offering 25 blocks, comprising 21 fully explored and four partially explored mines. “Competition in the current round has been intense, with 16 of the 26 blocks attracting multiple bids. The round has also brought 20 first-time bidders into the commercial coal mining regime, a clear sign that the sector continues to draw new capital and new players,” the ministry said in a statement. Since the introduction of the commercial coal mining auction regime in June 2020, the government has auctioned 145 coal mines across 15 rounds. These mines are estimated to generate annual revenues of around ₹47,500 crore, according to government estimates.

articles.title: Ukraine says Russian strikes kill 15 in Kyiv region
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Moscow has been pummelling Ukraine with nightly aerial barrages as the war-torn country braces for another winter, as the full-scale invasion grinds through its fifth year

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Rescuers in Ukraine raced on Monday (November 23, 2026) to find residents trapped under the rubble of a block of flats that partially collapsed in a Russian strike, a fter attacks on the Kyiv region killed at least 15 people. Moscow has been pummelling Ukraine with nightly aerial barrages as the war-torn country braces for another winter, as the full-scale invasion grinds through its fifth year. Russian President Vladimir Putin vowed last week a "painful" response to Ukrainian strikes on Russia's Crimea bridge after holding a summit with U.S. counterpart Donald Trump and China's Xi Jinping. An overnight strike on Dymer, around 45 kilometres (30 miles) north of the Ukrainian capital, hit a five-storey building, killing at least 11 people, according to Kyiv regional official Tymur Tkachenko. AFP images showed rescuers combing through the mound of smouldering rubble. "Rescuers recovered the body of another person from beneath the rubble," Tkachenko wrote on Telegram, confirming the death toll had risen to 11. Ukraine's State Emergency Service said earlier on Telegram that the dead included a teenager and a woman in her forties. It said earlier that rescuers were searching for 11 people, including two children, who were "not responding or cannot be reached". Rescuers had managed to pull out people from the rubble including a 79-year-old woman and a child, Tkachenko said.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Ukrainian human rights ombudsman Dmytro Lubinets called the attack part of "Russia's genocidal war against Ukraine".

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #19 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Ukraine says Russian strikes kill 15 in Kyiv region

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 12:02:17 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Moscow has been pummelling Ukraine with nightly aerial barrages as the war-torn country braces for another winter, as the full-scale invasion grinds through its fifth year

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Rescuers in Ukraine raced on Monday (November 23, 2026) to find residents trapped under the rubble of a block of flats that partially collapsed in a Russian strike, a fter attacks on the Kyiv region killed at least 15 people. Moscow has been pummelling Ukraine with nightly aerial barrages as the war-torn country braces for another winter, as the full-scale invasion grinds through its fifth year. Russian President Vladimir Putin vowed last week a "painful" response to Ukrainian strikes on Russia's Crimea bridge after holding a summit with U.S. counterpart Donald Trump and China's Xi Jinping. An overnight strike on Dymer, around 45 kilometres (30 miles) north of the Ukrainian capital, hit a five-storey building, killing at least 11 people, according to Kyiv regional official Tymur Tkachenko. AFP images showed rescuers combing through the mound of smouldering rubble. "Rescuers recovered the body of another person from beneath the rubble," Tkachenko wrote on Telegram, confirming the death toll had risen to 11. Ukraine's State Emergency Service said earlier on Telegram that the dead included a teenager and a woman in her forties. It said earlier that rescuers were searching for 11 people, including two children, who were "not responding or cannot be reached". Rescuers had managed to pull out people from the rubble including a 79-year-old woman and a child, Tkachenko said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Ukrainian human rights ombudsman Dmytro Lubinets called the attack part of "Russia's genocidal war against Ukraine".

articles.title: Pakistan PM Shehbaz Sharif to undertake official visit to Russia
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The three-day visit to Russia will begin on November 30, aiming to strengthen bilateral ties by securing energy and investment agreements

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif is set to undertake his first official visit to Russia, followed by a trip to Iran for a regional summit. The three-day visit to Russia will begin on November 30, aiming to strengthen bilateral ties by securing energy and investment agreements, reported Dawn . During his meeting with Russian President Vladi­mir Putin, discussions are expected to focus on ene­rgy cooperation, defence, trade, regional security and investment, a source in the Prime Minister’s Office told Dawn. The revival of Pakistan Steel Mills, established with Russian assistance, is also likely to feature prominently, alongside potential Russian investment in Pakistan’s oil and gas sectors. The two countries are likely to examine possibilities for Russian cooperation in restoring the industrial facility, alongside broader initiatives aimed at supporting Pakistan’s industrial development. Later, Prime Minister Shehbaz will be travelling to Iran for the 18th Economic Coo­peration Organisation (ECO) Summit from December 3-4, according to Dawn . Leaders of 10 member States will discuss regional trade, connectivity, energy, transportation, investment and industrial cooperation.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The summit comes ahead of Pakistan assuming the ECO chairmanship for 2026-27.

articles.title: Nepal PM India visit LIVE: Balen Shah begins bilateral visit; energy, connectivity on agenda
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: This is Shah's first official bilateral foreign visit since taking office in March. He travelled to the U.S.; in September to attend the United Nations General Assembly

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Nepal and India are expected to inaugurate several completed projects in various sectors and lay foundation stones for upcoming initiatives, reflecting their efforts to expand cross-border cooperation. Beyond Government-level engagements, the visit will also feature a Nepal-India Business Forum aimed at attracting Indian investment to Nepal. Saryu-Kamala Express, which will run between Ayodhya and Janakpur, Nepal, was inaugurated today at the Ayodhya Cantt Railway Station via video conferencing by PM Narendra Modi and Nepal PM Balen Shah. Nepal PM Balendra Shah after paying homage to Mahatma Gandhi at Raj Ghat today, wrote in the memorial’s visitor book describing truth as “a power unmatched by any force” and calling compassion “the ultimate strength”. Linking Gandhi’s legacy with Nepal’s heritage, the Nepalese PM added, “On behalf of the people and Government of Nepal, I offer my deepest tribute. Coming from the birthplace of Lord Buddha, I behold in Gandhiji’s legacy that very same immortal light: the profound truth that compassion is the ultimate strength, and that true leadership lies in selfless service to the humblest among us.” The Ministry of External Affairs said, “India and Nepal share close and friendly relations, rooted in historical, cultural and civilisational links and strong people-to-people ties. Bilateral cooperation has witnessed progress across diverse sectors, including trade and commerce, development partnership, energy and water resources, and physical and digital connectivity, with growing engagement in newer areas such as start-ups, technology and innovation, and sports”. Prime Minister Modi will also host an official luncheon in honour of his Nepalese counterpart and his 34-member government delegation. Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath said the start of a direct rail service between Ayodhya and Janakpur in Nepal will open a new chapter in the centuries-old spiritual and cultural ties between the two regions and would strengthen India-Nepal relations and facilitate pilgrimage for crores of devotees. India and Nepal discussions are expected to focus on strengthening economic cooperation, particularly in trade, transportation, investment and infrastructure development. Both countries are also expected to exchange memorandums of understanding (MoUs) covering several areas of mutual interest, including education, health, agriculture, sports, disaster management and human resource development. Connectivity and energy cooperation are also expected to feature prominently during the visit. The two sides are expected to inaugurate several completed projects in these sectors and lay foundation stones for upcoming initiatives, reflecting their efforts to expand cross-border cooperation.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Former Nepal PM Jhala Nath Khanal said Nepal and India should maintain cordial relations and expand comprehensive cooperation, while expressing concern that Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah had not prepared a common national agenda ahead of his ongoing visit to India.

hinglishTracks.en: This is Shah's first official bilateral foreign visit since taking office in March.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — मार्च में पदभार संभालने के बाद यह शाह की पहली आधिकारिक द्विपक्षीय विदेश यात्रा है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Bilateral' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: द्विपक्षीय — दो देशों के बीच आपसी समझौता, व्यापार या कूटनीतिक बातचीत। इसके Synonyms हैं: Reciprocal, Two-sided, Mutual और Antonyms हैं: Unilateral, Multilateral, One-way।

hinglishTracks.en: Nepal and India are expected to inaugurate several completed projects in various sectors and lay foundation stones for upcoming initiatives, reflecting their efforts to expand cross-border cooperation.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — उम्मीद है कि नेपाल और भारत विभिन्न क्षेत्रों में कई पूर्ण परियोजनाओं का उद्घाटन करेंगे और आगामी पहलों की आधारशिला रखेंगे, जो सीमा पार सहयोग का विस्तार करने के उनके प्रयासों को दर्शाते हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: Beyond Government-level engagements, the visit will also feature a Nepal-India Business Forum aimed at attracting Indian investment to Nepal.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — सरकारी स्तर की व्यस्तताओं के अलावा, इस यात्रा में नेपाल-भारत बिजनेस फोरम भी शामिल होगा, जिसका उद्देश्य नेपाल में भारतीय निवेश को आकर्षित करना है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Saryu-Kamala Express, which will run between Ayodhya and Janakpur, Nepal, was inaugurated today at the Ayodhya Cantt Railway Station via video conferencing by PM Narendra Modi and Nepal PM Balen Shah.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — अयोध्या और नेपाल के जनकपुर के बीच चलने वाली सरयू-कमला एक्सप्रेस का उद्घाटन आज पीएम नरेंद्र मोदी और नेपाल के पीएम बालेन शाह ने वीडियो कॉन्फ्रेंसिंग के जरिए अयोध्या कैंट रेलवे स्टेशन पर किया।।

hinglishTracks.en: Nepal PM Balendra Shah after paying homage to Mahatma Gandhi at Raj Ghat today, wrote in the memorial’s visitor book describing truth as “a power unmatched by any force” and calling compassion “the ultimate strength”.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — नेपाल के प्रधानमंत्री बालेंद्र शाह ने आज राजघाट पर महात्मा गांधी को श्रद्धांजलि अर्पित करने के बाद स्मारक की आगंतुक पुस्तिका में सत्य को "किसी भी ताकत से बेजोड़ शक्ति" बताया और करुणा को "परम शक्ति" बताया।।

hinglishTracks.en: Linking Gandhi’s legacy with Nepal’s heritage, the Nepalese PM added, “On behalf of the people and Government of Nepal, I offer my deepest tribute.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — गांधी की विरासत को नेपाल की विरासत से जोड़ते हुए, नेपाली पीएम ने कहा, “नेपाल के लोगों और सरकार की ओर से, मैं अपनी गहरी श्रद्धांजलि अर्पित करता हूं।।

hinglishTracks.en: Coming from the birthplace of Lord Buddha, I behold in Gandhiji’s legacy that very same immortal light: the profound truth that compassion is the ultimate strength, and that true leadership lies in selfless service to the humblest among us.”

hinglishTracks.en: The Ministry of External Affairs said, “India and Nepal share close and friendly relations, rooted in historical, cultural and civilisational links and strong people-to-people ties.

hinglishTracks.en: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath said the start of a direct rail service between Ayodhya and Janakpur in Nepal will open a new chapter in the centuries-old spiritual and cultural ties between the two regions and would strengthen India-Nepal relations and facilitate pilgrimage for crores of devotees.
