articles.title: Paper tiger: On the Green India Mission
articles.examRelevance: UPSC, State PSC, SSC & Banking Mains: Deep Analytical Core Summary, Policy Critique, 4 Hinglish Vocab & 2 Analytical Questions
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Climate action has to be timely, with adequate resources and monitoring

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: That all was not well with the Green India Mission was clear even before its approval. After the UPA-I government announced it in 2008, the Ministry of Rural Development had objected to its financial design much before the Union Cabinet approved it in 2014. But the Environment Ministry proceeded anyway and retained largely the same arrangement when it revised the Mission in 2021. Following the Comptroller and Auditor General’s report, on November 19, the Public Accounts Committee (PAC) upbraided the Ministry for the Mission’s virtual failure and for still not having issued the implementation guidelines for the revised form. The original 10-year vision was to expand forest and tree cover by 5 million hectares (mha), improve forest quality on another 5 mha, improve forest-related livelihoods for 3 million households, and sequester up to 60 million tonnes of carbon dioxide a year. The outlay was ₹46,000 crore. In 2014, the Cabinet approved ₹13,000 crore for 1.4 mha each of the first two objectives by 2018, but to be supported to the tune of 81.5% by Compensatory Afforestation Fund Management and Planning Authority (CAMPA), National Afforestation Programme (NAP), and MGNREGS funds. In 2021-22, the Ministry folded the NAP into the Mission and, in mid-2025, unveiled a revised version with an allocation of ₹12,190 crore to improve forest cover on 25 mha by 2030, including 24 mha through other schemes. The government had thus expanded the primary target but left the Mission responsible for only 1 mha.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Together with the CAMPA, NAP, and MGNREGS funds never materialising, it is no surprise that the programmes to improve forest quality and forest cover have respectively fallen short by 91.8% and 97.5% vis-à-vis the 2014 target. The Environment Ministry had assembled a large programme around resources that it knew it could not control. Pro-climate work in practice ought to span government schemes to deliver action and justice, and the Ministry ought to have formalised the division of responsibilities and accounting system. The PAC’s new demand that the Ministry submit an implementation timetable is insufficient. From the Jal Shakti Abhiyan in 2019 to the Dharti Aaba Janjatiya Gram Utkarsh Abhiyan in 2024, the government has often floated new programmes banking significantly on funds from existing schemes — an untenable policy when the latter also have their own obligations. And if the VB-G RAM G scheme was to also advance climate justice, the government should not have undermined the erstwhile demand-driven funding model and shifted more financial responsibility to the States. Climate action has to be timely, for which the Union government must dedicate adequate resources and proactively ensure that its initiatives are implemented.

(Hinglish Arth: जलवायु कार्रवाई समय पर होनी चाहिए, जिसके लिए केंद्र सरकार को पर्याप्त संसाधन समर्पित करने चाहिए और सक्रिय रूप से यह सुनिश्चित करना चाहिए कि उसकी पहल लागू हो।)

hinglishTracks.en: Climate action has to be timely, with adequate resources and monitoring
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — पर्याप्त संसाधनों और निगरानी के साथ जलवायु कार्रवाई समय पर होनी चाहिए।

hinglishTracks.en: That all was not well with the Green India Mission was clear even before its approval.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — ग्रीन इंडिया मिशन में सब कुछ ठीक नहीं है, यह इसकी मंजूरी से पहले ही स्पष्ट हो गया था।।

hinglishTracks.en: After the UPA-I government announced it in 2008, the Ministry of Rural Development had objected to its financial design much before the Union Cabinet approved it in 2014.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — 2008 में यूपीए-1 सरकार द्वारा इसकी घोषणा के बाद, 2014 में केंद्रीय मंत्रिमंडल द्वारा इसे मंजूरी दिए जाने से काफी पहले ग्रामीण विकास मंत्रालय ने इसके वित्तीय डिजाइन पर आपत्ति जताई थी।।

hinglishTracks.en: But the Environment Ministry proceeded anyway and retained largely the same arrangement when it revised the Mission in 2021.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — लेकिन पर्यावरण मंत्रालय फिर भी आगे बढ़ा और 2021 में मिशन को संशोधित करते समय काफी हद तक वही व्यवस्था बरकरार रखी।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Environmental' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: पर्यावरण, प्रकृति और हमारे पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र (Ecosystem) से संबंधित। इसके Synonyms हैं: Ecological, Biospheric, Natural और Antonyms हैं: Industrial, Polluting, Synthetic।

hinglishTracks.en: Following the Comptroller and Auditor General’s report, on November 19, the Public Accounts Committee (PAC) upbraided the Ministry for the Mission’s virtual failure and for still not having issued the implementation guidelines for the revised form.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — नियंत्रक एवं महालेखा परीक्षक की रिपोर्ट के बाद, 19 नवंबर को, लोक लेखा समिति (पीएसी) ने मिशन की आभासी विफलता और संशोधित फॉर्म के लिए कार्यान्वयन दिशानिर्देश अभी तक जारी नहीं करने के लिए मंत्रालय को फटकार लगाई।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Implementation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: क्रियान्वयन / ज़मीनी स्तर पर लागू करना — किसी योजना या फैसले को असलियत में पूरा करना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Execution, Enforcement, Fulfillment और Antonyms हैं: Abandonment, Neglect, Cancellation।

hinglishTracks.en: The original 10-year vision was to expand forest and tree cover by 5 million hectares (mha), improve forest quality on another 5 mha, improve forest-related livelihoods for 3 million households, and sequester up to 60 million tonnes of carbon dioxide a year.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — मूल 10-वर्षीय दृष्टिकोण वन और वृक्ष आवरण को 5 मिलियन हेक्टेयर (एमएचए) तक विस्तारित करना, अन्य 5 एमएचए पर वन की गुणवत्ता में सुधार करना, 3 मिलियन परिवारों के लिए वन-संबंधी आजीविका में सुधार करना और प्रति वर्ष 60 मिलियन टन तक कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड को अलग करना था।।

hinglishTracks.en: The outlay was ₹46,000 crore.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — परिव्यय ₹46,000 करोड़ था।।

hinglishTracks.en: In 2014, the Cabinet approved ₹13,000 crore for 1.4 mha each of the first two objectives by 2018, but to be supported to the tune of 81.5% by Compensatory Afforestation Fund Management and Planning Authority (CAMPA), National Afforestation Programme (NAP), and MGNREGS funds.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — 2014 में, कैबिनेट ने 2018 तक पहले दो उद्देश्यों में से प्रत्येक 1.4 एमएचए के लिए ₹13,000 करोड़ की मंजूरी दी, लेकिन प्रतिपूरक वनीकरण निधि प्रबंधन और योजना प्राधिकरण (सीएएमपीए), राष्ट्रीय वनीकरण कार्यक्रम (एनएपी), और एमजीएनआरईजीएस फंड द्वारा 81.5% तक का समर्थन किया जाएगा।।

hinglishTracks.en: In 2021-22, the Ministry folded the NAP into the Mission and, in mid-2025, unveiled a revised version with an allocation of ₹12,190 crore to improve forest cover on 25 mha by 2030, including 24 mha through other schemes.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — 2021-22 में, मंत्रालय ने एनएपी को मिशन में शामिल कर लिया और 2025 के मध्य में, 2030 तक 25 एमएचए पर वन क्षेत्र में सुधार करने के लिए ₹12,190 करोड़ के आवंटन के साथ एक संशोधित संस्करण का अनावरण किया, जिसमें अन्य योजनाओं के माध्यम से 24 एमएचए भी शामिल था।।

hinglishTracks.en: The government had thus expanded the primary target but left the Mission responsible for only 1 mha.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — इस प्रकार सरकार ने प्राथमिक लक्ष्य का विस्तार किया लेकिन मिशन को केवल 1 मिलियन हेक्टेयर के लिए जिम्मेदार छोड़ दिया।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Responsibility' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Responsibility' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Together with the CAMPA, NAP, and MGNREGS funds never materialising, it is no surprise that the programmes to improve forest quality and forest cover have respectively fallen short by 91.8% and 97.5% vis-à-vis the 2014 target.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — CAMPA, NAP और MGNREGS फंड के कभी भी सफल नहीं होने के साथ, यह कोई आश्चर्य की बात नहीं है कि वन गुणवत्ता और वन आवरण में सुधार के कार्यक्रम 2014 के लक्ष्य की तुलना में क्रमशः 91.8% और 97.5% कम हो गए हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: The Environment Ministry had assembled a large programme around resources that it knew it could not control.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — पर्यावरण मंत्रालय ने उन संसाधनों के इर्द-गिर्द एक बड़ा कार्यक्रम तैयार किया था जिन्हें वह जानता था कि वह नियंत्रित नहीं कर सकता।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Environmental' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: पर्यावरण, प्रकृति और हमारे पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र (Ecosystem) से संबंधित। इसके Synonyms हैं: Ecological, Biospheric, Natural और Antonyms हैं: Industrial, Polluting, Synthetic।

hinglishTracks.en: Pro-climate work in practice ought to span government schemes to deliver action and justice, and the Ministry ought to have formalised the division of responsibilities and accounting system.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — व्यवहार में जलवायु समर्थक कार्य में कार्रवाई और न्याय प्रदान करने के लिए सरकारी योजनाओं का विस्तार होना चाहिए, और मंत्रालय को जिम्मेदारियों और लेखा प्रणाली के विभाजन को औपचारिक रूप देना चाहिए।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Accountability' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता। इसके Synonyms हैं: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability और Antonyms हैं: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility।

hinglishTracks.en: The PAC’s new demand that the Ministry submit an implementation timetable is insufficient.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — पीएसी की नई मांग कि मंत्रालय एक कार्यान्वयन समय सारिणी प्रस्तुत करे, अपर्याप्त है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Implementation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: क्रियान्वयन / ज़मीनी स्तर पर लागू करना — किसी योजना या फैसले को असलियत में पूरा करना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Execution, Enforcement, Fulfillment और Antonyms हैं: Abandonment, Neglect, Cancellation।

hinglishTracks.en: From the Jal Shakti Abhiyan in 2019 to the Dharti Aaba Janjatiya Gram Utkarsh Abhiyan in 2024, the government has often floated new programmes banking significantly on funds from existing schemes — an untenable policy when the latter also have their own obligations.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — 2019 में जल शक्ति अभियान से लेकर 2024 में धरती आबा जनजातीय ग्राम उत्कर्ष अभियान तक, सरकार ने अक्सर मौजूदा योजनाओं के फंड पर महत्वपूर्ण रूप से नए कार्यक्रम शुरू किए हैं - एक अस्थिर नीति जब बाद वाले के भी अपने दायित्व होते हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: And if the VB-G RAM G scheme was to also advance climate justice, the government should not have undermined the erstwhile demand-driven funding model and shifted more financial responsibility to the States.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — और अगर वीबी-जी रैम जी योजना को जलवायु न्याय को आगे बढ़ाना था, तो सरकार को पूर्ववर्ती मांग-संचालित फंडिंग मॉडल को कमजोर नहीं करना चाहिए था और राज्यों पर अधिक वित्तीय जिम्मेदारी स्थानांतरित नहीं करनी चाहिए थी।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Responsibility' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Responsibility' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Climate action has to be timely, for which the Union government must dedicate adequate resources and proactively ensure that its initiatives are implemented.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — जलवायु कार्रवाई समय पर होनी चाहिए, जिसके लिए केंद्र सरकार को पर्याप्त संसाधन समर्पित करने चाहिए और सक्रिय रूप से यह सुनिश्चित करना चाहिए कि उसकी पहल लागू हो।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Implementation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: क्रियान्वयन / ज़मीनी स्तर पर लागू करना — किसी योजना या फैसले को असलियत में पूरा करना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Execution, Enforcement, Fulfillment और Antonyms हैं: Abandonment, Neglect, Cancellation।

✍️ Editorial & Opinion Paragraph #2 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Paper tiger: On the Green India Mission

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 01:07:54 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Climate action has to be timely, with adequate resources and monitoring

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: That all was not well with the Green India Mission was clear even before its approval. After the UPA-I government announced it in 2008, the Ministry of Rural Development had objected to its financial design much before the Union Cabinet approved it in 2014. But the Environment Ministry proceeded anyway and retained largely the same arrangement when it revised the Mission in 2021. Following the Comptroller and Auditor General’s report, on November 19, the Public Accounts Committee (PAC) upbraided the Ministry for the Mission’s virtual failure and for still not having issued the implementation guidelines for the revised form. The original 10-year vision was to expand forest and tree cover by 5 million hectares (mha), improve forest quality on another 5 mha, improve forest-related livelihoods for 3 million households, and sequester up to 60 million tonnes of carbon dioxide a year. The outlay was ₹46,000 crore. In 2014, the Cabinet approved ₹13,000 crore for 1.4 mha each of the first two objectives by 2018, but to be supported to the tune of 81.5% by Compensatory Afforestation Fund Management and Planning Authority (CAMPA), National Afforestation Programme (NAP), and MGNREGS funds. In 2021-22, the Ministry folded the NAP into the Mission and, in mid-2025, unveiled a revised version with an allocation of ₹12,190 crore to improve forest cover on 25 mha by 2030, including 24 mha through other schemes. The government had thus expanded the primary target but left the Mission responsible for only 1 mha.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Together with the CAMPA, NAP, and MGNREGS funds never materialising, it is no surprise that the programmes to improve forest quality and forest cover have respectively fallen short by 91.8% and 97.5% vis-à-vis the 2014 target. The Environment Ministry had assembled a large programme around resources that it knew it could not control. Pro-climate work in practice ought to span government schemes to deliver action and justice, and the Ministry ought to have formalised the division of responsibilities and accounting system. The PAC’s new demand that the Ministry submit an implementation timetable is insufficient. From the Jal Shakti Abhiyan in 2019 to the Dharti Aaba Janjatiya Gram Utkarsh Abhiyan in 2024, the government has often floated new programmes banking significantly on funds from existing schemes — an untenable policy when the latter also have their own obligations. And if the VB-G RAM G scheme was to also advance climate justice, the government should not have undermined the erstwhile demand-driven funding model and shifted more financial responsibility to the States. Climate action has to be timely, for which the Union government must dedicate adequate resources and proactively ensure that its initiatives are implemented.

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: Climate action has to be timely, with adequate resources and monitoring
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: That all was not well with the Green India Mission was clear even before its approval. After the UPA-I government announced it in 2008, the Ministry of Rural Development had objected to its financial design much before the Union Cabinet approved it in 2014. But the Environment Ministry proceeded anyway and retained largely the same arrangement when it revised the Mission in 2021. Following the Comptroller and Auditor General’s report, on November 19, the Public Accounts Committee (PAC) upbraided the Ministry for the Mission’s virtual failure and for still not having issued the implementation guidelines for the revised form. The original 10-year vision was to expand forest and tree cover by 5 million hectares (mha), improve forest quality on another 5 mha, improve forest-related livelihoods for 3 million households, and sequester up to 60 million tonnes of carbon dioxide a year. The outlay was ₹46,000 crore. In 2014, the Cabinet approved ₹13,000 crore for 1.4 mha each of the first two objectives by 2018, but to be supported to the tune of 81.5% by Compensatory Afforestation Fund Management and Planning Authority (CAMPA), National Afforestation Programme (NAP), and MGNREGS funds. In 2021-22, the Ministry folded the NAP into the Mission and, in mid-2025, unveiled a revised version with an allocation of ₹12,190 crore to improve forest cover on 25 mha by 2030, including 24 mha through other schemes. The government had thus expanded the primary target but left the Mission responsible for only 1 mha.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Together with the CAMPA, NAP, and MGNREGS funds never materialising, it is no surprise that the programmes to improve forest quality and forest cover have respectively fallen short by 91.8% and 97.5% vis-à-vis the 2014 target. The Environment Ministry had assembled a large programme around resources that it knew it could not control. Pro-climate work in practice ought to span government schemes to deliver action and justice, and the Ministry ought to have formalised the division of responsibilities and accounting system. The PAC’s new demand that the Ministry submit an implementation timetable is insufficient. From the Jal Shakti Abhiyan in 2019 to the Dharti Aaba Janjatiya Gram Utkarsh Abhiyan in 2024, the government has often floated new programmes banking significantly on funds from existing schemes — an untenable policy when the latter also have their own obligations. And if the VB-G RAM G scheme was to also advance climate justice, the government should not have undermined the erstwhile demand-driven funding model and shifted more financial responsibility to the States. Climate action has to be timely, for which the Union government must dedicate adequate resources and proactively ensure that its initiatives are implemented.

articles.title: Incomplete remedies: On Special Summary Revision of electoral rolls
articles.examRelevance: UPSC, State PSC, SSC & Banking Mains: Deep Analytical Core Summary, Policy Critique, 4 Hinglish Vocab & 2 Analytical Questions
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The ECI offers relief to a section of deleted electors but SIR’s flaws remain

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Following the Special Summary Revision (SSR) by the Election Commission of India (ECI) in some States that had undergone the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) , mostly in Phases 1 and 2, some 74 lakh names were added onto the electoral rolls. This meant that the electorate in those 13 States, that had shrunk from 49.61 crore to 45.22 crore after the SIR, has now gone up to 45.96 crore. The ECI has extended the SSR to States and UTs in Phase 3. As before, it requires no proof of citizenship or mapping to older rolls, and insists on personal notice before any deletion other than of the dead. It also directs Electoral Registration Officers (EROs) to cross-verify deletions personally wherever they exceed 2% of a polling station’s electors. Draft deletions in Phase 3 of the SIR averaged 17% , and reached 32.8% in Delhi . The ECI also offered another opportunity to electors deleted by the SIR in the seven States and UTs where it is still underway, such as Delhi and Maharashtra, to return to the rolls. Electors who did not return their forms can do so now, explaining the delay, and those who moved within the State can return through the enumeration form with proof of their new address. EROs will process these forms under Rule 21(1) of the Registration of Electors Rules, 1960, and restore the elector’s old EPIC number. These “corrective” measures follow the Supreme Court’s observation on October 28 that forcing deleted electors to re-enrol through Form 6, meant for new voters, was an “error”. The ECI’s use of remedies that existed in the registration rules is a tacit admission that it went wrong during the SIR. But the measures are limited. They reach roughly 4.5 crore of the 13.37 crore struck off the draft rolls and do not cover electors who moved out of their States. Electors in States where the SIR has concluded, including Bihar and West Bengal, which have already voted on the SIR rolls, can return only through the SSR, by filing Form 6 as new voters, with fresh EPIC numbers and no record that they were ever on the roll. In essence, the structure of the SIR remains intact. Electors must still provide details from “the last SIR”, and those whose details are unavailable or do not match will be asked for documents in a manner that amounts to a citizenship test. The legality of the ludicrous “logical discrepancy” checks remains unaddressed. The 2002-03 special revision offered a better way. Those who had shifted homes were enumerated door to door at their new addresses. The Supreme Court must direct the ECI to return to that model.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Election Commission of India / Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls / election / India

✍️ Editorial & Opinion Paragraph #5 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Incomplete remedies: On Special Summary Revision of electoral rolls

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 01:31:27 PM IST
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The ECI offers relief to a section of deleted electors but SIR’s flaws remain

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Following the Special Summary Revision (SSR) by the Election Commission of India (ECI) in some States that had undergone the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) , mostly in Phases 1 and 2, some 74 lakh names were added onto the electoral rolls. This meant that the electorate in those 13 States, that had shrunk from 49.61 crore to 45.22 crore after the SIR, has now gone up to 45.96 crore. The ECI has extended the SSR to States and UTs in Phase 3. As before, it requires no proof of citizenship or mapping to older rolls, and insists on personal notice before any deletion other than of the dead. It also directs Electoral Registration Officers (EROs) to cross-verify deletions personally wherever they exceed 2% of a polling station’s electors. Draft deletions in Phase 3 of the SIR averaged 17% , and reached 32.8% in Delhi . The ECI also offered another opportunity to electors deleted by the SIR in the seven States and UTs where it is still underway, such as Delhi and Maharashtra, to return to the rolls. Electors who did not return their forms can do so now, explaining the delay, and those who moved within the State can return through the enumeration form with proof of their new address. EROs will process these forms under Rule 21(1) of the Registration of Electors Rules, 1960, and restore the elector’s old EPIC number. These “corrective” measures follow the Supreme Court’s observation on October 28 that forcing deleted electors to re-enrol through Form 6, meant for new voters, was an “error”. The ECI’s use of remedies that existed in the registration rules is a tacit admission that it went wrong during the SIR. But the measures are limited. They reach roughly 4.5 crore of the 13.37 crore struck off the draft rolls and do not cover electors who moved out of their States. Electors in States where the SIR has concluded, including Bihar and West Bengal, which have already voted on the SIR rolls, can return only through the SSR, by filing Form 6 as new voters, with fresh EPIC numbers and no record that they were ever on the roll. In essence, the structure of the SIR remains intact. Electors must still provide details from “the last SIR”, and those whose details are unavailable or do not match will be asked for documents in a manner that amounts to a citizenship test. The legality of the ludicrous “logical discrepancy” checks remains unaddressed. The 2002-03 special revision offered a better way. Those who had shifted homes were enumerated door to door at their new addresses. The Supreme Court must direct the ECI to return to that model.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Election Commission of India / Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls / election / India

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above ✍️ Editorial & Opinion passage on "Incomplete remedies: On Special Summary Revision of electoral rolls", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The ECI offers relief to a section of deleted electors but SIR’s flaws remain.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Incomplete remedies: On Special Summary Revision' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Incomplete remedies: On Special Summary Revis' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Incomplete remedies: On Special Summary Revis' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The ECI offers relief to a section of deleted electors but SIR’s flaws remain." (Hinglish Arth: ईसीआई हटाए गए मतदाताओं के एक वर्ग को राहत प्रदान करता है लेकिन एसआईआर की खामियां बनी हुई हैं)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Incomplete remedies: On Special Summary Revision of electoral rolls"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Election Commission of India / Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls / election / India.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. articles.title: Talks without peace: On Russia, Ukraine, U.S. talks
articles.examRelevance: UPSC, State PSC, SSC & Banking Mains: Deep Analytical Core Summary, Policy Critique, 4 Hinglish Vocab & 2 Analytical Questions
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Europe must be part of any settlement on the Ukraine war

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The trilateral negotiations in Abu Dhabi between Russia, Ukraine and the U.S. earlier this month failed to produce a major breakthrough or bridge the wide gap between Kyiv and Moscow. Yet, they were a good beginning towards finding a political settlement to Europe’s longest war since the Second World War . In the two-day talks, hosted by the U.S., the warring sides agreed on some humanitarian measures, including prisoner exchange. U.S. representatives Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff met Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow after the talks to discuss the proposal. In the next stage, U.S., Ukrainian and European officials will meet in Berlin to discuss a coordinated European and Ukrainian position towards the peace process. As of now, Russian and Ukrainian positions remain far apart. Russia demands Ukraine withdraw from the territories of Donbas it still controls to stop attacks. Russia also wants to introduce limits to Ukrainian military capabilities and Kyiv to declare neutrality (give up its NATO ambitions). Ukraine, on the other hand, has rejected making any territorial concessions for a settlement and asked for security guarantees from the West so that Russia would not attack the country again. That Ukraine survived Russia’s invasion and continued to resist Russian forces for almost five years is no small feat. But it has also paid a huge price for its resistance. The country has lost more than 20% of its territory. Millions have fled, while men of fighting age are being drafted into the military . Ukraine’s economy is kept afloat by European support, while its military continues to rely on NATO for weapons and other supplies. Until recently, the West stood united in its support for Ukraine against Russia, but that unity has since begun to fray. U.S. President Donald Trump, who has lifted sanctions on Russian diesel, is seeking to reset Washington’s ties with Moscow . European leaders, who initially sought to isolate Russia, have also started reestablishing contacts with the Kremlin. In October, Finnish and Norwegian leaders held direct talks with Mr. Putin. To be sure, Ukraine’s long-range strikes can hurt Russia, as the recent attack on the Kerch Bridge demonstrated. But such strikes are unlikely to change the Kremlin’s thinking about the war. As the conflict drags on, Ukraine’s position is weakening, and its allies are growing increasingly divided. After almost five years, Russia has failed to take a decisive victory. Ukraine does not have a credible path towards victory either. A diplomatic settlement, therefore, is the only way forward. The Abu Dhabi talks recognised this reality. But for the process to be meaningful, Europe must also be brought to the negotiating table.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: World / Ukraine / USA / Russia-Ukraine Crisis / war / war

ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.badge: Analytical Q1 • Central Inference & Passage Core
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.question: Based on a critical reading of the above ✍️ Editorial & Opinion passage on "Talks without peace: On Russia, Ukraine, U.S. talks", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
options: Europe must be part of any settlement on the Ukraine war.
Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Talks without peace: On Russia, Ukraine, U.S. ta' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Talks without peace: On Russia, Ukraine, U.S.' should be permanently discontinued.
The author contends that 'Talks without peace: On Russia, Ukraine, U.S.' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.answerText: Europe must be part of any settlement on the Ukraine war.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.hinglishExplanation: Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Europe must be part of any settlement on the Ukraine war." (Hinglish Arth: यूरोप को यूक्रेन युद्ध पर किसी भी समझौते का हिस्सा होना चाहिए)

ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.badge: Analytical Q2 • Key Evidence, Policy & Way Forward
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.question: Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Talks without peace: On Russia, Ukraine, U.S. talks"?
options: Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
World / Ukraine / USA / Russia-Ukraine Crisis / war / war.
Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.answerText: World / Ukraine / USA / Russia-Ukraine Crisis / war / war.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.hinglishExplanation: Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "World / Ukraine / USA / Russia-Ukraine Crisis / war / war." (Hinglish Arth: विश्व / यूक्रेन / अमेरिका / रूस-यूक्रेन संकट / युद्ध / युद्ध)

hinglishTracks.en: Europe must be part of any settlement on the Ukraine war
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — यूरोप को यूक्रेन युद्ध पर किसी भी समझौते का हिस्सा होना चाहिए। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Settlement' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: बस्ती — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Settlement' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: The trilateral negotiations in Abu Dhabi between Russia, Ukraine and the U.S.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — रूस, यूक्रेन और अमेरिका के बीच अबू धाबी में त्रिपक्षीय वार्ता। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Trilateral' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Trilateral' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: earlier this month failed to produce a major breakthrough or bridge the wide gap between Kyiv and Moscow.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — इस महीने की शुरुआत में कोई बड़ी सफलता हासिल करने या कीव और मॉस्को के बीच व्यापक अंतर को पाटने में विफल रही।।

hinglishTracks.en: Yet, they were a good beginning towards finding a political settlement to Europe’s longest war since the Second World War .
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — फिर भी, वे द्वितीय विश्व युद्ध के बाद यूरोप के सबसे लंबे युद्ध का राजनीतिक समाधान खोजने की दिशा में एक अच्छी शुरुआत थे।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Settlement' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: बस्ती — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Settlement' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: In the two-day talks, hosted by the U.S., the warring sides agreed on some humanitarian measures, including prisoner exchange.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — अमेरिका द्वारा आयोजित दो दिवसीय वार्ता में, युद्धरत पक्ष कैदियों की अदला-बदली सहित कुछ मानवीय उपायों पर सहमत हुए।।

hinglishTracks.en: representatives Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff met Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow after the talks to discuss the proposal.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — प्रस्ताव पर चर्चा के लिए प्रतिनिधि जेरेड कुशनर और स्टीव विटकॉफ़ ने वार्ता के बाद मॉस्को में रूसी राष्ट्रपति व्लादिमीर पुतिन से मुलाकात की।।

hinglishTracks.en: In the next stage, U.S., Ukrainian and European officials will meet in Berlin to discuss a coordinated European and Ukrainian position towards the peace process.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — अगले चरण में, अमेरिकी, यूक्रेनी और यूरोपीय अधिकारी शांति प्रक्रिया के प्रति समन्वित यूरोपीय और यूक्रेनी स्थिति पर चर्चा करने के लिए बर्लिन में मिलेंगे।।

hinglishTracks.en: As of now, Russian and Ukrainian positions remain far apart.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — अभी तक, रूसी और यूक्रेनी स्थिति बहुत दूर हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: Russia demands Ukraine withdraw from the territories of Donbas it still controls to stop attacks.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — रूस ने हमलों को रोकने के लिए यूक्रेन से डोनबास के उन क्षेत्रों से हटने की मांग की है जिन पर उसका अभी भी नियंत्रण है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Territorial' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Territorial' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: Russia also wants to introduce limits to Ukrainian military capabilities and Kyiv to declare neutrality (give up its NATO ambitions).
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — रूस भी यूक्रेनी सैन्य क्षमताओं पर सीमाएं लगाना चाहता है और कीव तटस्थता की घोषणा करना चाहता है (अपनी नाटो महत्वाकांक्षाओं को छोड़ना)।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Neutrality' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Neutrality' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Ukraine, on the other hand, has rejected making any territorial concessions for a settlement and asked for security guarantees from the West so that Russia would not attack the country again.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — दूसरी ओर, यूक्रेन ने समझौते के लिए कोई भी क्षेत्रीय रियायत देने से इनकार कर दिया है और पश्चिम से सुरक्षा गारंटी मांगी है ताकि रूस देश पर दोबारा हमला न करे।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Territorial' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Territorial' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: That Ukraine survived Russia’s invasion and continued to resist Russian forces for almost five years is no small feat.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — यूक्रेन रूस के आक्रमण से बच गया और लगभग पाँच वर्षों तक रूसी सेनाओं का विरोध करता रहा, यह कोई छोटी उपलब्धि नहीं है।।

hinglishTracks.en: But it has also paid a huge price for its resistance.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — लेकिन इसने अपने प्रतिरोध की भारी कीमत भी चुकाई है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The country has lost more than 20% of its territory.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — देश ने अपना 20% से अधिक क्षेत्र खो दिया है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Territorial' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Territorial' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: Millions have fled, while men of fighting age are being drafted into the military .
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — लाखों लोग भाग गए हैं, जबकि लड़ने की उम्र के लोगों को सेना में शामिल किया जा रहा है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Ukraine’s economy is kept afloat by European support, while its military continues to rely on NATO for weapons and other supplies.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — यूक्रेन की अर्थव्यवस्था यूरोपीय समर्थन से चलती रहती है, जबकि इसकी सेना हथियारों और अन्य आपूर्ति के लिए नाटो पर निर्भर रहती है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Until recently, the West stood united in its support for Ukraine against Russia, but that unity has since begun to fray.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — हाल तक, पश्चिम रूस के ख़िलाफ़ यूक्रेन के समर्थन में एकजुट था, लेकिन तब से वह एकता ख़त्म होने लगी है।।

hinglishTracks.en: President Donald Trump, who has lifted sanctions on Russian diesel, is seeking to reset Washington’s ties with Moscow .
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रम्प, जिन्होंने रूसी डीजल पर प्रतिबंध हटा दिया है, मास्को के साथ वाशिंगटन के संबंधों को फिर से स्थापित करने की कोशिश कर रहे हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: European leaders, who initially sought to isolate Russia, have also started reestablishing contacts with the Kremlin.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — यूरोपीय नेता, जिन्होंने शुरू में रूस को अलग-थलग करने की कोशिश की थी, उन्होंने भी क्रेमलिन के साथ फिर से संपर्क स्थापित करना शुरू कर दिया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: In October, Finnish and Norwegian leaders held direct talks with Mr.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — अक्टूबर में, फिनिश और नॉर्वेजियन नेताओं ने श्री के साथ सीधी बातचीत की।।

hinglishTracks.en: To be sure, Ukraine’s long-range strikes can hurt Russia, as the recent attack on the Kerch Bridge demonstrated.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — निश्चित रूप से, यूक्रेन के लंबी दूरी के हमले रूस को नुकसान पहुंचा सकते हैं, जैसा कि केर्च ब्रिज पर हाल के हमले से पता चला है।।

hinglishTracks.en: But such strikes are unlikely to change the Kremlin’s thinking about the war.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — लेकिन इस तरह के हमलों से क्रेमलिन की युद्ध के बारे में सोच बदलने की संभावना नहीं है।।

hinglishTracks.en: As the conflict drags on, Ukraine’s position is weakening, and its allies are growing increasingly divided.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — जैसे-जैसे संघर्ष बढ़ता जा रहा है, यूक्रेन की स्थिति कमज़ोर होती जा रही है और उसके सहयोगियों में फूट बढ़ती जा रही है।।

hinglishTracks.en: After almost five years, Russia has failed to take a decisive victory.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — करीब पांच साल बाद रूस निर्णायक जीत हासिल करने में नाकाम रहा है.।

hinglishTracks.en: Ukraine does not have a credible path towards victory either.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — यूक्रेन के पास जीत की दिशा में कोई विश्वसनीय रास्ता भी नहीं है।।

hinglishTracks.en: A diplomatic settlement, therefore, is the only way forward.

✍️ Editorial & Opinion Paragraph #6 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Talks without peace: On Russia, Ukraine, U.S. talks

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 01:31:27 PM IST
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Europe must be part of any settlement on the Ukraine war

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The trilateral negotiations in Abu Dhabi between Russia, Ukraine and the U.S. earlier this month failed to produce a major breakthrough or bridge the wide gap between Kyiv and Moscow. Yet, they were a good beginning towards finding a political settlement to Europe’s longest war since the Second World War . In the two-day talks, hosted by the U.S., the warring sides agreed on some humanitarian measures, including prisoner exchange. U.S. representatives Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff met Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow after the talks to discuss the proposal. In the next stage, U.S., Ukrainian and European officials will meet in Berlin to discuss a coordinated European and Ukrainian position towards the peace process. As of now, Russian and Ukrainian positions remain far apart. Russia demands Ukraine withdraw from the territories of Donbas it still controls to stop attacks. Russia also wants to introduce limits to Ukrainian military capabilities and Kyiv to declare neutrality (give up its NATO ambitions). Ukraine, on the other hand, has rejected making any territorial concessions for a settlement and asked for security guarantees from the West so that Russia would not attack the country again. That Ukraine survived Russia’s invasion and continued to resist Russian forces for almost five years is no small feat. But it has also paid a huge price for its resistance. The country has lost more than 20% of its territory. Millions have fled, while men of fighting age are being drafted into the military . Ukraine’s economy is kept afloat by European support, while its military continues to rely on NATO for weapons and other supplies. Until recently, the West stood united in its support for Ukraine against Russia, but that unity has since begun to fray. U.S. President Donald Trump, who has lifted sanctions on Russian diesel, is seeking to reset Washington’s ties with Moscow . European leaders, who initially sought to isolate Russia, have also started reestablishing contacts with the Kremlin. In October, Finnish and Norwegian leaders held direct talks with Mr. Putin. To be sure, Ukraine’s long-range strikes can hurt Russia, as the recent attack on the Kerch Bridge demonstrated. But such strikes are unlikely to change the Kremlin’s thinking about the war. As the conflict drags on, Ukraine’s position is weakening, and its allies are growing increasingly divided. After almost five years, Russia has failed to take a decisive victory. Ukraine does not have a credible path towards victory either. A diplomatic settlement, therefore, is the only way forward. The Abu Dhabi talks recognised this reality. But for the process to be meaningful, Europe must also be brought to the negotiating table.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: World / Ukraine / USA / Russia-Ukraine Crisis / war / war

articles.title: Pattabiram residents urge Highways dept. to build roundabouton CTH Road junction
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Residents of Pattabiram have urged the Highways Department to build a roundabout on the Chennai–Tiruvallur High Road (CTH) or Chennai–Tirupati–Renigunta Road near the flyover, replacing the Level Crossing 2 on the railway siding.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Without a roundabout, the six-way junction presents a chaotic sight during peak hours, said Roy Rozario, a resident. Apart from the lanes of the C.T.H Road, road to/from Poonamallee and M.G. Road join the junction. People heading to the police station, TIDEL Park, hotels, schools, and colleges use the junction. “Due to the lack of a roundabout, a lot of accidents happen as people drive on the wrong side of the road or drive recklessly. Long ago, the government had announced that a roundabout would be constructedat the location. We hope that it would come up soon,” he added. Residents, meanwhile, have urged the department to open the other side of the flyover to traffic. “It has been completed. Only some works such as lighting, removal of excess cement concrete, and painting seem to remain. Though the surface is rough, people are driving on the incomplete side of the flyover to reach the other side,” said T. Sadagopan, activist. articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: Residents of Pattabiram have urged the Highways Department to build a roundabout on the Chennai–Tiruvallur High Road (CTH) or Chennai–Tirupati–Renigunta Road near the flyover, replacing the Level Crossing 2 on the railway siding.
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Without a roundabout, the six-way junction presents a chaotic sight during peak hours, said Roy Rozario, a resident. Apart from the lanes of the C.T.H Road, road to/from Poonamallee and M.G. Road join the junction. People heading to the police station, TIDEL Park, hotels, schools, and colleges use the junction. “Due to the lack of a roundabout, a lot of accidents happen as people drive on the wrong side of the road or drive recklessly. Long ago, the government had announced that a roundabout would be constructedat the location. We hope that it would come up soon,” he added. Residents, meanwhile, have urged the department to open the other side of the flyover to traffic. “It has been completed. Only some works such as lighting, removal of excess cement concrete, and painting seem to remain. Though the surface is rough, people are driving on the incomplete side of the flyover to reach the other side,” said T. Sadagopan, activist. The space beneath the flyover must also be cleared and the roads must be laid properly. “Several bus services from Poonamallee, Thiruninravur, and other places have been cut, as there is no space to park the buses. Those buses that start from Pattabiram wait at random spots on the C.T.H Road. We want the Highways to also construct a foot overbridge beneath the flyover, or a limited-use subway,” said a resident.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Sources said the roundabout would be formed during the widening of the road. As far as a subway or a foot overbridge was concerned, necessary studies would be taken up.

articles.title: Six sent to juvenile home after Mumbai assault; Maharashtra SP leader seeks age change
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Police registered a case and produced all eight before the Board, and notices were sent to parents; the case was registered under sections 189(2), 189(4), 118(1), 352 and 351(2) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, says Deputy Commissioner of Police

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A juvenile court in Mumbai on Saturday sent six minors to a juvenile correctional home till December 4 in connection with the alleged assault of a couple at a garden in Kurla on Friday evening, police said on Sunday. The six are aged between 12 and 15, the Ghatkopar police said. Deputy Commissioner of Police Ganesh Shinde said an FIR was lodged against the minors under Sections 189(2) (unlawful assembly), 118(1) (voluntarily causing hurt using dangerous weapons or means), 352 (intentional insult with intent to provoke breach of peace), and 351(2) (criminal intimidation) and other relevant provisions of the BNS. All of them were produced before the Juvenile Justice Board and notices were sent to their parents. According to the police, the couple was at the garden behind Phoenix Marketcity mall when a group of minors surrounded them and began to abuse them. When the couple tried to reason with the group, they assaulted them with a hockey stick and forced them out of the garden. Police detained them after a video of the incident surfaced on social media. The police said they are recording the statements of the couple and the juveniles to determine whether the two groups had a dispute before the incident that took place at the Pramod Mahajan Garden. The incident drew sharp reactions from political parties, with many condemning it. Samajwadi Party Maharashtra president Abu Asim Azmi said the juvenile age threshold should be brought down from 18 to 15 and that those below 18 years who commit murder, robbery or harassment should not be given concessions under the law. Mr. Azmi added that the incident should not be linked to religion and that the law should act without discrimination. Meanwhile, BJP leader Kirit Somaiya met the couple at the Ghatkopar police station and promised action. NCP (SP) MP Supriya Sule urged Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis, who holds the Home portfolio, to “adopt a no-tolerance policy towards such incidents” and said citizens should be able to move around freely in the State. Shiv Sena (UBT) leader Intekhab Farooqui also condemned the assault.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mumbai / law / crime / police / Samajwadi Party / Bharatiya Janata Party / Shiv Sena

📰 Six sent to juvenile home after Mumbai assault; Maharashtra SP leader seeks age change

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 01:04:02 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Police registered a case and produced all eight before the Board, and notices were sent to parents; the case was registered under sections 189(2), 189(4), 118(1), 352 and 351(2) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, says Deputy Commissioner of Police

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A juvenile court in Mumbai on Saturday sent six minors to a juvenile correctional home till December 4 in connection with the alleged assault of a couple at a garden in Kurla on Friday evening, police said on Sunday. The six are aged between 12 and 15, the Ghatkopar police said. Deputy Commissioner of Police Ganesh Shinde said an FIR was lodged against the minors under Sections 189(2) (unlawful assembly), 118(1) (voluntarily causing hurt using dangerous weapons or means), 352 (intentional insult with intent to provoke breach of peace), and 351(2) (criminal intimidation) and other relevant provisions of the BNS. All of them were produced before the Juvenile Justice Board and notices were sent to their parents. According to the police, the couple was at the garden behind Phoenix Marketcity mall when a group of minors surrounded them and began to abuse them. When the couple tried to reason with the group, they assaulted them with a hockey stick and forced them out of the garden. Police detained them after a video of the incident surfaced on social media. The police said they are recording the statements of the couple and the juveniles to determine whether the two groups had a dispute before the incident that took place at the Pramod Mahajan Garden. The incident drew sharp reactions from political parties, with many condemning it. Samajwadi Party Maharashtra president Abu Asim Azmi said the juvenile age threshold should be brought down from 18 to 15 and that those below 18 years who commit murder, robbery or harassment should not be given concessions under the law. Mr. Azmi added that the incident should not be linked to religion and that the law should act without discrimination. Meanwhile, BJP leader Kirit Somaiya met the couple at the Ghatkopar police station and promised action. NCP (SP) MP Supriya Sule urged Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis, who holds the Home portfolio, to “adopt a no-tolerance policy towards such incidents” and said citizens should be able to move around freely in the State. Shiv Sena (UBT) leader Intekhab Farooqui also condemned the assault.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mumbai / law / crime / police / Samajwadi Party / Bharatiya Janata Party / Shiv Sena

articles.title: Over 40% Group A posts vacant at PGIMS Rohtak, says former Minister
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Alleging that 41.6% of the sanctioned Group A posts at the Post-Graduate Institute of Medical Sciences (PGIMS) in Rohtak were lying vacant, former Haryana Home Minister Subhash Batra on Sunday questioned the BJP government’s claims of improving healthcare services in the State.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Citing an inspection by the Assembly’s Subject Committee in February, Mr. Batra said 424 of the 1,018 sanctioned Group A posts at the institute were vacant. He said the shortage of doctors, specialists and healthcare staff was affecting patient care at the institute, which catered to over 8,000 patients daily in its outpatient department. Manjunath, in-charge of the Public Relations Department, PGIMS, did not respond to repeated calls and messages seeking his response to the former Minister’s allegations. Addressing a press conference, Mr. Batra also pointed out that only 200 of the 540 medicines on the government-approved list were available in the hospital store during the Health Minister’s inspection in April. Supply orders for 172 types of medicines and surgical materials were pending with companies, he alleged. Alleging that the “condition of the Radiology Department is also extremely concerning”, Mr. Batra said 10 of the 13 sanctioned faculty posts and nine of the 11 Senior Resident posts were vacant in the department, as per a September-October 2026 report. Of the nearly 500 patients advised ultrasound examinations daily, only 40% could undergo the test on the same day, he added. Questioning the gap between budgetary allocations and the availability of health care facilities, Mr. Batra said ₹1,232 crore had been allocated to the Pandit Bhagwat Dayal Sharma University of Health Sciences and PGIMS for 2026-27, an increase of ₹422 crore over the previous year, but patients continued to face shortages of medicines and delays in diagnostic tests. Mr. Batra also raised concerns over two incidents of ceiling plaster falling in the old hospital building in October. On behalf of the Congress, Mr. Batra demanded that all vacant posts be filled, medicine stocks and pending complaints be made public, diagnostic facilities expanded and old hospital buildings subjected to a safety audit.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “The poor, labourers, farmers and the middle-class families in the State need doctors on time, essential medicines and quality treatment and not speeches and announcements,” he said, adding that the Congress would continue to raise this serious issue concerning health and hold the government accountable.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Over 40% Group A posts vacant at PGIMS Rohtak, says former Minister

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 01:01:11 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Alleging that 41.6% of the sanctioned Group A posts at the Post-Graduate Institute of Medical Sciences (PGIMS) in Rohtak were lying vacant, former Haryana Home Minister Subhash Batra on Sunday questioned the BJP government’s claims of improving healthcare services in the State.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Citing an inspection by the Assembly’s Subject Committee in February, Mr. Batra said 424 of the 1,018 sanctioned Group A posts at the institute were vacant. He said the shortage of doctors, specialists and healthcare staff was affecting patient care at the institute, which catered to over 8,000 patients daily in its outpatient department. Manjunath, in-charge of the Public Relations Department, PGIMS, did not respond to repeated calls and messages seeking his response to the former Minister’s allegations. Addressing a press conference, Mr. Batra also pointed out that only 200 of the 540 medicines on the government-approved list were available in the hospital store during the Health Minister’s inspection in April. Supply orders for 172 types of medicines and surgical materials were pending with companies, he alleged. Alleging that the “condition of the Radiology Department is also extremely concerning”, Mr. Batra said 10 of the 13 sanctioned faculty posts and nine of the 11 Senior Resident posts were vacant in the department, as per a September-October 2026 report. Of the nearly 500 patients advised ultrasound examinations daily, only 40% could undergo the test on the same day, he added. Questioning the gap between budgetary allocations and the availability of health care facilities, Mr. Batra said ₹1,232 crore had been allocated to the Pandit Bhagwat Dayal Sharma University of Health Sciences and PGIMS for 2026-27, an increase of ₹422 crore over the previous year, but patients continued to face shortages of medicines and delays in diagnostic tests. Mr. Batra also raised concerns over two incidents of ceiling plaster falling in the old hospital building in October. On behalf of the Congress, Mr. Batra demanded that all vacant posts be filled, medicine stocks and pending complaints be made public, diagnostic facilities expanded and old hospital buildings subjected to a safety audit.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “The poor, labourers, farmers and the middle-class families in the State need doctors on time, essential medicines and quality treatment and not speeches and announcements,” he said, adding that the Congress would continue to raise this serious issue concerning health and hold the government accountable.

Institutional (Adjective)
संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।
✓ Syn: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional  |  ✖ Ant: Individual, Informal, Unorganized
Accountability (Noun)
जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता।
✓ Syn: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability  |  ✖ Ant: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility
Availability (Noun)
उपलब्धता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Availability' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Inspection (Adjective / Verb)
निरीक्षण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Inspection' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable

Alleging that the “condition of the Radiology Department is also extremely concerning”, Mr. Batra said 10 of the 13 sanctioned faculty posts and nine of the 11 Senior Resident posts were vacant in the department, as per a September-October 2026 report. Of the nearly 500 patients advised ultrasound examinations daily, only 40% could undergo the test on the same day, he added. Questioning the gap between budgetary allocations and the availability of health care facilities, Mr. Batra said ₹1,232 crore had been allocated to the Pandit Bhagwat Dayal Sharma University of Health Sciences and PGIMS for 2026-27, an increase of ₹422 crore over the previous year, but patients continued to face shortages of medicines and delays in diagnostic tests. Mr. Batra also raised concerns over two incidents of ceiling plaster falling in the old hospital building in October. On behalf of the Congress, Mr. Batra demanded that all vacant posts be filled, medicine stocks and pending complaints be made public, diagnostic facilities expanded and old hospital buildings subjected to a safety audit.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “The poor, labourers, farmers and the middle-class families in the State need doctors on time, essential medicines and quality treatment and not speeches and announcements,” he said, adding that the Congress would continue to raise this serious issue concerning health and hold the government accountable.

articles.title: 18th U.P. Legislative Assembly sits less than 90 days, experts point to unhealthy concentration of power in the Executive
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Fewer functioning days directly limit legislative oversight, and MLAs lose the chance to raise people-centric issues making legislature a passive spectator; experts call it contrary to spirit of constitutional checks and balance

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: With hardly two months left for Uttar Pradesh assembly polls and the 18 th Uttar Pradesh Legislative Assembly (May 2022- March 2027) nearing completion, question marks have been raised over the fewer days/meetings of the Legislative Assembly in the last five years. Editorial | Stoop to conquer: On the Opposition’s seat-sharing ahead of U.P. polls As the 18th Uttar Pradesh Legislative Assembly functioned for only 84 days, an average of 17 days a year, Opposition parties and constitutional experts in the State said fewer functioning days directly limit legislative oversight, and MLAs lose opportunities to raise constituency-centric issues. They added that in a State having a population of over 25 crores (250 million people), at least 50 days of Assembly sessions per year, similar to the Lok Sabha, are necessary. As per the data accessed by The Hindu and reverified through the data available with PRS Legislative Research as well as the U.P. Legislative Assembly Official Website, the State Assembly functioned for 16 days in 2022, 20 days in 2023, 16 days in 2024, 18 days in 2025 and 14 days in 2026 till now. The Assembly functioned for only over 500 hours in the last roughly five years in 15 sessions. In comparison, the 17 th Lok Sabha, which functioned between June 2019 and May 2024, functioned for 274 days, across 15 sessions, averaging 55 sitting/days per year. “The nearing conclusion of the tenure of the 18 th Uttar Pradesh Legislative Assembly presents an unsettling indictment of legislative governance in India’s most populous State. A House entrusted with representing more than 25 crore citizens reportedly sat for only 84 days over its five-year tenure, averaging just 17 sitting days a year. Such infrequent sittings are not a matter of administrative convenience; they strike at the heart of the constitutional scheme of accountable government. For a State grappling with enormous developmental challenges, law-and-order concerns and a population larger than that of most countries, such limited legislative engagement is indefensible. If the Lok Sabha can meet for around sixty days annually, Uttar Pradesh should institutionalize at least fifty sitting days every year as a constitutional minimum. Democracy is not sustained merely by periodic elections; it survives through continuous legislative vigilance. A Legislature that seldom meets risks converting representative government into a constitutional ritual and reducing executive accountability to an illusion. Such a trend ought to alarm every citizen who values constitutionalism, democratic oversight and the rule of law,” said Syed Mohammad Haider Rizvi, an expert on Constitutional Law and Legislative Processes and practicing advocate based in Lucknow. Sudhir Panwar, a senior Samajwadi Party (SP) leader said, “the Constitution distributed power and responsibility between legislature and executive for efficient working of democratic system. The legislature is responsible for oversight on functioning of executive and budget scrutiny. There is a fine balance between executive and legislative; fewer sitting disturb that balance in favor of the executive. The other dimension is relationship between fewer sitting and concentration of power in political system and those at helm of affairs as Chief Minister. In state assembly for continuous working, the committee system like Parliament needs to be introduced,”. Highlighting the Constitutional provisions, Mr. Rizvi added that when the Assembly sits for barely a handful of days each year, legislative oversight becomes diluted, financial scrutiny under Articles 202 to 207 becomes truncated, and the representatives of the people are deprived of sufficient opportunities to raise constituency-centric concerns, and the inevitable consequence is an unhealthy concentration of power in the Executive, contrary to the spirit of constitutional checks and balances. “The Constitution of India envisages a Legislature that is not a passive spectator but an active constitutional check upon executive authority. Articles 163 and 164 make the Council of Ministers collectively responsible to the Legislative Assembly, a responsibility that can be meaningfully enforced only when the House meets frequently enough to question, debate, scrutinize, and hold the Government to account. Likewise, Article 174 requires the Legislature to meet at regular intervals and clearly contemplates a living, functioning institution rather than one that assembles merely to satisfy the minimum constitutional formality. In constitutional theory and democratic practice alike, the Legislature is the foremost forum through which the sovereign will of the people finds expression,” he said.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Uttar Pradesh / executive (government) / Bharatiya Janata Party

hinglishTracks.en: A House entrusted with representing more than 25 crore citizens reportedly sat for only 84 days over its five-year tenure, averaging just 17 sitting days a year.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — कथित तौर पर 25 करोड़ से अधिक नागरिकों का प्रतिनिधित्व करने वाला सदन अपने पांच साल के कार्यकाल में केवल 84 दिन ही बैठा, यानी साल में औसतन केवल 17 दिन।।

hinglishTracks.en: Such infrequent sittings are not a matter of administrative convenience; they strike at the heart of the constitutional scheme of accountable government.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — ऐसी कम बैठकें प्रशासनिक सुविधा का विषय नहीं हैं; वे जवाबदेह सरकार की संवैधानिक योजना के मूल पर प्रहार करते हैं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.en: For a State grappling with enormous developmental challenges, law-and-order concerns and a population larger than that of most countries, such limited legislative engagement is indefensible.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — भारी विकासात्मक चुनौतियों, कानून-व्यवस्था की चिंताओं और अधिकांश देशों की तुलना में बड़ी आबादी से जूझ रहे राज्य के लिए, ऐसी सीमित विधायी भागीदारी अपरिहार्य है।।

hinglishTracks.en: If the Lok Sabha can meet for around sixty days annually, Uttar Pradesh should institutionalize at least fifty sitting days every year as a constitutional minimum.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — यदि लोकसभा सालाना लगभग साठ दिनों के लिए बैठक कर सकती है, तो उत्तर प्रदेश को संवैधानिक रूप से हर साल कम से कम पचास बैठक दिनों को संस्थागत बनाना चाहिए।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Institutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ। इसके Synonyms हैं: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional और Antonyms हैं: Individual, Informal, Unorganized।

hinglishTracks.en: Democracy is not sustained merely by periodic elections; it survives through continuous legislative vigilance.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — लोकतंत्र केवल समय-समय पर होने वाले चुनावों से कायम नहीं रहता; यह निरंतर विधायी सतर्कता के माध्यम से जीवित रहता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: A Legislature that seldom meets risks converting representative government into a constitutional ritual and reducing executive accountability to an illusion.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — एक विधायिका जो शायद ही कभी प्रतिनिधि सरकार को एक संवैधानिक अनुष्ठान में बदलने और कार्यकारी जवाबदेही को एक भ्रम में बदलने के जोखिमों को पूरा करती है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.en: Such a trend ought to alarm every citizen who values constitutionalism, democratic oversight and the rule of law,” said Syed Mohammad Haider Rizvi, an expert on Constitutional Law and Legislative Processes and practicing advocate based in Lucknow.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — इस तरह की प्रवृत्ति से हर उस नागरिक को चिंतित होना चाहिए जो संवैधानिकता, लोकतांत्रिक निरीक्षण और कानून के शासन को महत्व देता है, ”सैयद मोहम्मद हैदर रिज़वी, संवैधानिक कानून और विधायी प्रक्रियाओं के विशेषज्ञ और लखनऊ स्थित वकील ने कहा।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.en: Sudhir Panwar, a senior Samajwadi Party (SP) leader said, “the Constitution distributed power and responsibility between legislature and executive for efficient working of democratic system.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — समाजवादी पार्टी (सपा) के वरिष्ठ नेता सुधीर पंवार ने कहा, “संविधान ने लोकतांत्रिक प्रणाली के कुशल कामकाज के लिए विधायिका और कार्यपालिका के बीच शक्ति और जिम्मेदारी वितरित की है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.en: The legislature is responsible for oversight on functioning of executive and budget scrutiny.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — विधायिका कार्यपालिका के कामकाज पर निगरानी और बजट जांच के लिए जिम्मेदार है।।

hinglishTracks.en: There is a fine balance between executive and legislative; fewer sitting disturb that balance in favor of the executive.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — कार्यपालिका और विधायिका के बीच एक अच्छा संतुलन है; कम बैठने से कार्यपालिका के पक्ष में संतुलन बिगड़ जाता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The other dimension is relationship between fewer sitting and concentration of power in political system and those at helm of affairs as Chief Minister.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — दूसरा आयाम राजनीतिक व्यवस्था में कम बैठने और सत्ता की एकाग्रता और मुख्यमंत्री के रूप में मामलों के शीर्ष पर बैठे लोगों के बीच संबंध है।।

hinglishTracks.en: In state assembly for continuous working, the committee system like Parliament needs to be introduced,”.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — राज्य विधानसभा में निरंतर कामकाज के लिए संसद की तरह समिति प्रणाली शुरू करने की जरूरत है।”।

hinglishTracks.en: Highlighting the Constitutional provisions, Mr.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — संवैधानिक प्रावधानों पर प्रकाश डालते हुए श्री.। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.en: Rizvi added that when the Assembly sits for barely a handful of days each year, legislative oversight becomes diluted, financial scrutiny under Articles 202 to 207 becomes truncated, and the representatives of the people are deprived of sufficient opportunities to raise constituency-centric concerns, and the inevitable consequence is an unhealthy concentration of power in the Executive, contrary to the spirit of constitutional checks and balances.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — रिज़वी ने कहा कि जब विधानसभा हर साल बमुश्किल कुछ दिनों के लिए बैठती है, तो विधायी निरीक्षण कमजोर हो जाता है, अनुच्छेद 202 से 207 के तहत वित्तीय जांच कम हो जाती है, और लोगों के प्रतिनिधि निर्वाचन क्षेत्र-केंद्रित चिंताओं को उठाने के पर्याप्त अवसरों से वंचित हो जाते हैं, और अपरिहार्य परिणाम संवैधानिक जांच और संतुलन की भावना के विपरीत, कार्यपालिका में शक्ति का अस्वास्थ्यकर संकेंद्रण होता है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.en: “The Constitution of India envisages a Legislature that is not a passive spectator but an active constitutional check upon executive authority.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — “भारत का संविधान एक ऐसे विधानमंडल की परिकल्पना करता है जो निष्क्रिय दर्शक नहीं बल्कि कार्यकारी प्राधिकार पर एक सक्रिय संवैधानिक जाँच है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.en: Articles 163 and 164 make the Council of Ministers collectively responsible to the Legislative Assembly, a responsibility that can be meaningfully enforced only when the House meets frequently enough to question, debate, scrutinize, and hold the Government to account.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — अनुच्छेद 163 और 164 मंत्रिपरिषद को सामूहिक रूप से विधान सभा के प्रति जिम्मेदार बनाते हैं, एक जिम्मेदारी जिसे सार्थक रूप से तभी लागू किया जा सकता है जब सदन की बैठकें अक्सर सवाल करने, बहस करने, जांच करने और सरकार को जवाबदेह ठहराने के लिए होती हैं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Enforcement' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: सख्ती से कानून लागू करना — किसी नियम या आदेश का ज़मीनी स्तर पर पालन करवाना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Implementation, Execution, Administration और Antonyms हैं: Neglect, Abandonment, Waiver।

hinglishTracks.en: Likewise, Article 174 requires the Legislature to meet at regular intervals and clearly contemplates a living, functioning institution rather than one that assembles merely to satisfy the minimum constitutional formality.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — इसी तरह, अनुच्छेद 174 में विधायिका को नियमित अंतराल पर बैठक करने की आवश्यकता होती है और यह स्पष्ट रूप से एक जीवित, कार्यशील संस्था पर विचार करता है न कि केवल न्यूनतम संवैधानिक औपचारिकता को पूरा करने के लिए इकट्ठा होने वाली संस्था के रूप में।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Institutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ। इसके Synonyms हैं: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional और Antonyms हैं: Individual, Informal, Unorganized।

hinglishTracks.en: In constitutional theory and democratic practice alike, the Legislature is the foremost forum through which the sovereign will of the people finds expression,” he said.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — संवैधानिक सिद्धांत और लोकतांत्रिक व्यवहार में, विधायिका सबसे महत्वपूर्ण मंच है जिसके माध्यम से लोगों की संप्रभु इच्छा को अभिव्यक्ति मिलती है, ”उन्होंने कहा।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.en: Uttar Pradesh / executive (government) / Bharatiya Janata Party
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — उत्तर प्रदेश/कार्यकारी (सरकार)/भारतीय जनता पार्टी।
