📰 South Delhi braces for wedding rush, over 7,000 guests and 3,500 vehicles expected

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 11:16:32 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Adequate personnel have been deployed to regulate vehicular movement on roads covered by the advisory

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Traffic restrictions and additional personnel have been deployed on several roads in south Delhi as more than 19 wedding functions are scheduled across the area on Monday (November 23, 2026), with over 7,000 guests and around 3,500 additional vehicles expected, police said. Adequate personnel have been deployed to regulate vehicular movement on roads covered by the advisory, including SSN Marg (Bhati Mines Road), Bandh Road, Mandi Road and MG Road, according to the Delhi Traffic Police. The stretches likely to witness congestion include SSN Marg, 100 Foota Road, Anuvrat Marg, Aurobindo Marg, Mandi Road, Jonapur Road, Mehrauli-Gurugram Road and Mehrauli-Mahipalpur Road. Wedding guests have been asked to park their vehicles only in designated parking areas and avoid roadside parking.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Commuters can check real-time traffic updates and diversions through the Delhi Traffic Police's social media handle. They can also contact the traffic helpline at 1095 or the emergency number 112.

articles.title: Private buses in Keralam reported for violations on the new web app Idi Vandi
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Developed by Bengaluru-based Malayali Hrishikesh Vinod, the web app has received over 600 complaints in a week since going live

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: For someone who drives/rides in Keralam, the interface of the web app idivandi.com would look like a rogues’ gallery with photographs of buses, and the accompanying ‘music’ is the sound of horns blaring from private buses plying State roads. Road users have ‘reported’ these buses for traffic violations including rash driving, speeding, and/or blaring their horns. Since going live more than a week ago, users have already registered 679 complaints against 491 buses across Keralam. The web app, developed using AI tools, began as Bengaluru-based Hrishikesh Vinod’s way of venting about a private bus that rear-ended his brand-new car in April this year. When Hrishikesh, who runs a marketing agency, bought a new car, he wanted to show it to his mother at Kakkad, in Kannur, Keralam. “I brought it to Kannur, and within three days the incident happened. This was my way of venting. I did it for myself; I didn't intend to make it public. But what happened to Akshara S, who was run over by a private bus in Kochi on November 4, and what her husband, Varun, posted on social media about losing her struck a chord. A spate of other incidents involving private buses also prompted me to throw the app open to the public,” says Hrishikesh. Hrishikesh Vinod, who developed the Idi Vandi web app | Photo Credit: SPECIAL ARRANGEMENT He clarifies that he doesn't mean to malign bus drivers or owners, but to demand accountability. “This is not designed to hassle or get them into trouble; I want them to spare some thought for their behaviour and how they treat others using the roads.” Idi vandi is colloquial for rashly driven buses, which cause accidents. All complaints and incidents are verified using AI. “I have set up several firewalls so that people do not use this website as a platform to settle personal scores.” For instance, a person cannot make more than two complaints a day. There are more than 20 criteria for complaints, including racing, rash driving, honking, harassing passengers, and dangerous overtaking. Each offence comes with a score or ‘idi points’: rear-ending gets five points, causing an accident gets a score of six, a bus that causes a fatality gains 10 points, and so on. There is even a leaderboard of buses with the most violations. Apart from complaining on the website, which will be forwarded after mandatory vetting to the concerned Road Transport Office (RTO), there is also the option of making a direct complaint. This will be anonymous; only idivandi.com and the Motor Vehicle Department (MVD) will have access to the complainant’s details. So far, Idi Vandi has sent 15 complaints to RTOs across Keralam. The offices have received only three responses. “If a bus racks up more than three complaints, an email is sent to the RTO, with a reminder every 30 days.” Since he has just gone live, he is considering options about what to do if there is no response. An option he is considering is filing an RTI application, asking what action has been taken, if the two follow-up requests are ignored.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “Think about it… there would be 2000-odd private buses plying on our roads along various routes. If there are complaints against 400-plus of these, it is a huge number of violations!” It is not all errant buses on Idi Vandi; a Nalla Vandi section lists buses that have been ‘good ’, like helping passengers and showing kindness to students and the disabled.

ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.answerText: If there are complaints against 400-plus of these, it is a huge number of violations!” It is not all errant buses on Idi Vandi; a Nalla Vandi section...

Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "If there are complaints against 400-plus of these, it is a huge number of violations!” It is not all errant buses on Idi Vandi; a Nalla Vandi section..." (Hinglish Arth: यदि इनमें से 400 से अधिक के खिलाफ शिकायतें हैं, तो यह उल्लंघनों की एक बड़ी संख्या है!” ईदी वंडी पर सभी गलत बसें नहीं हैं; नल्ला वंडी अनुभाग उन बसों को सूचीबद्ध करता है जो 'अच्छी' रही हैं, जैसे यात्रियों की मदद करना और दिखाना)

hinglishTracks.en: Developed by Bengaluru-based Malayali Hrishikesh Vinod, the web app has received over 600 complaints in a week since going live
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — बेंगलुरु स्थित मलयाली हृषिकेश विनोद द्वारा विकसित, वेब ऐप को लाइव होने के बाद से एक सप्ताह में 600 से अधिक शिकायतें मिली हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: For someone who drives/rides in Keralam, the interface of the web app idivandi.com would look like a rogues’ gallery with photographs of buses, and the accompanying ‘music’ is the sound of horns blaring from private buses plying State roads.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — केरल में गाड़ी चलाने/सवारी करने वाले किसी व्यक्ति के लिए, वेब ऐप idivandi.com का इंटरफ़ेस बसों की तस्वीरों वाली एक दुष्ट गैलरी की तरह दिखेगा, और साथ में 'संगीत' राज्य की सड़कों पर चलने वाली निजी बसों से बजने वाले हॉर्न की आवाज़ है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Road users have ‘reported’ these buses for traffic violations including rash driving, speeding, and/or blaring their horns.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — सड़क उपयोगकर्ताओं ने इन बसों पर लापरवाही से गाड़ी चलाने, तेज गति से गाड़ी चलाने और/या हॉर्न बजाने सहित यातायात उल्लंघनों की 'रिपोर्ट' की है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Since going live more than a week ago, users have already registered 679 complaints against 491 buses across Keralam.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — एक सप्ताह से अधिक समय पहले लाइव होने के बाद से, उपयोगकर्ता पहले ही केरलम में 491 बसों के खिलाफ 679 शिकायतें दर्ज कर चुके हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: The web app, developed using AI tools, began as Bengaluru-based Hrishikesh Vinod’s way of venting about a private bus that rear-ended his brand-new car in April this year.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — एआई टूल्स का उपयोग करके विकसित किया गया वेब ऐप, बेंगलुरु स्थित हृषिकेश विनोद के एक निजी बस के बारे में बताने के तरीके के रूप में शुरू हुआ, जिसने इस साल अप्रैल में उनकी ब्रांड-नई कार को पीछे से खत्म कर दिया था।।

hinglishTracks.en: When Hrishikesh, who runs a marketing agency, bought a new car, he wanted to show it to his mother at Kakkad, in Kannur, Keralam.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — जब एक मार्केटिंग एजेंसी चलाने वाले हृषिकेश ने एक नई कार खरीदी, तो वह इसे केरल के कन्नूर में कक्कड़ में अपनी मां को दिखाना चाहता था।।

hinglishTracks.en: “I brought it to Kannur, and within three days the incident happened.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — “मैं इसे कन्नूर ले आया और तीन दिनों के भीतर यह घटना घट गई।।

hinglishTracks.en: This was my way of venting.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — यह मेरा गुस्सा जाहिर करने का तरीका था.।

hinglishTracks.en: I did it for myself; I didn't intend to make it public.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — मैंने इसे अपने लिए किया; मेरा इरादा इसे सार्वजनिक करने का नहीं था.।

hinglishTracks.en: But what happened to Akshara S, who was run over by a private bus in Kochi on November 4, and what her husband, Varun, posted on social media about losing her struck a chord.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — लेकिन अक्षरा एस के साथ जो हुआ, वह 4 नवंबर को कोच्चि में एक निजी बस से कुचल गई थी, और उसके पति वरुण ने उसे खोने के बारे में सोशल मीडिया पर जो पोस्ट किया, उसने दिल दहला दिया।।

hinglishTracks.en: A spate of other incidents involving private buses also prompted me to throw the app open to the public,” says Hrishikesh.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — निजी बसों से जुड़ी कई अन्य घटनाओं ने भी मुझे ऐप को जनता के लिए खोलने के लिए प्रेरित किया,'' हृषिकेश कहते हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: Hrishikesh Vinod, who developed the Idi Vandi web app | Photo Credit: SPECIAL ARRANGEMENT
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — हृषिकेश विनोद, जिन्होंने ईदी वंडी वेब ऐप विकसित किया | फोटो साभार: विशेष व्यवस्था। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Arrangement' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Arrangement' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: He clarifies that he doesn't mean to malign bus drivers or owners, but to demand accountability.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — उन्होंने स्पष्ट किया कि उनका इरादा बस चालकों या मालिकों को बदनाम करना नहीं है, बल्कि जवाबदेही की मांग करना है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Accountability' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता। इसके Synonyms हैं: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability और Antonyms हैं: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility।

hinglishTracks.en: “This is not designed to hassle or get them into trouble; I want them to spare some thought for their behaviour and how they treat others using the roads.” Idi vandi is colloquial for rashly driven buses, which cause accidents.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — "यह उन्हें परेशान करने या परेशानी में डालने के लिए नहीं बनाया गया है; मैं चाहता हूं कि वे अपने व्यवहार और सड़कों पर दूसरों के साथ कैसा व्यवहार करते हैं, इस पर कुछ विचार करें।" ईदी वंडी लापरवाही से चलने वाली बसों के लिए बोलचाल की भाषा है, जो दुर्घटनाओं का कारण बनती हैं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Colloquial' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Colloquial' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: All complaints and incidents are verified using AI.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — सभी शिकायतों और घटनाओं को एआई का उपयोग करके सत्यापित किया जाता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: “I have set up several firewalls so that people do not use this website as a platform to settle personal scores.” For instance, a person cannot make more than two complaints a day.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — "मैंने कई फ़ायरवॉल स्थापित किए हैं ताकि लोग इस वेबसाइट का उपयोग व्यक्तिगत हिसाब-किताब तय करने के लिए एक मंच के रूप में न करें।" उदाहरण के लिए, एक व्यक्ति एक दिन में दो से अधिक शिकायतें नहीं कर सकता।।

hinglishTracks.en: There are more than 20 criteria for complaints, including racing, rash driving, honking, harassing passengers, and dangerous overtaking.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — शिकायतों के लिए 20 से अधिक मानदंड हैं, जिनमें रेसिंग, लापरवाही से गाड़ी चलाना, हॉर्न बजाना, यात्रियों को परेशान करना और खतरनाक ओवरटेकिंग शामिल हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: Each offence comes with a score or ‘idi points’: rear-ending gets five points, causing an accident gets a score of six, a bus that causes a fatality gains 10 points, and so on.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — प्रत्येक अपराध एक अंक या 'आईडीआई अंक' के साथ आता है: पीछे वाले को पांच अंक मिलते हैं, दुर्घटना का कारण बनने वाली बस को छह अंक मिलते हैं, जिस बस को मौत का कारण बनता है उसे 10 अंक मिलते हैं, और इसी तरह।।

hinglishTracks.en: There is even a leaderboard of buses with the most violations.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — यहां तक ​​कि सबसे अधिक उल्लंघन वाली बसों का एक लीडरबोर्ड भी है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Apart from complaining on the website, which will be forwarded after mandatory vetting to the concerned Road Transport Office (RTO), there is also the option of making a direct complaint.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — वेबसाइट पर शिकायत करने के अलावा, जिसे संबंधित सड़क परिवहन कार्यालय (आरटीओ) को अनिवार्य जांच के बाद भेजा जाएगा, सीधे शिकायत करने का विकल्प भी है।।

hinglishTracks.en: This will be anonymous; only idivandi.com and the Motor Vehicle Department (MVD) will have access to the complainant’s details.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — यह गुमनाम होगा; केवल idivandi.com और मोटर वाहन विभाग (एमवीडी) के पास शिकायतकर्ता के विवरण तक पहुंच होगी।।

hinglishTracks.en: So far, Idi Vandi has sent 15 complaints to RTOs across Keralam.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — अब तक, इदी वांडी ने पूरे केरलम में आरटीओ को 15 शिकायतें भेजी हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: The offices have received only three responses.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — कार्यालयों को केवल तीन प्रतिक्रियाएँ प्राप्त हुई हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: “If a bus racks up more than three complaints, an email is sent to the RTO, with a reminder every 30 days.” Since he has just gone live, he is considering options about what to do if there is no response.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — "यदि किसी बस में तीन से अधिक शिकायतें आती हैं, तो हर 30 दिनों में एक अनुस्मारक के साथ आरटीओ को एक ईमेल भेजा जाता है।" चूँकि वह अभी-अभी लाइव हुआ है, इसलिए वह विकल्पों पर विचार कर रहा है कि अगर कोई प्रतिक्रिया नहीं मिलती है तो क्या किया जाए।।

hinglishTracks.en: An option he is considering is filing an RTI application, asking what action has been taken, if the two follow-up requests are ignored.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #26 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Private buses in Keralam reported for violations on the new web app Idi Vandi

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 12:01:38 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Developed by Bengaluru-based Malayali Hrishikesh Vinod, the web app has received over 600 complaints in a week since going live

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: For someone who drives/rides in Keralam, the interface of the web app idivandi.com would look like a rogues’ gallery with photographs of buses, and the accompanying ‘music’ is the sound of horns blaring from private buses plying State roads. Road users have ‘reported’ these buses for traffic violations including rash driving, speeding, and/or blaring their horns. Since going live more than a week ago, users have already registered 679 complaints against 491 buses across Keralam. The web app, developed using AI tools, began as Bengaluru-based Hrishikesh Vinod’s way of venting about a private bus that rear-ended his brand-new car in April this year. When Hrishikesh, who runs a marketing agency, bought a new car, he wanted to show it to his mother at Kakkad, in Kannur, Keralam. “I brought it to Kannur, and within three days the incident happened. This was my way of venting. I did it for myself; I didn't intend to make it public. But what happened to Akshara S, who was run over by a private bus in Kochi on November 4, and what her husband, Varun, posted on social media about losing her struck a chord. A spate of other incidents involving private buses also prompted me to throw the app open to the public,” says Hrishikesh. Hrishikesh Vinod, who developed the Idi Vandi web app | Photo Credit: SPECIAL ARRANGEMENT He clarifies that he doesn't mean to malign bus drivers or owners, but to demand accountability. “This is not designed to hassle or get them into trouble; I want them to spare some thought for their behaviour and how they treat others using the roads.” Idi vandi is colloquial for rashly driven buses, which cause accidents. All complaints and incidents are verified using AI. “I have set up several firewalls so that people do not use this website as a platform to settle personal scores.” For instance, a person cannot make more than two complaints a day. There are more than 20 criteria for complaints, including racing, rash driving, honking, harassing passengers, and dangerous overtaking. Each offence comes with a score or ‘idi points’: rear-ending gets five points, causing an accident gets a score of six, a bus that causes a fatality gains 10 points, and so on. There is even a leaderboard of buses with the most violations. Apart from complaining on the website, which will be forwarded after mandatory vetting to the concerned Road Transport Office (RTO), there is also the option of making a direct complaint. This will be anonymous; only idivandi.com and the Motor Vehicle Department (MVD) will have access to the complainant’s details. So far, Idi Vandi has sent 15 complaints to RTOs across Keralam. The offices have received only three responses. “If a bus racks up more than three complaints, an email is sent to the RTO, with a reminder every 30 days.” Since he has just gone live, he is considering options about what to do if there is no response. An option he is considering is filing an RTI application, asking what action has been taken, if the two follow-up requests are ignored.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “Think about it… there would be 2000-odd private buses plying on our roads along various routes. If there are complaints against 400-plus of these, it is a huge number of violations!” It is not all errant buses on Idi Vandi; a Nalla Vandi section lists buses that have been ‘good ’, like helping passengers and showing kindness to students and the disabled.

Application (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Application' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Colloquial' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।

articles.title: Automation system problem at Delta causes flight delays as Americans travel for Thanksgiving
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Delta delays come as Americans have been encountering a growing number of problems with technology that are increasingly disrupting their lives

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Over 1,000 Delta flights were delayed Sunday (November 22, 2026) after an automated system that calculates an aircraft's weight malfunctioned during a busy time for travel ahead of the Thanksgiving holiday. The airline said Sunday (November 22, 2026) morning that its teams were using manual workarounds to get flights off the ground while they sought to restore the automation system that ensures an aircraft isn't too heavy to fly. Hours later, Delta said that system was once again working, though flights were still not back to normal. The airline said it was helping passengers who needed hotel rooms or meals but hoped to have all the delayed flights in the air by the end of the day. On Sunday (November 22, 2026) morning, the Federal Aviation Administration issued about an hourlong ground stop to some flights into Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport, which is Delta's hub and one of the busiest airports in the world. Complying with the weight and balance limits of an aircraft is critical to flight safety, according to an FAA document, and going above the limit can compromise the structural integrity of the aircraft. The agency said on X that the delays weren't related to FAA air traffic systems. Earlier this month, a malfunction in th e FAA’s network led to the longest nationwide ground stop in 25 years . The stop lasted for more than four hours, and carriers canceled and delayed swaths of flights as they worked to recover. Just days after that, United Airlines saw its own system outage — forcing it to delay departing flights. The Delta delays come as Americans have been encountering a growing number of problems with technology that are increasingly disrupting their lives. And the disruptions came just days before the Thanksgiving holiday, the busiest travel season in the United States. As of Sunday (November 22, 2026) evening, the flight-tracking website FlightAware said 58%, or about 2,000, of Delta's flights were delayed; it wasn't immediately clear how many of those involved flights into or out of the Atlanta airport.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: FlightAware said that about 58% of flights out of the Atlanta airport were delayed while about 50% of flights destined for the airport were delayed. The vast majority of flights at the Atlanta airport are operated by Delta.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #20 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Automation system problem at Delta causes flight delays as Americans travel for Thanksgiving

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 11:05:15 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The Delta delays come as Americans have been encountering a growing number of problems with technology that are increasingly disrupting their lives

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Over 1,000 Delta flights were delayed Sunday (November 22, 2026) after an automated system that calculates an aircraft's weight malfunctioned during a busy time for travel ahead of the Thanksgiving holiday. The airline said Sunday (November 22, 2026) morning that its teams were using manual workarounds to get flights off the ground while they sought to restore the automation system that ensures an aircraft isn't too heavy to fly. Hours later, Delta said that system was once again working, though flights were still not back to normal. The airline said it was helping passengers who needed hotel rooms or meals but hoped to have all the delayed flights in the air by the end of the day. On Sunday (November 22, 2026) morning, the Federal Aviation Administration issued about an hourlong ground stop to some flights into Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport, which is Delta's hub and one of the busiest airports in the world. Complying with the weight and balance limits of an aircraft is critical to flight safety, according to an FAA document, and going above the limit can compromise the structural integrity of the aircraft. The agency said on X that the delays weren't related to FAA air traffic systems. Earlier this month, a malfunction in th e FAA’s network led to the longest nationwide ground stop in 25 years . The stop lasted for more than four hours, and carriers canceled and delayed swaths of flights as they worked to recover. Just days after that, United Airlines saw its own system outage — forcing it to delay departing flights. The Delta delays come as Americans have been encountering a growing number of problems with technology that are increasingly disrupting their lives. And the disruptions came just days before the Thanksgiving holiday, the busiest travel season in the United States. As of Sunday (November 22, 2026) evening, the flight-tracking website FlightAware said 58%, or about 2,000, of Delta's flights were delayed; it wasn't immediately clear how many of those involved flights into or out of the Atlanta airport.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: FlightAware said that about 58% of flights out of the Atlanta airport were delayed while about 50% of flights destined for the airport were delayed. The vast majority of flights at the Atlanta airport are operated by Delta.

articles.title: U.S. panel urges India dialogue for Dalai Lama succession, warns of China legitimacy contest
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: A U.S. Congressional panel has recommended establishing a senior-level channel with India for succession contingency planning for the 14th Dalai Lama, arguing that China may turn the process into an international legitimacy contest

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A U.S. Congressional panel has recommended setting up a senior-level channel with India for succession contingency planning for the 14th Dalai Lama, contending that China may turn the process into an international contest over legitimacy. A U.S. Congressional panel has recommended establishing a senior-level channel with India for succession contingency planning for the 14th Dalai Lama, arguing that China may turn the process into an international legitimacy contest. The U.S.-China Economic and Security Review Commission, in a report to the U.S. Congress, made a strong pitch to recognise the Gaden Phodrang Trust as the sole legitimate authority to identify and recognise the successor to the 14th Dalai Lama. The report by the bipartisan Commission said China was likely to use coercive tools to shape the outcome of the succession process. It said that the U.S. Congress should adopt a policy of not recognising any successor to the Dalai Lama who is selected or installed by China. “To carry out this policy and ensure U.S. government readiness for the Dalai Lama’s succession, Congress should direct the Secretary of State to… establish a senior-level channel with the Government of India for succession contingency planning, including intelligence sharing on Chinese influence operations,” the report said. It also asked the U.S. Secretary of State to lead an internal interagency tabletop exercise on succession scenarios, with participation by the National Security Advisor, the Director of National Intelligence, and the Secretary of Defence. The commission also asked the U.S. Secretary of State to conduct Track 1.5 and Track 2 dialogues and tabletop exercises with Indian counterparts on the political and security implications of succession scenarios. The Commission also wanted the U.S. to coordinate with allies and partners on a diplomatic response that denies international legitimacy to any successor selected by China.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: It also wanted the U.S. to counter succession-related influence operations by strengthening the Central Tibetan Administration’s cybersecurity and resilience against China’s cyber and artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled disinformation campaigns.

Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A U.S. Congressional panel has recommended setting up a senior-level channel with India for succession contingency planning for the 14th Dalai Lama, contending that China may turn the process into an international contest over legitimacy. A U.S. Congressional panel has recommended establishing a senior-level channel with India for succession contingency planning for the 14th Dalai Lama, arguing that China may turn the process into an international legitimacy contest. The U.S.-China Economic and Security Review Commission, in a report to the U.S. Congress, made a strong pitch to recognise the Gaden Phodrang Trust as the sole legitimate authority to identify and recognise the successor to the 14th Dalai Lama. The report by the bipartisan Commission said China was likely to use coercive tools to shape the outcome of the succession process. It said that the U.S. Congress should adopt a policy of not recognising any successor to the Dalai Lama who is selected or installed by China. “To carry out this policy and ensure U.S. government readiness for the Dalai Lama’s succession, Congress should direct the Secretary of State to… establish a senior-level channel with the Government of India for succession contingency planning, including intelligence sharing on Chinese influence operations,” the report said. It also asked the U.S. Secretary of State to lead an internal interagency tabletop exercise on succession scenarios, with participation by the National Security Advisor, the Director of National Intelligence, and the Secretary of Defence. The commission also asked the U.S. Secretary of State to conduct Track 1.5 and Track 2 dialogues and tabletop exercises with Indian counterparts on the political and security implications of succession scenarios. The Commission also wanted the U.S. to coordinate with allies and partners on a diplomatic response that denies international legitimacy to any successor selected by China.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: It also wanted the U.S. to counter succession-related influence operations by strengthening the Central Tibetan Administration’s cybersecurity and resilience against China’s cyber and artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled disinformation campaigns.

articles.title: Bisleri says it’s water ‘safe for consumption’ after FSSAI sanctions prosecution, says it has received no notice
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The company said five of six samples collected from its Goa facility in September 2025 met applicable standards, while an independent test found the bromate level in the disputed sample within the prescribed limit

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Bisleri International has maintained that its packaged drinking water is safe for consumption, disputing the findings of the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI), which has sanctioned prosecution against the company after a water sample was declared unsafe following laboratory tests. In a statement issued on Monday (November 23, 2026), the company said the matter related to a batch manufactured in September 2025 at its Goa facility, one of 143 plants in its network, and dated back about 14 months. Bisleri said the FSSAI collected six samples from the facility on September 30, 2025, of which five met all applicable standards. The sixth sample recorded a bromate level of 12 micrograms per litre, against the prescribed limit of 10 micrograms per litre. Following an appeal by the company on November 22, 2025, the FSSAI referred the sample to a referral laboratory for retesting. Bisleri said the referral laboratory found the bromate level to be within the prescribed limit, but separately flagged the presence of polynuclear aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs). The findings came after the initial laboratory examination had found the sample non-compliant with the prescribed bromate limits, and declared it unsafe under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. The referral laboratory also declared the sample unsafe, citing the detection of PAHs. Based on the laboratory findings, the FSSAI subsequently sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri. Questioning the differing test results, Bisleri said the difference between the two sets of findings raised questions that it believed warranted clarification. The company said it arranged for the same sample to be tested independently at an FSSAI-approved laboratory, where the bromate level was also found to be within the prescribed limit. Bisleri said it submitted the independent test results to the FSSAI’s Western Regional Office along with a formal letter dated February 2, 2026. “We received no further communication from FSSAI after that submission and understood the matter to be closed. To date, Bisleri has received no notice by email or in hard copy and has been unable to locate the reported notice on FSSAI’s website,” a company spokesperson said. The company’s management is deciding on the next steps, the spokesperson said. The company said it maintained stringent quality controls, including more than 90 tests across its 10-step manufacturing process. It added that it would continue to cooperate with the FSSAI and address the matter through the appropriate regulatory process.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: water / food safety / health / India / drinking water / health and hygiene

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #27 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Bisleri says it’s water ‘safe for consumption’ after FSSAI sanctions prosecution, says it has received no notice

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 11:40:09 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The company said five of six samples collected from its Goa facility in September 2025 met applicable standards, while an independent test found the bromate level in the disputed sample within the prescribed limit

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Bisleri International has maintained that its packaged drinking water is safe for consumption, disputing the findings of the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI), which has sanctioned prosecution against the company after a water sample was declared unsafe following laboratory tests. In a statement issued on Monday (November 23, 2026), the company said the matter related to a batch manufactured in September 2025 at its Goa facility, one of 143 plants in its network, and dated back about 14 months. Bisleri said the FSSAI collected six samples from the facility on September 30, 2025, of which five met all applicable standards. The sixth sample recorded a bromate level of 12 micrograms per litre, against the prescribed limit of 10 micrograms per litre. Following an appeal by the company on November 22, 2025, the FSSAI referred the sample to a referral laboratory for retesting. Bisleri said the referral laboratory found the bromate level to be within the prescribed limit, but separately flagged the presence of polynuclear aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs). The findings came after the initial laboratory examination had found the sample non-compliant with the prescribed bromate limits, and declared it unsafe under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. The referral laboratory also declared the sample unsafe, citing the detection of PAHs. Based on the laboratory findings, the FSSAI subsequently sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri. Questioning the differing test results, Bisleri said the difference between the two sets of findings raised questions that it believed warranted clarification. The company said it arranged for the same sample to be tested independently at an FSSAI-approved laboratory, where the bromate level was also found to be within the prescribed limit. Bisleri said it submitted the independent test results to the FSSAI’s Western Regional Office along with a formal letter dated February 2, 2026. “We received no further communication from FSSAI after that submission and understood the matter to be closed. To date, Bisleri has received no notice by email or in hard copy and has been unable to locate the reported notice on FSSAI’s website,” a company spokesperson said. The company’s management is deciding on the next steps, the spokesperson said. The company said it maintained stringent quality controls, including more than 90 tests across its 10-step manufacturing process. It added that it would continue to cooperate with the FSSAI and address the matter through the appropriate regulatory process.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: water / food safety / health / India / drinking water / health and hygiene

articles.title: What is the HPV vaccine’s role in preventing cervical cancer?
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The HPV vaccine is not used to cure cancer; it also does not cure HPV if it is present. What it does, is ensure that some of the most detrimental types of HPV do not enter and infect the body in the first place

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: When discussing cervical cancer, what often gets left out is that it is one of the most preventable of cancers. Despite this, cervical cancer continues to be a cause of thousands of deaths among women every year, not only in India, but in many parts of the world. In many such cases, the condition is detected far too late, leaving limited room for intervention. The issue therefore, is not a gap in science, but a gap in awareness

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The main culprit in cervical cancer is a virus that is very common, human papillomavirus, or HPV for short. HPV primarily spreads through close skin-to-skin contact, most often during sexual intercourse. The virus is so widespread that virtually everyone, both men and women, at some point in their lifetime, will be infected without even realising it. More often than not, the immune system gets rid of the virus without causing any damage.

hinglishTracks.en: Despite this, cervical cancer continues to be a cause of thousands of deaths among women every year, not only in India, but in many parts of the world.

hinglishTracks.en: The issue therefore, is not a gap in science, but a gap in awareness

hinglishTracks.en: HPV primarily spreads through close skin-to-skin contact, most often during sexual intercourse.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — एचपीवी मुख्य रूप से त्वचा से त्वचा के निकट संपर्क से फैलता है, अधिकतर संभोग के दौरान।।

hinglishTracks.en: The virus is so widespread that virtually everyone, both men and women, at some point in their lifetime, will be infected without even realising it.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — यह वायरस इतना व्यापक है कि लगभग हर कोई, पुरुष और महिला दोनों, अपने जीवनकाल में किसी न किसी समय इससे संक्रमित हो जाएंगे और उन्हें इसका एहसास भी नहीं होगा।।

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — अक्सर, प्रतिरक्षा प्रणाली बिना कोई नुकसान पहुंचाए वायरस से छुटकारा पा लेती है।।

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #30 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 What is the HPV vaccine’s role in preventing cervical cancer?

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 10:46:09 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The HPV vaccine is not used to cure cancer; it also does not cure HPV if it is present. What it does, is ensure that some of the most detrimental types of HPV do not enter and infect the body in the first place

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: When discussing cervical cancer, what often gets left out is that it is one of the most preventable of cancers. Despite this, cervical cancer continues to be a cause of thousands of deaths among women every year, not only in India, but in many parts of the world. In many such cases, the condition is detected far too late, leaving limited room for intervention. The issue therefore, is not a gap in science, but a gap in awareness

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The main culprit in cervical cancer is a virus that is very common, human papillomavirus, or HPV for short. HPV primarily spreads through close skin-to-skin contact, most often during sexual intercourse. The virus is so widespread that virtually everyone, both men and women, at some point in their lifetime, will be infected without even realising it. More often than not, the immune system gets rid of the virus without causing any damage.

articles.title: U.S. seeks answers on Nvidia's sale of chips to China, Treasury ​Secretary says
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Friday that he ⁠would like to see Jensen Huang apologise and return to Nvidia

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The U.S. is seeking ​answers from Nvidia on its chip sales to China and will ‌find out who was in charge of compliance ​at the company formerly led by Jensen Huang, ⁠who resigned following an affair with a suspected Chinese spy, US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Sunday. “We’ve been in touch ‌with the temporary management, with the lead directors, with their lawyers, and we do need ‌answers.... It behooves Nvidia to move quickly on this ‌because ⁠we want to know what the culture was,” ⁠Bessent told the CBS programme “Face the Nation.” Reports about Huang’s relationship with a woman whom U.S. intelligence suspects of being a Chinese spy and ​his extramarital affair with ‌a company executive led to his resignation and investigations by U.S. regulators and the FBI, congressional action, an internal review and a proposed investor class-action lawsuit. Days after Huang’s ‌resignation, U.S. President Donald Trump’s administration issued a rule ​to further restrict China’s access to advanced AI chips from companies like Nvidia, tightening controls ahead ⁠of Trump’s trip to China last week for talks with President Xi Jinping. Mr. Bessent said the chipmaker’s board of directors ‌is working to determine what had happened, and he expressed confidence that it would “come up with some very fulsome and robust answers.” “We do need to see who was in charge of compliance there,” Bessent said. “We will see which level of the business knew about this. ‌Was it at the lower levels? Was it at the ​middle level? Did it go all the way to the top?” Mr. Trump said on Friday that he ⁠would like to see Huang apologise and return to Nvidia. ⁠Asked whether he agreed with Trump, Mr. Bessent said more information is needed. “I think we have to ‌see where the buck stops,” Mr. Bessent said.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Nvidia board Chairman Harvey Jones has said the board will not ​rehire Huang.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #28 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 U.S. seeks answers on Nvidia's sale of chips to China, Treasury ​Secretary says

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 10:43:36 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Friday that he ⁠would like to see Jensen Huang apologise and return to Nvidia

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The U.S. is seeking ​answers from Nvidia on its chip sales to China and will ‌find out who was in charge of compliance ​at the company formerly led by Jensen Huang, ⁠who resigned following an affair with a suspected Chinese spy, US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Sunday. “We’ve been in touch ‌with the temporary management, with the lead directors, with their lawyers, and we do need ‌answers.... It behooves Nvidia to move quickly on this ‌because ⁠we want to know what the culture was,” ⁠Bessent told the CBS programme “Face the Nation.” Reports about Huang’s relationship with a woman whom U.S. intelligence suspects of being a Chinese spy and ​his extramarital affair with ‌a company executive led to his resignation and investigations by U.S. regulators and the FBI, congressional action, an internal review and a proposed investor class-action lawsuit. Days after Huang’s ‌resignation, U.S. President Donald Trump’s administration issued a rule ​to further restrict China’s access to advanced AI chips from companies like Nvidia, tightening controls ahead ⁠of Trump’s trip to China last week for talks with President Xi Jinping. Mr. Bessent said the chipmaker’s board of directors ‌is working to determine what had happened, and he expressed confidence that it would “come up with some very fulsome and robust answers.” “We do need to see who was in charge of compliance there,” Bessent said. “We will see which level of the business knew about this. ‌Was it at the lower levels? Was it at the ​middle level? Did it go all the way to the top?” Mr. Trump said on Friday that he ⁠would like to see Huang apologise and return to Nvidia. ⁠Asked whether he agreed with Trump, Mr. Bessent said more information is needed. “I think we have to ‌see where the buck stops,” Mr. Bessent said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Nvidia board Chairman Harvey Jones has said the board will not ​rehire Huang.

articles.title: Keralam cracks down on unsafe cosmetics after teen’s kidney disease
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Statewide inspections under Operation Soundarya on Sunday led to the seizure of fake cosmetic products worth more than ₹10 lakh. Teen’s plight prompts complaints from others citing health problems after using similar products

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The State government has stepped up action against illegal and unsafe cosmetics following reports of a 17-year-old girl from Areekode developing kidney disease after using a mercury-laced fairness cream. Statewide inspections under Operation Soundarya on Sunday led to the seizure of fake cosmetic products worth more than ₹10 lakh. The Drugs Control department has also seized perfumes containing methanol and initiated action against products that violate cosmetic safety rules. The department said inspections would continue in the coming days. Health Minister K. Muraleedharan warned of strict action against the sale of fairness creams containing excessive mercury. The government is also considering special inspection teams in all districts. The crackdown follows the case of the higher secondary girl from Areekode, who developed membranous nephropathy, a kidney disease, after using a cream called F Tune for nearly a year. She bought the product after seeing promotions by social media influencers, particularly on Instagram. She ordered it through WhatsApp after being told that it could remove pimples, dark spots, and pigmentation. Laboratory tests reportedly found 1.25% mercury, or 12,500 parts per million (ppm), in the cream. The permitted limit is less than 1 ppm. The girl developed swelling in her legs, fainting spells, low blood pressure and difficulty in walking. Doctors also found that she was losing excessive amounts of protein through urine. She has since recovered from the critical stage following treatment. The girl said she first learned about the cream after seeing classmates use it. Its packaging listed ingredients such as turmeric but did not provide manufacturer or licence details. She said she would not have used it had she known it contained mercury. She has urged other users to stop using the product. Her family has handed over the cream’s details and medical records to the police and plans to approach the consumer court. The police launched an investigation and collected details of the product for further examination. Criminal action against the manufacturers and distributors is being considered. The cream’s Instagram page, which had been promoted by several influencers, is no longer available. The incident has also prompted complaints from others who say they experienced health problems after using similar products. Mappilapattu singer Saleem Kodathoor said that he too developed membranous nephropathy after using a similar fairness cream. He said the illness forced him to suspend music programmes for months.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The State Commission for Protection of Child Rights has filed a case and sought reports from the Health department, police and drugs controller. The Chief Minister’s Office has directed the Health department to examine measures to prevent the sale of mercury-containing creams and strengthen inspections.

Laboratory tests reportedly found 1.25% mercury, or 12,500 parts per million (ppm), in the cream. The permitted limit is less than 1 ppm. The girl developed swelling in her legs, fainting spells, low blood pressure and difficulty in walking. Doctors also found that she was losing excessive amounts of protein through urine. She has since recovered from the critical stage following treatment. The girl said she first learned about the cream after seeing classmates use it. Its packaging listed ingredients such as turmeric but did not provide manufacturer or licence details. She said she would not have used it had she known it contained mercury. She has urged other users to stop using the product. Her family has handed over the cream’s details and medical records to the police and plans to approach the consumer court. The police launched an investigation and collected details of the product for further examination. Criminal action against the manufacturers and distributors is being considered. The cream’s Instagram page, which had been promoted by several influencers, is no longer available. The incident has also prompted complaints from others who say they experienced health problems after using similar products. Mappilapattu singer Saleem Kodathoor said that he too developed membranous nephropathy after using a similar fairness cream. He said the illness forced him to suspend music programmes for months.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The State Commission for Protection of Child Rights has filed a case and sought reports from the Health department, police and drugs controller. The Chief Minister’s Office has directed the Health department to examine measures to prevent the sale of mercury-containing creams and strengthen inspections.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #29 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Keralam cracks down on unsafe cosmetics after teen’s kidney disease

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 10:39:45 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Statewide inspections under Operation Soundarya on Sunday led to the seizure of fake cosmetic products worth more than ₹10 lakh. Teen’s plight prompts complaints from others citing health problems after using similar products

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The State government has stepped up action against illegal and unsafe cosmetics following reports of a 17-year-old girl from Areekode developing kidney disease after using a mercury-laced fairness cream. Statewide inspections under Operation Soundarya on Sunday led to the seizure of fake cosmetic products worth more than ₹10 lakh. The Drugs Control department has also seized perfumes containing methanol and initiated action against products that violate cosmetic safety rules. The department said inspections would continue in the coming days. Health Minister K. Muraleedharan warned of strict action against the sale of fairness creams containing excessive mercury. The government is also considering special inspection teams in all districts. The crackdown follows the case of the higher secondary girl from Areekode, who developed membranous nephropathy, a kidney disease, after using a cream called F Tune for nearly a year. She bought the product after seeing promotions by social media influencers, particularly on Instagram. She ordered it through WhatsApp after being told that it could remove pimples, dark spots, and pigmentation. Laboratory tests reportedly found 1.25% mercury, or 12,500 parts per million (ppm), in the cream. The permitted limit is less than 1 ppm. The girl developed swelling in her legs, fainting spells, low blood pressure and difficulty in walking. Doctors also found that she was losing excessive amounts of protein through urine. She has since recovered from the critical stage following treatment. The girl said she first learned about the cream after seeing classmates use it. Its packaging listed ingredients such as turmeric but did not provide manufacturer or licence details. She said she would not have used it had she known it contained mercury. She has urged other users to stop using the product. Her family has handed over the cream’s details and medical records to the police and plans to approach the consumer court. The police launched an investigation and collected details of the product for further examination. Criminal action against the manufacturers and distributors is being considered. The cream’s Instagram page, which had been promoted by several influencers, is no longer available. The incident has also prompted complaints from others who say they experienced health problems after using similar products. Mappilapattu singer Saleem Kodathoor said that he too developed membranous nephropathy after using a similar fairness cream. He said the illness forced him to suspend music programmes for months.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The State Commission for Protection of Child Rights has filed a case and sought reports from the Health department, police and drugs controller. The Chief Minister’s Office has directed the Health department to examine measures to prevent the sale of mercury-containing creams and strengthen inspections.

Examination (Noun)
परीक्षा — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Examination' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Department (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Department' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Keralam cracks down on unsafe cosmetics after te' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.

D. The author contends that 'Keralam cracks down on unsafe cosmetics after' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Keralam cracks down on unsafe cosmetics after teen’s kidney disease"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. The Chief Minister’s Office has directed the Health department to examine measures to prevent the sale of mercury-containing creams and strengthen...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The Chief Minister’s Office has directed the Health department to examine measures to prevent the sale of mercury-containing creams and strengthen..." (Hinglish Arth: मुख्यमंत्री कार्यालय ने स्वास्थ्य विभाग को पारा युक्त क्रीम की बिक्री को रोकने के उपायों की जांच करने और निरीक्षण को मजबूत करने का निर्देश दिया है।)

articles.title: Karnataka plans to start two new medical colleges in Ramangara and Puttur next academic year
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Medical Education Minister Sharan Prakash Patil says, ‘We will apply to the National Medical Commission to start these colleges from 2027-28 with a capacity of at least 50 seats.’

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Department of Medical Education is preparing to start two new government medical colleges in Ramanagara of Bengaluru South District and Puttur of Dakshina Kannada District for the academic year of 2027-28, and a proposal will be submitted to the National Medical Commission (NMC) soon. “The construction work for the medical college on the Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences (RGUHS) new campus in Ramanagara is progressing rapidly. The tender for the medical college in Puttur has been finalised, and the construction will commence shortly. We will apply to the NMC to start these colleges from 2027-28 with a capacity of at least 50 seats,” Medical Education Minister Sharan Prakash Patil said. “There is also a proposal to start medical colleges in Vijayapura and Kolar districts. The cabinet will decide on that soon,” he added. The government has decided to start a medical college in every district of the State. There are 25 now. If colleges are established in Ramanagara, Puttur, Vijayapura, and Kolar districts, only Tumakuru, Bengaluru Rural, and Udupi districts will have to have a government medical college of their own. Currently, there are 76 medical colleges in the State, comprising 25 government and 51 private institutions, with a total of 15,745 seats available for the 2026-27 academic year. If the Ramanagara and Puttur colleges are approved for the next academic year, with 50 seats each, this will go up to 78 colleges with 15,845 seats. The NMC has rejected the State’s applications for starting medical colleges in Kanakapura and Ramanagara four times from 2023-24 to 2026-27, for want of infrastructure, including teaching and non-teaching staff. Will the commission approve the proposals this year at least is the moot question. In this context, the State government decided to construct a medical college and hospital in Kanakapura at an estimated cost of about ₹550 crore, and the construction work is in progress. However, the work of the medical college planned to be built on the proposed Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences (RGUHS) campus in Ramanagara is only 70% complete. Therefore, the government has decided to start the medical college using the district hospital.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “The construction of medical college on the RGUHS new campus in Ramanagara will be completed soon. Consequently, steps have been taken to shift the university to the new campus within the next three to four months. Meanwhile, the construction of a medical college and hospital in Kanakapura is progressing rapidly, and once the work is complete, a proposal will be submitted to the MNC for the commencement of the college,” Mr. Patil said.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #30 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Karnataka plans to start two new medical colleges in Ramangara and Puttur next academic year

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 10:37:55 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Medical Education Minister Sharan Prakash Patil says, ‘We will apply to the National Medical Commission to start these colleges from 2027-28 with a capacity of at least 50 seats.’

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Department of Medical Education is preparing to start two new government medical colleges in Ramanagara of Bengaluru South District and Puttur of Dakshina Kannada District for the academic year of 2027-28, and a proposal will be submitted to the National Medical Commission (NMC) soon. “The construction work for the medical college on the Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences (RGUHS) new campus in Ramanagara is progressing rapidly. The tender for the medical college in Puttur has been finalised, and the construction will commence shortly. We will apply to the NMC to start these colleges from 2027-28 with a capacity of at least 50 seats,” Medical Education Minister Sharan Prakash Patil said. “There is also a proposal to start medical colleges in Vijayapura and Kolar districts. The cabinet will decide on that soon,” he added. The government has decided to start a medical college in every district of the State. There are 25 now. If colleges are established in Ramanagara, Puttur, Vijayapura, and Kolar districts, only Tumakuru, Bengaluru Rural, and Udupi districts will have to have a government medical college of their own. Currently, there are 76 medical colleges in the State, comprising 25 government and 51 private institutions, with a total of 15,745 seats available for the 2026-27 academic year. If the Ramanagara and Puttur colleges are approved for the next academic year, with 50 seats each, this will go up to 78 colleges with 15,845 seats. The NMC has rejected the State’s applications for starting medical colleges in Kanakapura and Ramanagara four times from 2023-24 to 2026-27, for want of infrastructure, including teaching and non-teaching staff. Will the commission approve the proposals this year at least is the moot question. In this context, the State government decided to construct a medical college and hospital in Kanakapura at an estimated cost of about ₹550 crore, and the construction work is in progress. However, the work of the medical college planned to be built on the proposed Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences (RGUHS) campus in Ramanagara is only 70% complete. Therefore, the government has decided to start the medical college using the district hospital.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “The construction of medical college on the RGUHS new campus in Ramanagara will be completed soon. Consequently, steps have been taken to shift the university to the new campus within the next three to four months. Meanwhile, the construction of a medical college and hospital in Kanakapura is progressing rapidly, and once the work is complete, a proposal will be submitted to the MNC for the commencement of the college,” Mr. Patil said.

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: Medical Education Minister Sharan Prakash Patil says, ‘We will apply to the National Medical Commission to start these colleges from 2027-28 with a capacity of at least 50 seats.’
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Department of Medical Education is preparing to start two new government medical colleges in Ramanagara of Bengaluru South District and Puttur of Dakshina Kannada District for the academic year of 2027-28, and a proposal will be submitted to the National Medical Commission (NMC) soon. “The construction work for the medical college on the Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences (RGUHS) new campus in Ramanagara is progressing rapidly. The tender for the medical college in Puttur has been finalised, and the construction will commence shortly. We will apply to the NMC to start these colleges from 2027-28 with a capacity of at least 50 seats,” Medical Education Minister Sharan Prakash Patil said. “There is also a proposal to start medical colleges in Vijayapura and Kolar districts. The cabinet will decide on that soon,” he added. The government has decided to start a medical college in every district of the State. There are 25 now. If colleges are established in Ramanagara, Puttur, Vijayapura, and Kolar districts, only Tumakuru, Bengaluru Rural, and Udupi districts will have to have a government medical college of their own. Currently, there are 76 medical colleges in the State, comprising 25 government and 51 private institutions, with a total of 15,745 seats available for the 2026-27 academic year. If the Ramanagara and Puttur colleges are approved for the next academic year, with 50 seats each, this will go up to 78 colleges with 15,845 seats. The NMC has rejected the State’s applications for starting medical colleges in Kanakapura and Ramanagara four times from 2023-24 to 2026-27, for want of infrastructure, including teaching and non-teaching staff. Will the commission approve the proposals this year at least is the moot question. In this context, the State government decided to construct a medical college and hospital in Kanakapura at an estimated cost of about ₹550 crore, and the construction work is in progress. However, the work of the medical college planned to be built on the proposed Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences (RGUHS) campus in Ramanagara is only 70% complete. Therefore, the government has decided to start the medical college using the district hospital.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “The construction of medical college on the RGUHS new campus in Ramanagara will be completed soon. Consequently, steps have been taken to shift the university to the new campus within the next three to four months. Meanwhile, the construction of a medical college and hospital in Kanakapura is progressing rapidly, and once the work is complete, a proposal will be submitted to the MNC for the commencement of the college,” Mr. Patil said.

articles.title: Bengaluru Namma Metro records 12.29% growth in ridership; fare revenue jumps 49% to ₹1,125 crore

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The annual report also highlighted the contribution of multiple digital ticketing options, including tokens, Smart Cards, QR tickets, National Common Mobility Cards (NCMC) and other digital payment platforms, towards improving passenger convenience and reducing transaction time at Metro stations.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The corporation recorded 310.49 million passenger journeys during 2025–26, compared with 276.51 million in the previous financial year. The average daily ridership increased to 8.51 lakh passengers from 7.57 lakh, registering a growth of 12.42%. Namma Metro also recorded its highest-ever single-day ridership of 10.82 lakh passengers on August 14, 2025. On the same day, fare-box revenue reached ₹4.58 crore, setting a new single-day record for the corporation. ALSO WATCH Namma Metro Pink Line: Will it ease traffic congestion? | Decode Karnataka The increase in passenger numbers translated into higher ticket revenue. BMRCL generated ₹1,125.58 crore through fare-box collections during 2025–26, compared with ₹753.59 crore in 2024–25, marking a growth of 49.36%. Non-fare revenue also witnessed significant growth, increasing to ₹88.51 crore from ₹54.97 crore in the previous financial year, registering a rise of 61.02%, according to the annual report. The corporation attributed the growth in fare-box collections primarily to higher passenger ridership following the commissioning of the 19.15-km Reach-5 Yellow Line between RV Road and Bommasandra in August 2025. BMRCL reported that trains operated with a punctuality rate of 99.85% during the financial year. Services commenced at 5 a.m. on Mondays to cater to passengers travelling early in the morning, while the last train services operated until 11.30 pm. The corporation also reported an operational profit of ₹417.42 crore and a cash profit of ₹209.66 crore during 2025–26. According to the report, the expenditure during the year, excluding depreciation and finance costs, stood at ₹823.69 crore.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The annual report highlighted the contribution of tokens, Smart Cards, QR tickets, National Common Mobility Cards (NCMC) and other digital payment platforms, towards improving passenger convenience and reducing transaction time at Metro stations. | Photo Credit: The Hindu

📰 Bengaluru Namma Metro records 12.29% growth in ridership; fare revenue jumps 49% to ₹1,125 crore

🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The annual report also highlighted the contribution of multiple digital ticketing options, including tokens, Smart Cards, QR tickets, National Common Mobility Cards (NCMC) and other digital payment platforms, towards improving passenger convenience and reducing transaction time at Metro stations.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The corporation recorded 310.49 million passenger journeys during 2025–26, compared with 276.51 million in the previous financial year. The average daily ridership increased to 8.51 lakh passengers from 7.57 lakh, registering a growth of 12.42%. Namma Metro also recorded its highest-ever single-day ridership of 10.82 lakh passengers on August 14, 2025. On the same day, fare-box revenue reached ₹4.58 crore, setting a new single-day record for the corporation. ALSO WATCH Namma Metro Pink Line: Will it ease traffic congestion? | Decode Karnataka The increase in passenger numbers translated into higher ticket revenue. BMRCL generated ₹1,125.58 crore through fare-box collections during 2025–26, compared with ₹753.59 crore in 2024–25, marking a growth of 49.36%. Non-fare revenue also witnessed significant growth, increasing to ₹88.51 crore from ₹54.97 crore in the previous financial year, registering a rise of 61.02%, according to the annual report. The corporation attributed the growth in fare-box collections primarily to higher passenger ridership following the commissioning of the 19.15-km Reach-5 Yellow Line between RV Road and Bommasandra in August 2025. BMRCL reported that trains operated with a punctuality rate of 99.85% during the financial year. Services commenced at 5 a.m. on Mondays to cater to passengers travelling early in the morning, while the last train services operated until 11.30 pm. The corporation also reported an operational profit of ₹417.42 crore and a cash profit of ₹209.66 crore during 2025–26. According to the report, the expenditure during the year, excluding depreciation and finance costs, stood at ₹823.69 crore.

articles.title: Supreme Court bars Tamil Nadu government from coercive action against SASTRA University over land dispute
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: A Bench headed by CJI Surya Kant made absolute its interim order staying any coercive measures over 31.37 acres of government land allegedly encroached upon by the Thanjavur university

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Supreme Court on Monday (November 23, 2026) admitted an appeal filed by Shanmugha Arts Science Technology and Research Academy (SASTRA), a deemed university based in Thanjavur, against a Madras High Court direction to the Tamil Nadu government to evict it from 31.37 acres of public land in its occupation for nearly 40 years. The Court had already stayed the eviction of the university in an order passed on January 15, 2026, and had allowed the institution to carry out its activities without any hindrance. At that hearing, the Court asked the State government to consider three options of alternative lands offered by the university, instead of the land occupied and already utilised by it, represented by senior advocate Mukul Rohatgi. A Bench headed by Chief Justice of India Surya Kant had found the three options “just and fair”, and asked the State to consider the offer “sympathetically and take an appropriate decision by ensuring that no loss is caused to the public exchequer”. It also suggested that a high-powered committee of three senior officers of the State government accord a personal hearing to the university to “explain all the attending circumstances and also to persuade the authorities to accept one of the three options”. On August 10, 2026, the Court gave the State, represented by senior advocate Jaideep Gupta and Tamil Nadu Additional Advocate General Haripriya Padmanabhan, a “free hand in determining the actual market value of land” under dispute, with the university obligated to pay. The August order also recorded the university’s offer to pay the sale price of any land the State required for a public purpose, in this case the establishment of a prison, for which it wanted the disputed 31.37-acre property. The Court asked the State to take a “reasonably fair decision and apprise this court”. However, at the next hearing on September 21, 2026, the State sought more time to “consider the different options”. At the September 21 hearing, the Court noted that the land in dispute was used by an educational institution serving a public purpose, and asked why the State was so “obstinate” on eviction and demolition of the institution.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The State government had contended that the alternate parcels were inferior to the disputed land in terms of value, accessibility and contiguity, and that settling for alternative land could amount to putting a premium on encroachment.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #8 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Supreme Court bars Tamil Nadu government from coercive action against SASTRA University over land dispute

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 01:25:23 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: A Bench headed by CJI Surya Kant made absolute its interim order staying any coercive measures over 31.37 acres of government land allegedly encroached upon by the Thanjavur university

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Supreme Court on Monday (November 23, 2026) admitted an appeal filed by Shanmugha Arts Science Technology and Research Academy (SASTRA), a deemed university based in Thanjavur, against a Madras High Court direction to the Tamil Nadu government to evict it from 31.37 acres of public land in its occupation for nearly 40 years. The Court had already stayed the eviction of the university in an order passed on January 15, 2026, and had allowed the institution to carry out its activities without any hindrance. At that hearing, the Court asked the State government to consider three options of alternative lands offered by the university, instead of the land occupied and already utilised by it, represented by senior advocate Mukul Rohatgi. A Bench headed by Chief Justice of India Surya Kant had found the three options “just and fair”, and asked the State to consider the offer “sympathetically and take an appropriate decision by ensuring that no loss is caused to the public exchequer”. It also suggested that a high-powered committee of three senior officers of the State government accord a personal hearing to the university to “explain all the attending circumstances and also to persuade the authorities to accept one of the three options”. On August 10, 2026, the Court gave the State, represented by senior advocate Jaideep Gupta and Tamil Nadu Additional Advocate General Haripriya Padmanabhan, a “free hand in determining the actual market value of land” under dispute, with the university obligated to pay. The August order also recorded the university’s offer to pay the sale price of any land the State required for a public purpose, in this case the establishment of a prison, for which it wanted the disputed 31.37-acre property. The Court asked the State to take a “reasonably fair decision and apprise this court”. However, at the next hearing on September 21, 2026, the State sought more time to “consider the different options”. At the September 21 hearing, the Court noted that the land in dispute was used by an educational institution serving a public purpose, and asked why the State was so “obstinate” on eviction and demolition of the institution.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The State government had contended that the alternate parcels were inferior to the disputed land in terms of value, accessibility and contiguity, and that settling for alternative land could amount to putting a premium on encroachment.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Institutional (Adjective)
संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।
✓ Syn: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional  |  ✖ Ant: Individual, Informal, Unorganized
Establishment (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Establishment' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Accessibility (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Accessibility' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Encroachment (Adjective)
अतिक्रमण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Encroachment' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Supreme Court bars Tamil Nadu government from coercive action against SASTRA University over land dispute", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. A Bench headed by CJI Surya Kant made absolute its interim order staying any coercive measures over 31.37 acres of government land allegedly...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Supreme Court bars Tamil Nadu government from co' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Supreme Court bars Tamil Nadu government from' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Supreme Court bars Tamil Nadu government from' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "A Bench headed by CJI Surya Kant made absolute its interim order staying any coercive measures over 31.37 acres of government land allegedly..." (Hinglish Arth: सीजेआई सूर्यकांत की अध्यक्षता वाली पीठ ने तंजावुर विश्वविद्यालय द्वारा कथित रूप से अतिक्रमण की गई 31.37 एकड़ सरकारी भूमि पर किसी भी कठोर कदम पर रोक लगाने के अपने अंतरिम आदेश को निरस्त कर दिया।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Supreme Court bars Tamil Nadu government from coercive action against SASTRA University over land dispute"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. The State government had contended that the alternate parcels were inferior to the disputed land in terms of value, accessibility and contiguity, and...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The State government had contended that the alternate parcels were inferior to the disputed land in terms of value, accessibility and contiguity, and..." (Hinglish Arth: राज्य सरकार ने तर्क दिया था कि वैकल्पिक भूखंड मूल्य, पहुंच और निकटता के मामले में विवादित भूमि से कमतर थे, और वैकल्पिक भूमि के लिए निपटान का मतलब उस पर प्रीमियम लगाना हो सकता है।)
