🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Transgender persons to be roped in for tax collection in West Bengal

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 03:12:49 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: West Bengal Minister Agnimitra Paul launches a programme to provide dignified, alternative livelihoods to trans persons

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The West Bengal government will engage transgender persons to collect municipal tax and spread traffic awareness. Urban Development and Municipal Affairs Minister Agnimitra Paul said the initiative, called “Brihannala Brigade”, will provide an opportunity for a dignified livelihood for the transpersons. “The CM wishes that they (transgender people no) longer have to resort to begging at traffic signals; instead, we want to offer them an alternative, respectable livelihood. We have decided that those among them who are interested will receive training from the police and be deployed at traffic signals. Their role will be to sensitise the public about traffic rules and safety measures,” Ms. Paul said on Thursday (November 19, 2026). She further added that another group of transgender persons would be trained to collect outstanding taxes, which could help address the staff shortage that leads to delayed collections and large pending amounts. The Minister also added that each of these transgender individuals will be provided with training to engage in this work so that they can conduct better public interaction and do their work seamlessly. They will receive a stipend for the work, Ms. Paul said. The West Bengal government has started an initiative to offer relief in paying outstanding property taxes, including in the actual sums and interest, to encourage defaulters to pay their outstanding balances. According to Kolkata Municipal Corporation estimates, they have around ₹6800 crore outstanding property tax pending, including personal properties, mixed-use properties, and commercial properties.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In 2022, the previous Mamata Banerjee government decided to allow transgender persons to apply for government jobs under the general category to help them have better opportunities in employment. A Transgender Development Board was set up in 2017, but the board could not undertake many activities for the welfare of members of the community. The last census carried out in the state in 2011 put the number of transgender people in the state at 30,349. The actual number of people of the third gender may be higher, several groups working for the community say.

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: West Bengal Minister Agnimitra Paul launches a programme to provide dignified, alternative livelihoods to trans persons
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The West Bengal government will engage transgender persons to collect municipal tax and spread traffic awareness. Urban Development and Municipal Affairs Minister Agnimitra Paul said the initiative, called “Brihannala Brigade”, will provide an opportunity for a dignified livelihood for the transpersons. “The CM wishes that they (transgender people no) longer have to resort to begging at traffic signals; instead, we want to offer them an alternative, respectable livelihood. We have decided that those among them who are interested will receive training from the police and be deployed at traffic signals. Their role will be to sensitise the public about traffic rules and safety measures,” Ms. Paul said on Thursday (November 19, 2026). She further added that another group of transgender persons would be trained to collect outstanding taxes, which could help address the staff shortage that leads to delayed collections and large pending amounts. The Minister also added that each of these transgender individuals will be provided with training to engage in this work so that they can conduct better public interaction and do their work seamlessly. They will receive a stipend for the work, Ms. Paul said. The West Bengal government has started an initiative to offer relief in paying outstanding property taxes, including in the actual sums and interest, to encourage defaulters to pay their outstanding balances. According to Kolkata Municipal Corporation estimates, they have around ₹6800 crore outstanding property tax pending, including personal properties, mixed-use properties, and commercial properties.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In 2022, the previous Mamata Banerjee government decided to allow transgender persons to apply for government jobs under the general category to help them have better opportunities in employment. A Transgender Development Board was set up in 2017, but the board could not undertake many activities for the welfare of members of the community. The last census carried out in the state in 2011 put the number of transgender people in the state at 30,349. The actual number of people of the third gender may be higher, several groups working for the community say.

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Attappady’s recurring infant deaths this year point to a crisis that goes beyond malnutrition and access to timely healthcare. Poverty, land alienation, and the erosion of traditional food systems, are taking a toll on maternal and child health in this predominantly tribal region of Keralam

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Between the pages of a logbook recording Dakshina’s treatment are ₹100, ₹50, ₹20, and ₹10 notes. Dakshina’s mother, Minnal Rani, had filed them away for her daughter’s medical expenses. The child is gone, but the money remains untouched. “We will never spend it,” she says, fighting back tears. Dakshina was five months old when doctors detected a hole in her heart. Born on June 13, 2025, she was taken to many hospitals, including one in Thiruvananthapuram, Keralam’s capital. With surgery ruled out, she was eventually referred to a cooperative hospital at Perinthalmanna, in Malappuram district, a two-and-a-half-hour drive away from home. She died here, on April 13, 2026. Rani and her husband Chandra Sekhar say the hospital refused to release their daughter’s body until they paid a bill of ₹10,000. They managed to raise the money with the help of a ward councillor. “We buried her under that tree,” says Rani, pointing to a coconut tree near their house at Vechapathi hamlet in Sholayur panchayat of Attappadi, Palakkad district. Dakshina’s death is among a series of 10 infant deaths reported this year from Attappadi, a predominantly tribal settlement. There have been four back-to-back deaths in October. Of the 10 infant deaths, six involved congenital anomalies, with heart defects among the commonly reported conditions. An expert committee of doctors and researchers is examining the deaths.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Ground Zero / Keralam / infants / health / government health care

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — इस वर्ष अट्टापडी में बार-बार होने वाली शिशु मृत्यु एक ऐसे संकट की ओर इशारा करती है जो कुपोषण और समय पर स्वास्थ्य देखभाल तक पहुंच से परे है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Malnutrition' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Malnutrition' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Poverty, land alienation, and the erosion of traditional food systems, are taking a toll on maternal and child health in this predominantly tribal region of Keralam
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — गरीबी, भूमि अलगाव, और पारंपरिक खाद्य प्रणालियों का क्षरण, केरलम के इस मुख्य आदिवासी क्षेत्र में मातृ एवं शिशु स्वास्थ्य पर भारी असर डाल रहा है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Traditional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Traditional' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — दक्षिणा के उपचार को रिकॉर्ड करने वाली लॉगबुक के पन्नों के बीच ₹100, ₹50, ₹20 और ₹10 के नोट हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: Dakshina’s mother, Minnal Rani, had filed them away for her daughter’s medical expenses.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — दक्षिणा की मां, मिन्नल रानी ने उन्हें अपनी बेटी के चिकित्सा खर्चों के लिए जमा कर दिया था।।

hinglishTracks.en: Born on June 13, 2025, she was taken to many hospitals, including one in Thiruvananthapuram, Keralam’s capital.

hinglishTracks.en: She died here, on April 13, 2026.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — 13 अप्रैल, 2026 को उनकी यहीं मृत्यु हो गई।।

hinglishTracks.en: Rani and her husband Chandra Sekhar say the hospital refused to release their daughter’s body until they paid a bill of ₹10,000.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — रानी और उनके पति चंद्र शेखर का कहना है कि अस्पताल ने उनकी बेटी का शव तब तक देने से इनकार कर दिया जब तक कि उन्होंने ₹10,000 का बिल नहीं चुका दिया।।

articles.title: Koti Deepotsavam emerges as grand confluence of Shaiva, Vaishnava traditions in Telangana
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Bringing together revered spiritual heads, sacred rituals and devotees from across the State, the annual celebration offers a rare opportunity to experience diverse Hindu traditions at one venue, with the illumination of a crore earthen lamps forming its grand spectacle

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A confluence of Shaiva and Vaishnava traditions, a congregation of revered spiritual heads from across the country and the illumination of a crore lamps have made Koti Deepotsavam one of Telangana’s biggest religious celebrations outside temple premises. Held every year in Kartika month, the event draws thousands of devotees from different parts of the State, not merely to witness the ceremonies but also to participate in an array of rituals that are otherwise not easily accessible to the common devotee. Koti Deepotsavam offers devotees an opportunity to perform abhishekams, offer bilva leaves to Shiva Lingams, worship the Goddess and participate in special pujas and other ceremonies. The presence of Jagadgurus and heads of prominent peethams adds another dimension, enabling devotees to seek their blessings and have their darshan, an opportunity that many may seldom get otherwise. Over the past 13 years, Koti Deepotsavam has given a distinctive identity to the month of Kartika and to Telangana. The initiative began in 2012 as a Laksha Deepotsavam, or the lighting of one lakh lamps, and the following year evolved into Koti Deepotsavam, involving a crore lamps. The idea was conceived by Narendra Chowdary and his wife Ramadevi, and daughter Rachana, who run Bhakti TV. The genesis of the initiative lay in a visit by Sringeri Dakshinamnaya Peetham Jagadguru Sri Bharati Tirtha Mahaswami to Hyderabad during his Vijaya Yatra in 2012, when Kartika Deepotsavam was combined with the darshan of the Jagadguru for the Guru Vandanam. The first edition was organised at NTR Stadium, where a specially constructed stage depicting the grandeur of Kailasa provided the setting for the celebrations. The Sringeri Jagadguru performed Deeparadhana and blessed the devotees. By 2013, the Laksha Deepotsavam had grown into Koti Deepotsavam. What began as a single religious gathering gradually developed into an elaborate annual celebration, incorporating several traditions, rituals and cultural presentations. “The objective has been to recreate the experience of visiting important pilgrimage centres by bringing the deities and their traditions together at one venue,” says Mr. Narendra Chowdary.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: A distinctive feature is the presence of utsava murtis representing important temples and pilgrimage centres. Deities associated with the 12 Jyotirlingas, Pancha Bhuta Lingas, 18 Shakti Peethas and Divya Desams of the Sri Vaishnava tradition are brought to the venue and worshipped. Shaiva centres such as Ujjain, Arunachalam, Vemulawada and Kaleshwaram find representation alongside Vaishnava shrines such as Yadadri and Srirangam, and Shakti Peethas including Alampur, Kanchi and Varanasi.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #7 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Koti Deepotsavam emerges as grand confluence of Shaiva, Vaishnava traditions in Telangana

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 07:25:05 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Bringing together revered spiritual heads, sacred rituals and devotees from across the State, the annual celebration offers a rare opportunity to experience diverse Hindu traditions at one venue, with the illumination of a crore earthen lamps forming its grand spectacle

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A confluence of Shaiva and Vaishnava traditions, a congregation of revered spiritual heads from across the country and the illumination of a crore lamps have made Koti Deepotsavam one of Telangana’s biggest religious celebrations outside temple premises. Held every year in Kartika month, the event draws thousands of devotees from different parts of the State, not merely to witness the ceremonies but also to participate in an array of rituals that are otherwise not easily accessible to the common devotee. Koti Deepotsavam offers devotees an opportunity to perform abhishekams, offer bilva leaves to Shiva Lingams, worship the Goddess and participate in special pujas and other ceremonies. The presence of Jagadgurus and heads of prominent peethams adds another dimension, enabling devotees to seek their blessings and have their darshan, an opportunity that many may seldom get otherwise. Over the past 13 years, Koti Deepotsavam has given a distinctive identity to the month of Kartika and to Telangana. The initiative began in 2012 as a Laksha Deepotsavam, or the lighting of one lakh lamps, and the following year evolved into Koti Deepotsavam, involving a crore lamps. The idea was conceived by Narendra Chowdary and his wife Ramadevi, and daughter Rachana, who run Bhakti TV. The genesis of the initiative lay in a visit by Sringeri Dakshinamnaya Peetham Jagadguru Sri Bharati Tirtha Mahaswami to Hyderabad during his Vijaya Yatra in 2012, when Kartika Deepotsavam was combined with the darshan of the Jagadguru for the Guru Vandanam. The first edition was organised at NTR Stadium, where a specially constructed stage depicting the grandeur of Kailasa provided the setting for the celebrations. The Sringeri Jagadguru performed Deeparadhana and blessed the devotees. By 2013, the Laksha Deepotsavam had grown into Koti Deepotsavam. What began as a single religious gathering gradually developed into an elaborate annual celebration, incorporating several traditions, rituals and cultural presentations. “The objective has been to recreate the experience of visiting important pilgrimage centres by bringing the deities and their traditions together at one venue,” says Mr. Narendra Chowdary.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: A distinctive feature is the presence of utsava murtis representing important temples and pilgrimage centres. Deities associated with the 12 Jyotirlingas, Pancha Bhuta Lingas, 18 Shakti Peethas and Divya Desams of the Sri Vaishnava tradition are brought to the venue and worshipped. Shaiva centres such as Ujjain, Arunachalam, Vemulawada and Kaleshwaram find representation alongside Vaishnava shrines such as Yadadri and Srirangam, and Shakti Peethas including Alampur, Kanchi and Varanasi.

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Congregation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Celebration' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।

🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Koti Deepotsavam emerges as grand confluence of Shaiva, Vaishnava traditions in Telangana", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Bringing together revered spiritual heads, sacred rituals and devotees from across the State, the annual celebration offers a rare opportunity to...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Koti Deepotsavam emerges as grand confluence of ' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Koti Deepotsavam emerges as grand confluence ' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Koti Deepotsavam emerges as grand confluence ' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Bringing together revered spiritual heads, sacred rituals and devotees from across the State, the annual celebration offers a rare opportunity to..." (Hinglish Arth: राज्य भर से श्रद्धेय आध्यात्मिक प्रमुखों, पवित्र अनुष्ठानों और भक्तों को एक साथ लाते हुए, वार्षिक उत्सव रोशनी के साथ एक ही स्थान पर विविध हिंदू परंपराओं का अनुभव करने का एक दुर्लभ अवसर प्रदान करता है।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Koti Deepotsavam emerges as grand confluence of Shaiva, Vaishnava traditions in Telangana"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Shaiva centres such as Ujjain, Arunachalam, Vemulawada and Kaleshwaram find representation alongside Vaishnava shrines such as Yadadri and Srirangam,...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Shaiva centres such as Ujjain, Arunachalam, Vemulawada and Kaleshwaram find representation alongside Vaishnava shrines such as Yadadri and Srirangam,..." (Hinglish Arth: उज्जैन, अरुणाचलम, वेमुलावाड़ा और कालेश्वरम जैसे शैव केंद्रों को यदाद्रि और श्रीरंगम जैसे वैष्णव मंदिरों और आलमपुर, कांची और वाराणसी सहित शक्ति पीठों के साथ प्रतिनिधित्व मिलता है।)

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Scientists indicate that the ongoing strong El Niño could persist until March 2027, followed by neutral conditions and a possible transition to La Niña during the Southwest Monsoon. They are also monitoring widespread marine heatwaves across the Indian Ocean

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: While the powerful El Niño continues to strengthen over the Pacific Ocean, scientists are beginning to see signs that its cooler counterpart, La Niña, could emerge by the time the Southwest Monsoon arrives in 2027.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Scientists at the Hyderabad-based Indian National Centre for Ocean Information Services (INCOIS) say the ongoing El Niño is likely to remain dominant until March next year. But, climate models indicate a gradual transition to neutral conditions thereafter, followed by increasing chances of La Niña development during the 2027 Southwest monsoon season.

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Odisha Chief Minister said heavy rainfall was expected in Mayurbhanj and Balasore over the next 24 hours, with its impact likely to extend to neighbouring Jajpur, Bhadrak, Kendrapara and Jagatsinghpur districts

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu sought central assistance of nearly ₹100 crore for the restoration of horticultural crops damaged by cyclones Arnab and Murasu. “Naidu has written a letter to Union Minister for Agriculture and Farmers Welfare Shivraj Singh Chouhan, seeking additional financial assistance for the restoration of horticulture crops damaged by two consecutive cyclones,” a press release said. The cyclones damaged crops across 29,960 hectares in 18 districts, affecting 71,576 farmers and causing losses estimated at ₹1,092 crore, he said. The cyclone had considerably lost its intensity when it made landfall near Gopalpur in Odisha. “The cyclonic storm Akvan crossed the south coastal Odisha and north Andhra Pradesh close to Gopalpur with a wind speed of 70-80 kmph, gusting to 90 kmph during 7.30 a.m. to 8.30 a.m.,” said the India Meteorological Department (IMD). Landfall of Cyclone Akvan nears Odisha and Andhra Pradesh coasts as land interaction begins, with heavy rainfall and prolonged impact anticipated. The depression is likely to move nearly northwards over Odisha and weaken further into a low-pressure area during next 6 hours, said IMD
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: cyclones / rains / Odisha / Andhra Pradesh / weather / Live news

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #8 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Cyclone 'Akvan' weakens into depression; no major damage, flood threat | LIVE

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 09:03:11 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Odisha Chief Minister said heavy rainfall was expected in Mayurbhanj and Balasore over the next 24 hours, with its impact likely to extend to neighbouring Jajpur, Bhadrak, Kendrapara and Jagatsinghpur districts

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu sought central assistance of nearly ₹100 crore for the restoration of horticultural crops damaged by cyclones Arnab and Murasu. “Naidu has written a letter to Union Minister for Agriculture and Farmers Welfare Shivraj Singh Chouhan, seeking additional financial assistance for the restoration of horticulture crops damaged by two consecutive cyclones,” a press release said. The cyclones damaged crops across 29,960 hectares in 18 districts, affecting 71,576 farmers and causing losses estimated at ₹1,092 crore, he said. The cyclone had considerably lost its intensity when it made landfall near Gopalpur in Odisha. “The cyclonic storm Akvan crossed the south coastal Odisha and north Andhra Pradesh close to Gopalpur with a wind speed of 70-80 kmph, gusting to 90 kmph during 7.30 a.m. to 8.30 a.m.,” said the India Meteorological Department (IMD). Landfall of Cyclone Akvan nears Odisha and Andhra Pradesh coasts as land interaction begins, with heavy rainfall and prolonged impact anticipated. The depression is likely to move nearly northwards over Odisha and weaken further into a low-pressure area during next 6 hours, said IMD

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: cyclones / rains / Odisha / Andhra Pradesh / weather / Live news

articles.title: India says no change in its position on Indus Water Treaty as Pakistan minister attends SCO forum in Delhi
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: India suspended the treaty in 2025 as one of the punitive measures against Pakistan after the April 22 Pahalgam terror attack last year that claimed 26 lives

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: India's position on the Indus Waters Treaty (IWT) is "very clear" and there has been "absolutely no change" in it, the Ministry of External Affairs said on Friday (November 20, 2026), amid a visit by Pakistan Minister Musadik Malik to attend the SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum in Delhi. Mr. Malik, who arrived here in the early hours of Friday (November 20, 2026), attended the opening day of the three-day forum in the evening. The event, being hosted by India at the historic Purana Quila, was inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi. India had announced on October 28 that invitations had been extended to all SCO members, including Pakistan, in keeping with established practice. It was perhaps the first time New Delhi had invited a Pakistani minister to attend an event in India since the May 7-10 military hostilities last year following Operation Sindoor. Pakistan had announced on November 14 that its Climate Change Minister Malik would participate in the forum. "As far as IWT is concerned, we have made our position very clear, and that is where it remains. There is absolutely no change," Mr. Jaiswal said. India suspended the treaty in 2025 as one of the punitive measures against Pakistan after the April 22 Pahalgam terror attack last year that claimed 26 lives. Mr. Malik's participation in the forum is being seen by some experts as an opportunity in a multilateral framework that may help improve ties between the two neighbours. Interacting with reporters on the sidelines of the forum, Mr. Malik, when asked about the role of culture in fostering better ties between India and Pakistan, said, "Culture has a very key role to play".

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Hours before the inauguration, the MEA on Friday (November 20, 2026) said the forum was a "multilateral event within the SCO framework", for which invitations had been extended to all members of the grouping, including Pakistan.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 India says no change in its position on Indus Water Treaty as Pakistan minister attends SCO forum in Delhi

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 06:56:57 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: India suspended the treaty in 2025 as one of the punitive measures against Pakistan after the April 22 Pahalgam terror attack last year that claimed 26 lives

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: India's position on the Indus Waters Treaty (IWT) is "very clear" and there has been "absolutely no change" in it, the Ministry of External Affairs said on Friday (November 20, 2026), amid a visit by Pakistan Minister Musadik Malik to attend the SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum in Delhi. Mr. Malik, who arrived here in the early hours of Friday (November 20, 2026), attended the opening day of the three-day forum in the evening. The event, being hosted by India at the historic Purana Quila, was inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi. India had announced on October 28 that invitations had been extended to all SCO members, including Pakistan, in keeping with established practice. It was perhaps the first time New Delhi had invited a Pakistani minister to attend an event in India since the May 7-10 military hostilities last year following Operation Sindoor. Pakistan had announced on November 14 that its Climate Change Minister Malik would participate in the forum. "As far as IWT is concerned, we have made our position very clear, and that is where it remains. There is absolutely no change," Mr. Jaiswal said. India suspended the treaty in 2025 as one of the punitive measures against Pakistan after the April 22 Pahalgam terror attack last year that claimed 26 lives. Mr. Malik's participation in the forum is being seen by some experts as an opportunity in a multilateral framework that may help improve ties between the two neighbours. Interacting with reporters on the sidelines of the forum, Mr. Malik, when asked about the role of culture in fostering better ties between India and Pakistan, said, "Culture has a very key role to play".

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Hours before the inauguration, the MEA on Friday (November 20, 2026) said the forum was a "multilateral event within the SCO framework", for which invitations had been extended to all members of the grouping, including Pakistan.

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Participation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Inauguration (Adjective / Verb)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Inauguration' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Opposition questions why India not present at 'G-3' global power summit in Shenzhen; Ministry cites ‘concrete outcomes’ of Quad Summit held earlier in the week

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: “We have taken note of this meeting between three APEC member countries,” said the Ministry’s spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal, responding to a question at a briefing on Friday (November 20, 2026). “We await a fuller account of the concrete outcomes of this meeting before offering our assessment,” he added. The trilateral summit ended with a joint statement that described the meeting as “historic”. “We will be having discussions on the theme of upholding world peace and promoting strategic stability in major country relations. Peace has been an enduring pursuit of humanity. Our planet has been put through more than 10,000 wars,” the host, Mr. Xi said, calling the trilateral summit a “groundbreaking move”. The joint statement issued in Washington, Moscow, and Beijing highlighted four areas of cooperation for the three countries, including reform of the United Nations, increasing the production and supply of petroleum products, curtailing the actions of the International Criminal Court and other international agencies that violated the immunity of State officials, and nuclear arms control and preventing proliferation. The Opposition had criticised the government, suggesting that India should have been included in the summit where global issues were being discussed. “If the Congress were in power, India’s Prime Minister would be sitting at this table ,” Congress leader Rahul Gandhi posted on social media, with a photograph of Mr. Trump, Mr. Xi and Mr. Putin around a table in Shenzhen. India is not a member of the 21-nation APEC grouping, and Prime Minister Narendra Modi had met Mr. Trump on Tuesday (November 17, 2026) at the Quad summit in Manila. “There were some concrete outcomes which came out of [the Quad Summit] including the Quad Business Leaders Forum which is to be held next year,” Mr. Jaiswal said, listing initiatives announced after the Quad meeting, including on emerging technologies, maritime surveillance, cybersecurity cooperation and security issues. “These decisions are [examples of] practical cooperation that is delivering for the people and countries in the Indo-Pacific region,” Mr. Jaiswal added.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: international relations / diplomacy / China / USA / Russia

articles.title: Three to tango: On Trump, Xi, Putin trilateral summit
articles.examRelevance: UPSC, State PSC, SSC & Banking Mains: Deep Analytical Core Summary, Policy Critique, 4 Hinglish Vocab & 2 Analytical Questions
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: U.S., China, Russia must draw up a roadmap for talks on nuclear weapons

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The first trilateral summit between the Presidents of China, the U.S. and Russia , held in Shenzhen on November 19, reflected both the changing global order and the leaders’ shared desire to remain engaged with one another in an increasingly unpredictable world. For U.S. President Donald Trump, the summit was a platform where he could push for joint talks between the world’s three largest nuclear powers on reducing nuclear warheads. After the New START treaty between the U.S. and Russia expired in February 2026, Moscow had signalled that it was ready for talks, but Mr. Trump wanted to involve China as well. For President Xi Jinping, the summit reinforced China’s position as a peer competitor to the U.S. While Russia seeks to deepen partnership with China, the U.S. is looking to build strategic stability. And for Russian President Vladimir Putin, whom the West sought to isolate after he launched the invasion of Ukraine, the summit offered a seat at the high table. The decision to start trilateral talks on nuclear arms and the joint declaration, which stated that ‘a nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought’, are steps in the right direction. But much will depend on what follows.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Many had compared the meet to the 1945 Yalta Conference, when Russian leader Joseph Stalin, U.S. President Franklin D. Roosevelt and British Prime Minister Winston Churchill met to discuss the future of post-War Europe. But Shenzhen was not a summit of the victors of a major war. This was more about three great powers setting terms of engagement in a changing world. The summit failed to achieve any breakthrough on any of the issues on the agenda — nuclear arms reduction, non-proliferation or the Ukraine war — or even offer a road map for the future. Moreover, it is not clear if the Shenzhen spirit could be sustained in the medium to long-term as another President in the U.S. could take a very different approach towards Russia and China. The three leaders have called for reform of the UN. While it is a welcome move, any attempt to reform the international system and institutions must also involve other powers, particularly rising middle powers such as India, South Africa and Brazil. But the Shenzhen framework could bring greater stability and predictability to great-power relations. This is important given that two of the Big Three are currently waging two separate wars. The leaders should draw up a clear road map for nuclear talks and other key issues outlined in the Shenzhen declaration, with realistic and achievable objectives. Otherwise, the summit would amount to little more than another diplomatic photo-op.

✍️ Editorial & Opinion Paragraph #4 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Three to tango: On Trump, Xi, Putin trilateral summit

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 08:17:55 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: U.S., China, Russia must draw up a roadmap for talks on nuclear weapons

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The first trilateral summit between the Presidents of China, the U.S. and Russia , held in Shenzhen on November 19, reflected both the changing global order and the leaders’ shared desire to remain engaged with one another in an increasingly unpredictable world. For U.S. President Donald Trump, the summit was a platform where he could push for joint talks between the world’s three largest nuclear powers on reducing nuclear warheads. After the New START treaty between the U.S. and Russia expired in February 2026, Moscow had signalled that it was ready for talks, but Mr. Trump wanted to involve China as well. For President Xi Jinping, the summit reinforced China’s position as a peer competitor to the U.S. While Russia seeks to deepen partnership with China, the U.S. is looking to build strategic stability. And for Russian President Vladimir Putin, whom the West sought to isolate after he launched the invasion of Ukraine, the summit offered a seat at the high table. The decision to start trilateral talks on nuclear arms and the joint declaration, which stated that ‘a nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought’, are steps in the right direction. But much will depend on what follows.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Many had compared the meet to the 1945 Yalta Conference, when Russian leader Joseph Stalin, U.S. President Franklin D. Roosevelt and British Prime Minister Winston Churchill met to discuss the future of post-War Europe. But Shenzhen was not a summit of the victors of a major war. This was more about three great powers setting terms of engagement in a changing world. The summit failed to achieve any breakthrough on any of the issues on the agenda — nuclear arms reduction, non-proliferation or the Ukraine war — or even offer a road map for the future. Moreover, it is not clear if the Shenzhen spirit could be sustained in the medium to long-term as another President in the U.S. could take a very different approach towards Russia and China. The three leaders have called for reform of the UN. While it is a welcome move, any attempt to reform the international system and institutions must also involve other powers, particularly rising middle powers such as India, South Africa and Brazil. But the Shenzhen framework could bring greater stability and predictability to great-power relations. This is important given that two of the Big Three are currently waging two separate wars. The leaders should draw up a clear road map for nuclear talks and other key issues outlined in the Shenzhen declaration, with realistic and achievable objectives. Otherwise, the summit would amount to little more than another diplomatic photo-op.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Predictably (Adverb)
जैसा पहले से अनुमान था — बिना किसी आश्चर्य के बिल्कुल पूर्वानुमान के मुताबिक होना।
✓ Syn: Foreseeably, Expectedly, Inevitably  |  ✖ Ant: Unexpectedly, Surprisingly, Abruptly
Institutional (Adjective)
संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।
✓ Syn: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional  |  ✖ Ant: Individual, Informal, Unorganized
Sustainability (Noun)
सतत विकास — पर्यावरण और भविष्य की पीढ़ियों को नुकसान पहुँचाए बिना लंबे समय तक चलने वाला विकास।
✓ Syn: Viability, Eco-balance, Durability  |  ✖ Ant: Depletion, Unsustainability, Destruction
Proliferation (Noun)
प्रसार — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Proliferation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above ✍️ Editorial & Opinion passage on "Three to tango: On Trump, Xi, Putin trilateral summit", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. U.S., China, Russia must draw up a roadmap for talks on nuclear weapons.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Three to tango: On Trump, Xi, Putin trilateral s' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Three to tango: On Trump, Xi, Putin trilatera' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Three to tango: On Trump, Xi, Putin trilatera' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "U.S., China, Russia must draw up a roadmap for talks on nuclear weapons." (Hinglish Arth: अमेरिका, चीन, रूस को परमाणु हथियारों पर बातचीत के लिए एक रोडमैप तैयार करना चाहिए)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Three to tango: On Trump, Xi, Putin trilateral summit"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Otherwise, the summit would amount to little more than another diplomatic photo-op.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Otherwise, the summit would amount to little more than another diplomatic photo-op." (Hinglish Arth: अन्यथा, शिखर सम्मेलन एक और राजनयिक फोटो-ऑप से थोड़ा अधिक होगा।)

articles.title: Why did Tukaram Mundhe withdraw his petition after dragging the Centre to court? | Explained
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: How does the jurisdiction issue between FSSAI and FDA affect businesses and consumers? The history behind the tussle and how Maharashtra had raised concerns earlier too

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A constitutional battle waged by Maharashtra’s Food and Drug Administration Commissioner Tukaram Mundhe has been withdrawn. In September this year, the FDA had filed a case in the Bombay High Court, accusing the Centre of usurping its power by creating a parallel system. It hindered the work of the State government in protecting the consumers’ interests, the FDA said. Adding that it impeded the work of the FDA officials by stopping them from independently raiding establishments which have been licensed by the Centre. Tukaram Mundhe’s step had created a stir, pitting the Centre and the State of Maharashtra against each other over jurisdiction issues. It also accused the FSSAI of ‘clandestinely’ adding new regulations. But now, the FDA Commissioner has decided to withdraw the petition. What do the documents accessed by The Hindu reveal? And why did Tukaram Mundhe decide to withdraw the plea? How do experts weigh in on the constitutional debate? And what does it mean for the businesses and for consumers? Is this the first time Maharashtra has raised this issue? At the heart of the petition filed by the Maharashtra FDA in the Bombay High Court on September 3, 2026, is a jurisdictional dispute. The FDA has argued in the petition that the Centre has gone against the grain of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, to create a parallel structure of enforcement, usurping the powers of the State FDA. It has claimed that the Act itself had envisaged decentralisation of power and had delegated the executive powers of implementation to the State authorities. According to the petition, the core of the dispute is the constitutional validity of regulations and the positions created by FSSAI (Food Safety and Standards Authority of India). Maharashtra government argued that this encroached upon the responsibilities of the State authority in food safety enforcement. The State government said that FSSAI’s move was geared towards centralisation of enforcement, and contradicted the decentralised framework envisioned by the FSS Act. It pointed to the original Statement of Objects and Reasons of the Food Safety Act, which talked of the decentralisation of licensing for food products, empowering the States to issue registration and State licences. Maharashtra government said that the new regulations and new positions hindered the effective protection of public health and consumer interests within the State. The petition challenged the constitutional validity of a few provisions of the Food Safety and Standards (Licensing and Registration of Food Businesses) Regulations, 2011 and its amendment in 2026. It also challenged the creation of the posts of Food Analysts and Central Food Safety Officers under the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (Recruitment and Appointment) Regulation, 2018.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: food safety / health / Maharashtra / The Hindu Explains

hinglishTracks.en: The history behind the tussle and how Maharashtra had raised concerns earlier too

hinglishTracks.en: In September this year, the FDA had filed a case in the Bombay High Court, accusing the Centre of usurping its power by creating a parallel system.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — इस साल सितंबर में, FDA ने बॉम्बे हाई कोर्ट में एक मामला दायर किया था, जिसमें केंद्र पर समानांतर प्रणाली बनाकर उसकी शक्ति हड़पने का आरोप लगाया गया था।।

hinglishTracks.en: It hindered the work of the State government in protecting the consumers’ interests, the FDA said.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — एफडीए ने कहा कि इसने उपभोक्ताओं के हितों की रक्षा करने में राज्य सरकार के काम में बाधा डाली।।

hinglishTracks.en: Adding that it impeded the work of the FDA officials by stopping them from independently raiding establishments which have been licensed by the Centre.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — उन्होंने कहा कि इसने एफडीए अधिकारियों को केंद्र द्वारा लाइसेंस प्राप्त प्रतिष्ठानों पर स्वतंत्र रूप से छापा मारने से रोककर उनके काम में बाधा डाली।।

hinglishTracks.en: Tukaram Mundhe’s step had created a stir, pitting the Centre and the State of Maharashtra against each other over jurisdiction issues.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — तुकाराम मुंढे के कदम ने हलचल पैदा कर दी थी, अधिकार क्षेत्र के मुद्दों पर केंद्र और महाराष्ट्र राज्य एक-दूसरे के खिलाफ खड़े हो गए थे।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Jurisdiction' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: अधिकार क्षेत्र — न्यायालय या किसी संस्था की वह कानूनी सीमा जहाँ तक वह आदेश दे सके। इसके Synonyms हैं: Authority, Sovereignty, Cognizance और Antonyms हैं: Powerlessness, Subordination, Incompetence।

hinglishTracks.en: It also accused the FSSAI of ‘clandestinely’ adding new regulations.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — इसने एफएसएसएआई पर 'गुप्त रूप से' नए नियम जोड़ने का भी आरोप लगाया।।

hinglishTracks.en: But now, the FDA Commissioner has decided to withdraw the petition.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — लेकिन अब, एफडीए आयुक्त ने याचिका वापस लेने का फैसला किया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: What do the documents accessed by The Hindu reveal?
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — द हिंदू को मिले दस्तावेज़ों से क्या पता चलता है?।

hinglishTracks.en: And why did Tukaram Mundhe decide to withdraw the plea?
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — और तुकाराम मुंढे ने याचिका वापस लेने का फैसला क्यों किया?।

hinglishTracks.en: How do experts weigh in on the constitutional debate?
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — विशेषज्ञ संवैधानिक बहस को कैसे महत्व देते हैं?। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.en: And what does it mean for the businesses and for consumers?
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — और व्यवसायों और उपभोक्ताओं के लिए इसका क्या मतलब है?।

hinglishTracks.en: Is this the first time Maharashtra has raised this issue?
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — क्या यह पहली बार है जब महाराष्ट्र ने यह मुद्दा उठाया है?।

hinglishTracks.en: At the heart of the petition filed by the Maharashtra FDA in the Bombay High Court on September 3, 2026, is a jurisdictional dispute.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — 3 सितंबर, 2026 को बॉम्बे हाई कोर्ट में महाराष्ट्र एफडीए द्वारा दायर याचिका के केंद्र में एक क्षेत्राधिकार संबंधी विवाद है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Jurisdiction' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: अधिकार क्षेत्र — न्यायालय या किसी संस्था की वह कानूनी सीमा जहाँ तक वह आदेश दे सके। इसके Synonyms हैं: Authority, Sovereignty, Cognizance और Antonyms हैं: Powerlessness, Subordination, Incompetence।

hinglishTracks.en: The FDA has argued in the petition that the Centre has gone against the grain of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, to create a parallel structure of enforcement, usurping the powers of the State FDA.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — एफडीए ने याचिका में तर्क दिया है कि केंद्र ने राज्य एफडीए की शक्तियों को हड़पते हुए प्रवर्तन की एक समानांतर संरचना बनाने के लिए खाद्य सुरक्षा और मानक अधिनियम, 2006 के प्रावधानों के खिलाफ कदम उठाया है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Enforcement' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: सख्ती से कानून लागू करना — किसी नियम या आदेश का ज़मीनी स्तर पर पालन करवाना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Implementation, Execution, Administration और Antonyms हैं: Neglect, Abandonment, Waiver।

hinglishTracks.en: It has claimed that the Act itself had envisaged decentralisation of power and had delegated the executive powers of implementation to the State authorities.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — इसने दावा किया है कि अधिनियम में स्वयं सत्ता के विकेंद्रीकरण की परिकल्पना की गई थी और कार्यान्वयन की कार्यकारी शक्तियां राज्य अधिकारियों को सौंप दी गई थीं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Implementation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: क्रियान्वयन / ज़मीनी स्तर पर लागू करना — किसी योजना या फैसले को असलियत में पूरा करना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Execution, Enforcement, Fulfillment और Antonyms हैं: Abandonment, Neglect, Cancellation।

hinglishTracks.en: According to the petition, the core of the dispute is the constitutional validity of regulations and the positions created by FSSAI (Food Safety and Standards Authority of India).
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — याचिका के अनुसार, विवाद का मूल नियमों की संवैधानिक वैधता और एफएसएसएआई (भारतीय खाद्य सुरक्षा और मानक प्राधिकरण) द्वारा बनाए गए पद हैं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.en: Maharashtra government argued that this encroached upon the responsibilities of the State authority in food safety enforcement.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — महाराष्ट्र सरकार ने तर्क दिया कि यह खाद्य सुरक्षा प्रवर्तन में राज्य प्राधिकरण की जिम्मेदारियों का अतिक्रमण है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Enforcement' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: सख्ती से कानून लागू करना — किसी नियम या आदेश का ज़मीनी स्तर पर पालन करवाना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Implementation, Execution, Administration और Antonyms हैं: Neglect, Abandonment, Waiver।

hinglishTracks.en: The State government said that FSSAI’s move was geared towards centralisation of enforcement, and contradicted the decentralised framework envisioned by the FSS Act.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — राज्य सरकार ने कहा कि एफएसएसएआई का कदम प्रवर्तन के केंद्रीकरण की दिशा में था, और एफएसएस अधिनियम द्वारा परिकल्पित विकेंद्रीकृत ढांचे का खंडन किया।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Enforcement' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: सख्ती से कानून लागू करना — किसी नियम या आदेश का ज़मीनी स्तर पर पालन करवाना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Implementation, Execution, Administration और Antonyms हैं: Neglect, Abandonment, Waiver।

hinglishTracks.en: It pointed to the original Statement of Objects and Reasons of the Food Safety Act, which talked of the decentralisation of licensing for food products, empowering the States to issue registration and State licences.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — इसने खाद्य सुरक्षा अधिनियम के उद्देश्यों और कारणों के मूल विवरण की ओर इशारा किया, जिसमें खाद्य उत्पादों के लिए लाइसेंसिंग के विकेंद्रीकरण, राज्यों को पंजीकरण और राज्य लाइसेंस जारी करने का अधिकार देने की बात की गई थी।।

hinglishTracks.en: Maharashtra government said that the new regulations and new positions hindered the effective protection of public health and consumer interests within the State.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — महाराष्ट्र सरकार ने कहा कि नए नियम और नए पद राज्य के भीतर सार्वजनिक स्वास्थ्य और उपभोक्ता हितों की प्रभावी सुरक्षा में बाधा डालते हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: The petition challenged the constitutional validity of a few provisions of the Food Safety and Standards (Licensing and Registration of Food Businesses) Regulations, 2011 and its amendment in 2026.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — याचिका में खाद्य सुरक्षा और मानक (खाद्य व्यवसायों की लाइसेंसिंग और पंजीकरण) विनियम, 2011 के कुछ प्रावधानों और 2026 में इसके संशोधन की संवैधानिक वैधता को चुनौती दी गई थी।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.en: It also challenged the creation of the posts of Food Analysts and Central Food Safety Officers under the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (Recruitment and Appointment) Regulation, 2018.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — इसने भारतीय खाद्य सुरक्षा और मानक प्राधिकरण (भर्ती और नियुक्ति) विनियमन, 2018 के तहत खाद्य विश्लेषकों और केंद्रीय खाद्य सुरक्षा अधिकारियों के पदों के निर्माण को भी चुनौती दी।।

📰 Why did Tukaram Mundhe withdraw his petition after dragging the Centre to court? | Explained

1. Core Context & Background: How does the jurisdiction issue between FSSAI and FDA affect businesses and consumers? The history behind the tussle and how Maharashtra had raised concerns earlier too

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A constitutional battle waged by Maharashtra’s Food and Drug Administration Commissioner Tukaram Mundhe has been withdrawn. In September this year, the FDA had filed a case in the Bombay High Court, accusing the Centre of usurping its power by creating a parallel system. It hindered the work of the State government in protecting the consumers’ interests, the FDA said. Adding that it impeded the work of the FDA officials by stopping them from independently raiding establishments which have been licensed by the Centre. Tukaram Mundhe’s step had created a stir, pitting the Centre and the State of Maharashtra against each other over jurisdiction issues. It also accused the FSSAI of ‘clandestinely’ adding new regulations. But now, the FDA Commissioner has decided to withdraw the petition. What do the documents accessed by The Hindu reveal? And why did Tukaram Mundhe decide to withdraw the plea? How do experts weigh in on the constitutional debate? And what does it mean for the businesses and for consumers? Is this the first time Maharashtra has raised this issue? At the heart of the petition filed by the Maharashtra FDA in the Bombay High Court on September 3, 2026, is a jurisdictional dispute. The FDA has argued in the petition that the Centre has gone against the grain of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, to create a parallel structure of enforcement, usurping the powers of the State FDA. It has claimed that the Act itself had envisaged decentralisation of power and had delegated the executive powers of implementation to the State authorities. According to the petition, the core of the dispute is the constitutional validity of regulations and the positions created by FSSAI (Food Safety and Standards Authority of India). Maharashtra government argued that this encroached upon the responsibilities of the State authority in food safety enforcement. The State government said that FSSAI’s move was geared towards centralisation of enforcement, and contradicted the decentralised framework envisioned by the FSS Act. It pointed to the original Statement of Objects and Reasons of the Food Safety Act, which talked of the decentralisation of licensing for food products, empowering the States to issue registration and State licences. Maharashtra government said that the new regulations and new positions hindered the effective protection of public health and consumer interests within the State. The petition challenged the constitutional validity of a few provisions of the Food Safety and Standards (Licensing and Registration of Food Businesses) Regulations, 2011 and its amendment in 2026. It also challenged the creation of the posts of Food Analysts and Central Food Safety Officers under the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (Recruitment and Appointment) Regulation, 2018.

articles.title: Andhra Pradesh bags seven national awards under PM SVANidhi scheme
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Andhra Pradesh secures first rank at the national level for conducting special campaigns, second rank in loan disbursement and third in overall performance under PM SVANidhi

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Andhra Pradesh has bagged seven national awards under the Pradhan Mantri Street Vendor’s AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi) scheme in recognition of its outstanding performance in supporting street vendors and strengthening their livelihoods. The awards comprise three State-level honours and four awards for Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) in multiple performance categories. Mission for Elimination of Poverty in Municipal Areas (MEPMA) Director G. Balakrishna, Additional Director N. Venkateswara Rao and State Mission Manager (Business Loans) V. Prabhavathi received the awards on behalf of the Andhra Pradesh government at the SVANidhi Samman Awards event held in New Delhi on Friday (November 20, 2026). Andhra Pradesh has secured the first rank at the national level for conducting special campaigns, second rank in loan disbursement and third in overall performance under PM SVANidhi, Municipal Administration & Urban Development (MA&UD) Department Principal Secretary S. Suresh Kumar said in a release. The achievement was strengthened by the outstanding performance of four ULBs. Kadapa Municipal Corporation secured the second rank in loan disbursement, while Ramachandrapuram Municipality got the first rank in the S VANidhi Se Samriddhi category. Amalapuram Municipality secured second rank in the same category, and Vizianagaram Municipal Corporation earned second rank in digital transactions. Mr. Suresh Kumar said that the achievements across loan disbursement, special campaigns, welfare convergence and digital transactions demonstrated the importance of strong institutional coordination and last-mile delivery in extending the benefits of the scheme to street vendors. PM SVANidhi is for providing collateral-free working capital loans to street vendors, enabling them to restart, sustain and expand their businesses. Beyond access to formal credit, the scheme promotes digital transactions, financial literacy and social security, helping them become financially independent and strengthen their economic prospects, he added.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: MA&UD Minister P. Narayana lauded the efforts and commitment that enabled the department to win the awards and said the awards marked the State’s continued focus on inclusive urban growth.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Andhra Pradesh bags seven national awards under PM SVANidhi scheme

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 08:49:17 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Andhra Pradesh secures first rank at the national level for conducting special campaigns, second rank in loan disbursement and third in overall performance under PM SVANidhi

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Andhra Pradesh has bagged seven national awards under the Pradhan Mantri Street Vendor’s AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi) scheme in recognition of its outstanding performance in supporting street vendors and strengthening their livelihoods. The awards comprise three State-level honours and four awards for Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) in multiple performance categories. Mission for Elimination of Poverty in Municipal Areas (MEPMA) Director G. Balakrishna, Additional Director N. Venkateswara Rao and State Mission Manager (Business Loans) V. Prabhavathi received the awards on behalf of the Andhra Pradesh government at the SVANidhi Samman Awards event held in New Delhi on Friday (November 20, 2026). Andhra Pradesh has secured the first rank at the national level for conducting special campaigns, second rank in loan disbursement and third in overall performance under PM SVANidhi, Municipal Administration & Urban Development (MA&UD) Department Principal Secretary S. Suresh Kumar said in a release. The achievement was strengthened by the outstanding performance of four ULBs. Kadapa Municipal Corporation secured the second rank in loan disbursement, while Ramachandrapuram Municipality got the first rank in the S VANidhi Se Samriddhi category. Amalapuram Municipality secured second rank in the same category, and Vizianagaram Municipal Corporation earned second rank in digital transactions. Mr. Suresh Kumar said that the achievements across loan disbursement, special campaigns, welfare convergence and digital transactions demonstrated the importance of strong institutional coordination and last-mile delivery in extending the benefits of the scheme to street vendors. PM SVANidhi is for providing collateral-free working capital loans to street vendors, enabling them to restart, sustain and expand their businesses. Beyond access to formal credit, the scheme promotes digital transactions, financial literacy and social security, helping them become financially independent and strengthen their economic prospects, he added.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: MA&UD Minister P. Narayana lauded the efforts and commitment that enabled the department to win the awards and said the awards marked the State’s continued focus on inclusive urban growth.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Institutional (Adjective)
संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।
✓ Syn: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional  |  ✖ Ant: Individual, Informal, Unorganized
Inclusive (Adjective)
समावेशी — जिसमें समाज के हर वर्ग (खासकर गरीब और वंचित वर्ग) को बराबर शामिल किया जाए।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Egalitarian, All-encompassing  |  ✖ Ant: Exclusive, Discriminatory, Narrow
Sustainability (Noun)
सतत विकास — पर्यावरण और भविष्य की पीढ़ियों को नुकसान पहुँचाए बिना लंबे समय तक चलने वाला विकास।
✓ Syn: Viability, Eco-balance, Durability  |  ✖ Ant: Depletion, Unsustainability, Destruction
Administration (Noun)
प्रशासन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Administration' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Andhra Pradesh bags seven national awards und' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Andhra Pradesh bags seven national awards und' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. articles.title: MoUs signed of ₹1.72 lakh crore for six energy projects in Bihar
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Nuclear power plants to be established in Banka and Siwan; Four pumped storage projects to be developed in Nawada, Jamui and Aurangabad

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: In a step towards promoting industrial development and attracting investment in Bihar, Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) were signed for six energy projects on Friday (November 20, 2026) during the Entrepreneurs’ Interaction and MoU Exchange Ceremony organised under Bihar Business Connect–2026. These projects envisage a total investment of ₹1,72,885 crore in the state’s energy sector. The projects have two nuclear power plants and four pumped storage projects. The two nuclear power plants will be established in Banka and Siwan districts, while the four pumped storage projects will be developed in Nawada, Jamui and Aurangabad districts. The ceremony was held in Patna with Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary attending as the Chief Guest. Both Deputy Chief Ministers Vijay Kumar Choudhary and Bijendra Prasad Yadav were present along with Industries Minister Shreyasi Singh. Among the total investment proposals worth ₹2.25 lakh crore received by the Energy and Industries Departments under Bihar Business Connect, the agreements for these six energy projects will strengthen the State’s power generation and energy storage capacity. Once implemented, these projects will help meet Bihar’s future electricity requirements, enhance energy security and accelerate industrial growth. Chief Secretary Pratyaya Amrit (IAS) and Energy Secretary-cum-Chairman and Managing Director of Bihar State Power Holding Company Limited (BSPHCL) Ajay Yadav (IAS). Vishal Raj (IAS), Managing Director of Bihar State Power Generation Company Limited, exchanged the MoUs with representatives of various companies. The participating representatives included Sumit Verma, Head – Business Development and Strategy, Adani Group, Krishna Tungaturthi, Chief Operation Officer (COO) - Pumped Storage- Greenko Group, Jigish Mehta, Director, Torrent Power; S. D. Paraswar - Scientist and Member of the Board of Directors, Nuclear Power Corporation of India Limited (NPCIL) and Arnada Prasad Samal, Executive Director (Nuclear), NTPC. Bihar CM said that Bihar’s energy sector is undergoing a major transformation. “These agreements have been signed keeping in mind the rising demand for electricity and the pace of industrial development. The state government aims to ensure 24×7 availability of affordable, quality and uninterrupted power to industries by 2030,” Mr. Choudhary said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He further said that the State government is providing 125 units of free electricity every month to 1.92 crore domestic consumers. In addition, rooftop solar installations are being encouraged through the PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana and other solar energy schemes.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 MoUs signed of ₹1.72 lakh crore for six energy projects in Bihar

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 08:43:31 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Nuclear power plants to be established in Banka and Siwan; Four pumped storage projects to be developed in Nawada, Jamui and Aurangabad

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: In a step towards promoting industrial development and attracting investment in Bihar, Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) were signed for six energy projects on Friday (November 20, 2026) during the Entrepreneurs’ Interaction and MoU Exchange Ceremony organised under Bihar Business Connect–2026. These projects envisage a total investment of ₹1,72,885 crore in the state’s energy sector. The projects have two nuclear power plants and four pumped storage projects. The two nuclear power plants will be established in Banka and Siwan districts, while the four pumped storage projects will be developed in Nawada, Jamui and Aurangabad districts. The ceremony was held in Patna with Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary attending as the Chief Guest. Both Deputy Chief Ministers Vijay Kumar Choudhary and Bijendra Prasad Yadav were present along with Industries Minister Shreyasi Singh. Among the total investment proposals worth ₹2.25 lakh crore received by the Energy and Industries Departments under Bihar Business Connect, the agreements for these six energy projects will strengthen the State’s power generation and energy storage capacity. Once implemented, these projects will help meet Bihar’s future electricity requirements, enhance energy security and accelerate industrial growth. Chief Secretary Pratyaya Amrit (IAS) and Energy Secretary-cum-Chairman and Managing Director of Bihar State Power Holding Company Limited (BSPHCL) Ajay Yadav (IAS). Vishal Raj (IAS), Managing Director of Bihar State Power Generation Company Limited, exchanged the MoUs with representatives of various companies. The participating representatives included Sumit Verma, Head – Business Development and Strategy, Adani Group, Krishna Tungaturthi, Chief Operation Officer (COO) - Pumped Storage- Greenko Group, Jigish Mehta, Director, Torrent Power; S. D. Paraswar - Scientist and Member of the Board of Directors, Nuclear Power Corporation of India Limited (NPCIL) and Arnada Prasad Samal, Executive Director (Nuclear), NTPC. Bihar CM said that Bihar’s energy sector is undergoing a major transformation. “These agreements have been signed keeping in mind the rising demand for electricity and the pace of industrial development. The state government aims to ensure 24×7 availability of affordable, quality and uninterrupted power to industries by 2030,” Mr. Choudhary said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He further said that the State government is providing 125 units of free electricity every month to 1.92 crore domestic consumers. In addition, rooftop solar installations are being encouraged through the PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana and other solar energy schemes.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Implementation (Noun)
क्रियान्वयन / ज़मीनी स्तर पर लागू करना — किसी योजना या फैसले को असलियत में पूरा करना।
✓ Syn: Execution, Enforcement, Fulfillment  |  ✖ Ant: Abandonment, Neglect, Cancellation
Transformation (Noun)
परिवर्तन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Transformation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Availability (Noun)
उपलब्धता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Availability' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Development (Adjective)
विकास — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Development' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "MoUs signed of ₹1.72 lakh crore for six energy projects in Bihar", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Nuclear power plants to be established in Banka and Siwan; Four pumped storage projects to be developed in Nawada, Jamui and Aurangabad.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'MoUs signed of ₹1.72 lakh crore for six energy p' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'MoUs signed of ₹1.72 lakh crore for six energ' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'MoUs signed of ₹1.72 lakh crore for six energ' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Nuclear power plants to be established in Banka and Siwan; Four pumped storage projects to be developed in Nawada, Jamui and Aurangabad." (Hinglish Arth: बांका और सीवान में स्थापित होंगे परमाणु ऊर्जा संयंत्र; नवादा, जमुई और औरंगाबाद में चार पंप भंडारण परियोजनाएं विकसित की जाएंगी)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "MoUs signed of ₹1.72 lakh crore for six energy projects in Bihar"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. In addition, rooftop solar installations are being encouraged through the PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana and other solar energy schemes.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "In addition, rooftop solar installations are being encouraged through the PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana and other solar energy schemes." (Hinglish Arth: इसके अलावा, पीएम सूर्य घर: मुफ्त बिजली योजना और अन्य सौर ऊर्जा योजनाओं के माध्यम से छत पर सौर ऊर्जा प्रतिष्ठानों को प्रोत्साहित किया जा रहा है।)

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Multiple merging points, U-turns and downstream bottlenecks contribute to persistent jams on NH-48; proposed decongestion measures include regulating vehicle entry and enforcing lane discipline

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A long line of red tail-lights stretches along the Mahipalpur flyover on National Highway-48 every day as commuters make their way between home and work. With at least half a million commuters using the flyover daily, according to Delhi Traffic Police estimates, the corridor connecting central Delhi with Gurugram has become a persistent traffic bottleneck. Vehicles begin slowing down even before reaching the flyover, with queues frequently stretching beyond it. Police sources attributed the congestion to multiple traffic streams converging at Telco Cut and Radisson, frequent merging and lane changes, and bottlenecks on the roads beyond the flyover. Gajender Rawat, a private-sector employee who travels from his residence in Paschim Vihar to his workplace in Gurugram, said he spends at least 30-40 minutes crossing the flyover every day — roughly the time his entire home-to-work journey would take in the absence of traffic. “Vehicles begin slowing down almost as soon as we enter the flyover while travelling from Delhi towards Gurugram, with congestion stretching towards the Gurugram side. It is the same story on the way back, especially if you travel during peak office hours,” Gajender Rawat said. On Wednesday, he took over 1.5 hours to cross the stretch during peak hours. For some commuters, avoiding the corridor altogether has become the only practical solution. Denis Gupta, another private-sector employee who travels daily from Rohini to Gurugram, said he takes the Urban Extension Road (UER), despite the longer distance and toll charges. “I stopped using that route altogether because of the long traffic jams. I now take the UER, which is a longer route and takes around an hour, and have to pay toll for it. But I’d rather pay and drive longer than get stuck in a traffic jam. Ultimately, it takes longer on the shorter route because of the jam,” he said. Commuters have also repeatedly flagged the problem on social media, describing the flyover as a “permanent choke point” and raising concerns over traffic management and passenger pick-ups and drop-offs along the stretch. “Over the last five-six months, there has been a permanent traffic jam at Mahipalpur flyover. We do not see police personnel at major choke points. Shiv Murti has become a bus stand, with long-distance buses stopping to pick up passengers. Cabs drop passengers near the hotel at Mahipalpur flyover,” a commuter wrote on X, sharing a Google Maps screenshot showing a travel time of 1 hour and 43 minutes for 36 km.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: A proposed decongestion plan prepared by the traffic police focuses on regulating the volume of vehicles entering the flyover rather than merely increasing signal timings. Traffic police official said the plan recommends controlled entry from feeder roads such as Telco Cut and Radisson, channelising merging and U-turn movements, and enforcing lane discipline to prevent sudden lane changes on the flyover.
