articles.title: FBI, U.S. Agriculture Department breached by hackers, reports say
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The newly uncovered breaches at the FBI and USDA were described as hacks, which are different from outages like the ones that afflicted Microsoft Outlook and the Federal Aviation Administration

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The FBI is investigating a ​suspected breach of a nationwide database ‌used by federal, state and ​local law enforcement agencies ⁠to share criminal justice information, CNN reported on Friday (November 20, 2026), citing two people ‌briefed on the investigation. The apparent compromise of the National ‌Crime Information Center database would ‌mark ⁠the second intrusion involving ⁠an FBI system in recent months and the latest in a string ​of cyber incidents that ‌have alarmed U.S. officials over the past week. The agency did not respond to a ‌request for comment from Reuters . The ​FBI database is used by law enforcement agencies nationwide ⁠to store and share information on warrants, criminal histories and background ‌checks. The U.S. Agriculture Department was also breached by hackers in cyberattacks, U.S. media reported on Friday. It remains unclear whether these two incidents are related and who is responsible for them. U.S. President Donald Trump has sought to calm the public and urged people to "relax", while officials said the various outages were not linked to criminal activity. The U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) told employees that a system used to facilitate payments to farmers was targeted in a cyberattack, NBC reported, citing two former USDA officials. The hackers may use the payments system as a backdoor to access more sensitive material, the former officials told NBC.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The USDA deals with "a bunch of scary biologic issues" and "if an adversary or a competitor were to have access to that same information... they could use our own research against us," a former official was quoted as saying.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #24 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 FBI, U.S. Agriculture Department breached by hackers, reports say

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 12:33:49 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The newly uncovered breaches at the FBI and USDA were described as hacks, which are different from outages like the ones that afflicted Microsoft Outlook and the Federal Aviation Administration

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The FBI is investigating a ​suspected breach of a nationwide database ‌used by federal, state and ​local law enforcement agencies ⁠to share criminal justice information, CNN reported on Friday (November 20, 2026), citing two people ‌briefed on the investigation. The apparent compromise of the National ‌Crime Information Center database would ‌mark ⁠the second intrusion involving ⁠an FBI system in recent months and the latest in a string ​of cyber incidents that ‌have alarmed U.S. officials over the past week. The agency did not respond to a ‌request for comment from Reuters . The ​FBI database is used by law enforcement agencies nationwide ⁠to store and share information on warrants, criminal histories and background ‌checks. The U.S. Agriculture Department was also breached by hackers in cyberattacks, U.S. media reported on Friday. It remains unclear whether these two incidents are related and who is responsible for them. U.S. President Donald Trump has sought to calm the public and urged people to "relax", while officials said the various outages were not linked to criminal activity. The U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) told employees that a system used to facilitate payments to farmers was targeted in a cyberattack, NBC reported, citing two former USDA officials. The hackers may use the payments system as a backdoor to access more sensitive material, the former officials told NBC.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The USDA deals with "a bunch of scary biologic issues" and "if an adversary or a competitor were to have access to that same information... they could use our own research against us," a former official was quoted as saying.

articles.title: Pakistan Climate Minister arrives in Delhi to attend SCO Civilisations Dialogue Forum
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Pakistan is the current chair of the SCO Council of Heads of State (CHS) (SCO_CHS) for the period of 2026-27; the event, which will be inaugurated by PM Modi, will be held at Delhi’s iconic Purana Quila (Old Fort), a 16th Century fort built by Emperor Humayun

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Pakistan’s Federal Minister for Climate Change and Environmental Coordination, Dr. Musadik Masood Malik , arrived in Delhi on Friday (November 20, 2026) for the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Civilisational Dialogue Forum, officials said. Mr. Malik is representing Pakistan at a cultural meeting of the SCO in Delhi, the Pakistan High Commission in India said. Pakistan is the current chair of the SCO Council of Heads of State (CHS) (SCO_CHS) for the period of 2026-27. The SCO is represented by China, India, Russia, Iran, Pakistan, Belarus, and Central Asian countries such as Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan, and Kazakhstan. Almost all the member countries of the SCO are ancient civilisations that date back to the BCE era. The dialogue, which will be organised by the Ministry of Culture and the Ministry of External Affairs, was proposed by Prime Minister Narendra Modi at the SCO leaders’ Summit in Tianjin last year and adopted by the SCO Council. According to the sources, the government has invited Pakistan’s Minister for National Heritage and Culture Aurungzeb Khan Khichi, for the event. Culture Ministers from the 10 member states, including China, Russia, Iran, Belarus and Central Asian states, 15 Dialogue partners and observer countries have been invited. The event, which will be inaugurated by Mr. Modi, will be held at Delhi’s iconic Purana Quila (Old Fort), a 16th Century fort built by Emperor Humayun. The fort is also the site of many excavations showcasing India’s ancient past spanning nearly 3,000 years, from the Pre-Mauryan, Mauryan, Sunga, Kushana, Gupta, Post-Gupta period to medieval-era Rajput, Sultanate and Mughal periods, officials said, explaining its importance.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: India-Pakistan / Pakistan / environmental issues / climate change

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #24 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Pakistan Climate Minister arrives in Delhi to attend SCO Civilisations Dialogue Forum

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 11:55:50 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Pakistan is the current chair of the SCO Council of Heads of State (CHS) (SCO_CHS) for the period of 2026-27; the event, which will be inaugurated by PM Modi, will be held at Delhi’s iconic Purana Quila (Old Fort), a 16th Century fort built by Emperor Humayun

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Pakistan’s Federal Minister for Climate Change and Environmental Coordination, Dr. Musadik Masood Malik , arrived in Delhi on Friday (November 20, 2026) for the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Civilisational Dialogue Forum, officials said. Mr. Malik is representing Pakistan at a cultural meeting of the SCO in Delhi, the Pakistan High Commission in India said. Pakistan is the current chair of the SCO Council of Heads of State (CHS) (SCO_CHS) for the period of 2026-27. The SCO is represented by China, India, Russia, Iran, Pakistan, Belarus, and Central Asian countries such as Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan, and Kazakhstan. Almost all the member countries of the SCO are ancient civilisations that date back to the BCE era. The dialogue, which will be organised by the Ministry of Culture and the Ministry of External Affairs, was proposed by Prime Minister Narendra Modi at the SCO leaders’ Summit in Tianjin last year and adopted by the SCO Council. According to the sources, the government has invited Pakistan’s Minister for National Heritage and Culture Aurungzeb Khan Khichi, for the event. Culture Ministers from the 10 member states, including China, Russia, Iran, Belarus and Central Asian states, 15 Dialogue partners and observer countries have been invited. The event, which will be inaugurated by Mr. Modi, will be held at Delhi’s iconic Purana Quila (Old Fort), a 16th Century fort built by Emperor Humayun. The fort is also the site of many excavations showcasing India’s ancient past spanning nearly 3,000 years, from the Pre-Mauryan, Mauryan, Sunga, Kushana, Gupta, Post-Gupta period to medieval-era Rajput, Sultanate and Mughal periods, officials said, explaining its importance.

articles.title: Over 1 crore HPV vaccines given to 14-year-old girls in nine months: Health Ministry
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Six States — Gujarat, Uttar Pradesh, Andhra Pradesh, Mizoram, Madhya Pradesh, and Bihar — have achieved 100% coverage of their identified target populations, the Ministry said

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: India has administered more than one crore doses of the HPV vaccine to 14-year-old girls under its national vaccination campaign in less than nine months, covering nearly 87% of the identified annual target, the Health Ministry said on Saturday (November 21, 2026). The nationwide HPV vaccination campaign, launched by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in February this year, provides free, voluntary and single-dose vaccination to 14-year-old girls at designated government health facilities with parental consent. The annual target cohort comprises around 1.2 crore girls, based on Registrar General of India (RGI) 2021 population estimates. Six States — Gujarat, Uttar Pradesh, Andhra Pradesh, Mizoram, Madhya Pradesh, and Bihar — have achieved 100% coverage of their identified target populations, the Ministry said. Among other States, Assam has recorded 95.63% coverage, followed by Telangana (95.28%), Karnataka (93.16%) and Uttarakhand (90.17%). Chhattisgarh and Rajasthan have crossed the 80% mark with 86.21% and 85.23% coverage, respectively. Kerala has recorded 77.02% coverage, Tamil Nadu 76.12%, Odisha 74.90% and the Union Territory of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu 72.99%. In absolute numbers, Uttar Pradesh leads with more than 29.33 lakh girls vaccinated, followed by Bihar with over 13.70 lakh and Gujarat with more than 7.75 lakh, according to the Ministry. The milestone reflects coordinated efforts by the Centre, States and Union Territories, district administrations, healthcare workers, teachers, parents and local communities, it said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The campaign has also focused on community engagement and dissemination of science-based information on HPV vaccination, with healthcare professionals, including paediatricians, gynaecologists, and specialists from institutions such as AIIMS, helping address concerns about vaccine safety and effectiveness.

articles.title: Pune startup develops atomic clock prototype amid growing export curbs on critical technologies
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Atomic clocks are critical to satellite navigation, telecommunications, space missions and strategic systems, where highly precise and stable timekeeping is essential.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Amid growing export controls and restrictions on access to high-performance atomic clock technology, Pune-based deep-tech startup QuPrayog Private Limited has developed a laboratory-scale atomic clock prototype, marking a step towards India’s efforts to build indigenous capabilities in precision timing and quantum instrumentation. The startup has developed a Rubidium-87 atomic clock using Coherent Population Trapping (CPT) technology in a seven-month development effort. Having achieved a Technology Readiness Level (TRL) 4 prototype, the company is now working towards developing a miniature, integrated product before the end of 2027. Atomic clocks are critical to satellite navigation, telecommunications, space missions and strategic systems, where highly precise and stable timekeeping is essential. However, international export controls on dual-use technologies have made access to advanced atomic clocks challenging, highlighting the need for domestic alternatives and a reliable indigenous supply chain. According to the company's experimental measurements, the prototype has demonstrated significant improvements in timekeeping stability, performing nearly 50 times better than a conventional free-running crystal oscillator over a period of 1,000 seconds, the company said in a press release. Explaining the significance of the development, Dr Jay Mangaonkar, CEO and co-founder of QuPrayog, said, “Our objective is to reduce India’s dependence on imported atomic clocks and establish a reliable domestic supply chain for high-performance timing systems developed and manufactured in India. We want these critical technologies to be accessible to Indian companies building the next generation of navigation, space and strategic systems.”

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: As part of India’s push towards self-reliance and its Viksit Bharat 2047 vision, the Centre launched the National Quantum Mission in 2023, with an allocation of ₹6,003.65 crore over eight years. The mission aims to develop indigenous capabilities in quantum technologies, including sensing, metrology and precision measurement.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #26 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Pune startup develops atomic clock prototype amid growing export curbs on critical technologies

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 12:03:51 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Atomic clocks are critical to satellite navigation, telecommunications, space missions and strategic systems, where highly precise and stable timekeeping is essential.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Amid growing export controls and restrictions on access to high-performance atomic clock technology, Pune-based deep-tech startup QuPrayog Private Limited has developed a laboratory-scale atomic clock prototype, marking a step towards India’s efforts to build indigenous capabilities in precision timing and quantum instrumentation. The startup has developed a Rubidium-87 atomic clock using Coherent Population Trapping (CPT) technology in a seven-month development effort. Having achieved a Technology Readiness Level (TRL) 4 prototype, the company is now working towards developing a miniature, integrated product before the end of 2027. Atomic clocks are critical to satellite navigation, telecommunications, space missions and strategic systems, where highly precise and stable timekeeping is essential. However, international export controls on dual-use technologies have made access to advanced atomic clocks challenging, highlighting the need for domestic alternatives and a reliable indigenous supply chain. According to the company's experimental measurements, the prototype has demonstrated significant improvements in timekeeping stability, performing nearly 50 times better than a conventional free-running crystal oscillator over a period of 1,000 seconds, the company said in a press release. Explaining the significance of the development, Dr Jay Mangaonkar, CEO and co-founder of QuPrayog, said, “Our objective is to reduce India’s dependence on imported atomic clocks and establish a reliable domestic supply chain for high-performance timing systems developed and manufactured in India. We want these critical technologies to be accessible to Indian companies building the next generation of navigation, space and strategic systems.”

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: As part of India’s push towards self-reliance and its Viksit Bharat 2047 vision, the Centre launched the National Quantum Mission in 2023, with an allocation of ₹6,003.65 crore over eight years. The mission aims to develop indigenous capabilities in quantum technologies, including sensing, metrology and precision measurement.

A. Atomic clocks are critical to satellite navigation, telecommunications, space missions and strategic systems, where highly precise and stable...

✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Odisha Chief Minister said heavy rainfall was expected in Mayurbhanj and Balasore over the next 24 hours, with its impact likely to extend to neighbouring Jajpur, Bhadrak, Kendrapara and Jagatsinghpur districts

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: As many as 14 flights were cancelled at the Birsa Munda Airport in Ranchi on Saturday (November 21) due to inclement weather triggered by cyclone ‘Akvan’, an official said. Cyclone Akvan causes 14 Ranchi airport flight cancellations due to poor visibility and bad weather. Relief operations are underway on a war footing in Odisha’s Ganjam district after Cyclone Akvan. An ODRAF team carried out a tree-cutting operation under the Jarau Nal bridge in Chhandikendu village to clear the affected area. Normalcy has been restored at Puri beach after Cyclone Akvan. Beach activities have resumed, bringing the shoreline back to life after the disruption caused by the cyclone. Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu sought central assistance of nearly ₹100 crore for the restoration of horticultural crops damaged by cyclones Arnab and Murasu. “Naidu has written a letter to Union Minister for Agriculture and Farmers Welfare Shivraj Singh Chouhan, seeking additional financial assistance for the restoration of horticulture crops damaged by two consecutive cyclones,” a press release said. The cyclones damaged crops across 29,960 hectares in 18 districts, affecting 71,576 farmers and causing losses estimated at ₹1,092 crore, he said. The cyclone had considerably lost its intensity when it made landfall near Gopalpur in Odisha. “The cyclonic storm Akvan crossed the south coastal Odisha and north Andhra Pradesh close to Gopalpur with a wind speed of 70-80 kmph, gusting to 90 kmph during 7.30 a.m. to 8.30 a.m.,” said the India Meteorological Department (IMD). Landfall of Cyclone Akvan nears Odisha and Andhra Pradesh coasts as land interaction begins, with heavy rainfall and prolonged impact anticipated.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The depression is likely to move nearly northwards over Odisha and weaken further into a low-pressure area during next 6 hours, said IMD

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #8 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 14 flights cancelled at Ranchi airport amid Cyclone 'Akvan' | LIVE

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 02:26:59 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Odisha Chief Minister said heavy rainfall was expected in Mayurbhanj and Balasore over the next 24 hours, with its impact likely to extend to neighbouring Jajpur, Bhadrak, Kendrapara and Jagatsinghpur districts

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: As many as 14 flights were cancelled at the Birsa Munda Airport in Ranchi on Saturday (November 21) due to inclement weather triggered by cyclone ‘Akvan’, an official said. Cyclone Akvan causes 14 Ranchi airport flight cancellations due to poor visibility and bad weather. Relief operations are underway on a war footing in Odisha’s Ganjam district after Cyclone Akvan. An ODRAF team carried out a tree-cutting operation under the Jarau Nal bridge in Chhandikendu village to clear the affected area. Normalcy has been restored at Puri beach after Cyclone Akvan. Beach activities have resumed, bringing the shoreline back to life after the disruption caused by the cyclone. Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu sought central assistance of nearly ₹100 crore for the restoration of horticultural crops damaged by cyclones Arnab and Murasu. “Naidu has written a letter to Union Minister for Agriculture and Farmers Welfare Shivraj Singh Chouhan, seeking additional financial assistance for the restoration of horticulture crops damaged by two consecutive cyclones,” a press release said. The cyclones damaged crops across 29,960 hectares in 18 districts, affecting 71,576 farmers and causing losses estimated at ₹1,092 crore, he said. The cyclone had considerably lost its intensity when it made landfall near Gopalpur in Odisha. “The cyclonic storm Akvan crossed the south coastal Odisha and north Andhra Pradesh close to Gopalpur with a wind speed of 70-80 kmph, gusting to 90 kmph during 7.30 a.m. to 8.30 a.m.,” said the India Meteorological Department (IMD). Landfall of Cyclone Akvan nears Odisha and Andhra Pradesh coasts as land interaction begins, with heavy rainfall and prolonged impact anticipated.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The depression is likely to move nearly northwards over Odisha and weaken further into a low-pressure area during next 6 hours, said IMD

बहाली — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Restoration' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Consecutive (Adjective)
लगातार — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Consecutive' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to '14 flights cancelled at Ranchi airport amid C' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that '14 flights cancelled at Ranchi airport amid C' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Odisha Chief Minister said heavy rainfall was expected in Mayurbhanj and Balasore over the next 24 hours, with its impact likely to extend to..." articles.title: Group of minors assault man, woman at Kurla garden; eight detained
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The attack took place at Pramod Mahajan Garden behind a mall in Kurla West, a police official said

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A group of minors allegedly assaulted a young man and a woman at a public garden in the eastern suburb of Kurla, Mumbai, with a video of the incident going viral on social media, police said on Saturday (November 21, 2026). The attack took place at Pramod Mahajan Garden behind a mall in Kurla West, an official said. The clip, which surfaced on social media on Friday (November 20, 2026), showed the young man and woman being surrounded by a group of minors, some appearing to be as young as 10 years old, who then proceeded to hit them with a stick, punch and kick them, before chasing after them as they tried to escape. Taking serious cognisance of the viral footage, police identified the minors involved in the assault and registered a case under section 189(2) (unlawful assembly), 118(1) (voluntarily causing hurt using dangerous weapons or means), 352 (intentional insult with intent to provoke breach of peace), and 351(2) (criminal intimidation) and other relevant provisions of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), the official said.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Eight minors have been detained and will be produced before the Juvenile Justice Board (JJB), he added.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Group of minors assault man, woman at Kurla garden; eight detained

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 02:25:40 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The attack took place at Pramod Mahajan Garden behind a mall in Kurla West, a police official said

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A group of minors allegedly assaulted a young man and a woman at a public garden in the eastern suburb of Kurla, Mumbai, with a video of the incident going viral on social media, police said on Saturday (November 21, 2026). The attack took place at Pramod Mahajan Garden behind a mall in Kurla West, an official said. The clip, which surfaced on social media on Friday (November 20, 2026), showed the young man and woman being surrounded by a group of minors, some appearing to be as young as 10 years old, who then proceeded to hit them with a stick, punch and kick them, before chasing after them as they tried to escape. Taking serious cognisance of the viral footage, police identified the minors involved in the assault and registered a case under section 189(2) (unlawful assembly), 118(1) (voluntarily causing hurt using dangerous weapons or means), 352 (intentional insult with intent to provoke breach of peace), and 351(2) (criminal intimidation) and other relevant provisions of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), the official said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Eight minors have been detained and will be produced before the Juvenile Justice Board (JJB), he added.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Intimidation (Adjective / Verb)
डराना — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Intimidation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Dangerous (Adjective)
खतरनाक — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Dangerous' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Group of minors assault man, woman at Kurla garden; eight detained", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The attack took place at Pramod Mahajan Garden behind a mall in Kurla West, a police official said.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Group of minors assault man, woman at Kurla gard' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.

D. The author contends that 'Group of minors assault man, woman at Kurla g' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The attack took place at Pramod Mahajan Garden behind a mall in Kurla West, a police official said." (Hinglish Arth: एक पुलिस अधिकारी ने बताया कि हमला कुर्ला पश्चिम में एक मॉल के पीछे प्रमोद महाजन गार्डन में हुआ)

C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Eight minors have been detained and will be produced before the Juvenile Justice Board (JJB), he added." articles.title: Kalpakkam DAE Centre conducts emergency preparedness drive
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Kalpakkam Centre of the Department of Atomic Energy (DAE), which houses a number of nuclear facilities, conducted a surprise emergency preparedness drive on Friday (November 20, 2026) to assess the preparedness and response capabilities of the Centre and the managements of the different plants in handling unlikely emergency situations.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: This is an annual feature and is conducted as an unannounced exercise, a press release stated. More than 7,000 personnel were evacuated as part of the simulated emergency response and it was completed within 90 minutes. The exercise was held under the supervision of Kalpakkam Emergency Committee headed by S.B. Selvakumar, Station Director, MAPS.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The Kalpakkam Centre houses the Madras Atomic Power Station (MAPS), operated by the Nuclear Power Corporation of India Limited (NPCIL); the Indira Gandhi Centre for Atomic Research (IGCAR); the Prototype Fast Breeder Reactor (PFBR), built and commissioned by BHAVINI; and the Nuclear Recycle Board.

articles.title: Break free of limiting beliefs to achieve new heights: PM Modi at IIT Kharagpur
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Narendra Modi joins Platinum Jubilee celebrations of the first IIT of the country and says the institute has and will continue to play a major role in nation building

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Saturday (November 21, 2026) said that if people go ahead with the “nation first” mindset, then new opportunities will come their way. He asked students to break free of limiting beliefs to achieve new heights, at the Platinum jubilee celebrations of the Indian Institute of Technology, Kharagpur. “This place has always come forward in building the nation at every stage of the country since its independence,” Mr. Modi said while addressing the students at the 75th anniversary celebrations at IIT Kharagpur, which is also the first IIT of independent India. He also hoped that the institute will continue to make similar contributions in building the future of the nation. “We have limiting beliefs; we limit our thoughts, our dreams, our aspirations, our talent, and give up. But we only reach our full potential if we break free of the limits to unlock new possibilities,” Mr. Modi said. He added that people put limit to their own thoughts, restricting the opportunities in their lives and of the nation. Mr Modi said that during his tenure as the PM, he has broken the limits and achieved many such goals which people believed to be “impossible”. “ Poverty in India was known to be a permanent problem. But there was no real change made through policy; they only made files. People took the situation for granted. But when we came to power, we changed this mentality and empowered the poor and started schemes to get them out of poverty,” Mr. Modi said. He added that according to a World Bank report, in the last 12-13 years at least 50 crore people in India have been taken out of poverty. Mr. Modi added that in the coming days, when India is going forward towards a “Viksit Bharat”, IIT Kharagpur is sure to play a major role in building that dream. The PM further said that he hopes the 100 years of IIT Kharagpur will be celebrated in the Vikshit Bharat in the coming years. VIDEO | Kharagpur, West Bengal: At the Platinum Jubilee celebrations of IIT Kharagpur, Prime Minister Narendra Modi says, "Break the limit, unlock the possibilities. Let me share a few examples with you today. Just think, until 20 years ago, poverty was considered a permanent problem in our country. Five decades ago, slogans were raised from the Red Fort about eradicating poverty. However, whenever it came to taking action at the policy level, the entire system would simply prepare files and sit idle." (Source: Narendra Modi YT) (Full video available on PTI Videos - https://t.co/bIyFWTfmBd) West Bengal Governor R.N. Ravi , Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari and Higher Education Minister Jagannath Chattopadhyay were among the others present at the 75-year program.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Meanwhile, the director of the institute took the stage and said that under the PM’s leadership, they are now remaining true to the mission of IIT Kharagpur. “From grassroots to skyrockets, that is the new IIT Kharagpur,” Professor Suman Chakraborty said. He also added that IIT Kharagpur alumni and Google CEO Sundar Pichai have offered a 5 million dollar support for applied Artificial Intelligence research.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Break free of limiting beliefs to achieve new heights: PM Modi at IIT Kharagpur

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 02:11:34 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Narendra Modi joins Platinum Jubilee celebrations of the first IIT of the country and says the institute has and will continue to play a major role in nation building

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Saturday (November 21, 2026) said that if people go ahead with the “nation first” mindset, then new opportunities will come their way. He asked students to break free of limiting beliefs to achieve new heights, at the Platinum jubilee celebrations of the Indian Institute of Technology, Kharagpur. “This place has always come forward in building the nation at every stage of the country since its independence,” Mr. Modi said while addressing the students at the 75th anniversary celebrations at IIT Kharagpur, which is also the first IIT of independent India. He also hoped that the institute will continue to make similar contributions in building the future of the nation. “We have limiting beliefs; we limit our thoughts, our dreams, our aspirations, our talent, and give up. But we only reach our full potential if we break free of the limits to unlock new possibilities,” Mr. Modi said. He added that people put limit to their own thoughts, restricting the opportunities in their lives and of the nation. Mr Modi said that during his tenure as the PM, he has broken the limits and achieved many such goals which people believed to be “impossible”. “ Poverty in India was known to be a permanent problem. But there was no real change made through policy; they only made files. People took the situation for granted. But when we came to power, we changed this mentality and empowered the poor and started schemes to get them out of poverty,” Mr. Modi said. He added that according to a World Bank report, in the last 12-13 years at least 50 crore people in India have been taken out of poverty. Mr. Modi added that in the coming days, when India is going forward towards a “Viksit Bharat”, IIT Kharagpur is sure to play a major role in building that dream. The PM further said that he hopes the 100 years of IIT Kharagpur will be celebrated in the Vikshit Bharat in the coming years. VIDEO | Kharagpur, West Bengal: At the Platinum Jubilee celebrations of IIT Kharagpur, Prime Minister Narendra Modi says, "Break the limit, unlock the possibilities. Let me share a few examples with you today. Just think, until 20 years ago, poverty was considered a permanent problem in our country. Five decades ago, slogans were raised from the Red Fort about eradicating poverty. However, whenever it came to taking action at the policy level, the entire system would simply prepare files and sit idle." (Source: Narendra Modi YT) (Full video available on PTI Videos - https://t.co/bIyFWTfmBd) West Bengal Governor R.N. Ravi , Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari and Higher Education Minister Jagannath Chattopadhyay were among the others present at the 75-year program.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Meanwhile, the director of the institute took the stage and said that under the PM’s leadership, they are now remaining true to the mission of IIT Kharagpur. “From grassroots to skyrockets, that is the new IIT Kharagpur,” Professor Suman Chakraborty said. He also added that IIT Kharagpur alumni and Google CEO Sundar Pichai have offered a 5 million dollar support for applied Artificial Intelligence research.

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: Narendra Modi joins Platinum Jubilee celebrations of the first IIT of the country and says the institute has and will continue to play a major role in nation building
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Saturday (November 21, 2026) said that if people go ahead with the “nation first” mindset, then new opportunities will come their way. He asked students to break free of limiting beliefs to achieve new heights, at the Platinum jubilee celebrations of the Indian Institute of Technology, Kharagpur. “This place has always come forward in building the nation at every stage of the country since its independence,” Mr. Modi said while addressing the students at the 75th anniversary celebrations at IIT Kharagpur, which is also the first IIT of independent India. He also hoped that the institute will continue to make similar contributions in building the future of the nation. “We have limiting beliefs; we limit our thoughts, our dreams, our aspirations, our talent, and give up. But we only reach our full potential if we break free of the limits to unlock new possibilities,” Mr. Modi said. He added that people put limit to their own thoughts, restricting the opportunities in their lives and of the nation. Mr Modi said that during his tenure as the PM, he has broken the limits and achieved many such goals which people believed to be “impossible”. “ Poverty in India was known to be a permanent problem. But there was no real change made through policy; they only made files. People took the situation for granted. But when we came to power, we changed this mentality and empowered the poor and started schemes to get them out of poverty,” Mr. Modi said. He added that according to a World Bank report, in the last 12-13 years at least 50 crore people in India have been taken out of poverty. Mr. Modi added that in the coming days, when India is going forward towards a “Viksit Bharat”, IIT Kharagpur is sure to play a major role in building that dream. The PM further said that he hopes the 100 years of IIT Kharagpur will be celebrated in the Vikshit Bharat in the coming years. VIDEO | Kharagpur, West Bengal: At the Platinum Jubilee celebrations of IIT Kharagpur, Prime Minister Narendra Modi says, "Break the limit, unlock the possibilities. Let me share a few examples with you today. Just think, until 20 years ago, poverty was considered a permanent problem in our country. Five decades ago, slogans were raised from the Red Fort about eradicating poverty. However, whenever it came to taking action at the policy level, the entire system would simply prepare files and sit idle." (Source: Narendra Modi YT) (Full video available on PTI Videos - https://t.co/bIyFWTfmBd) West Bengal Governor R.N. Ravi , Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari and Higher Education Minister Jagannath Chattopadhyay were among the others present at the 75-year program.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Meanwhile, the director of the institute took the stage and said that under the PM’s leadership, they are now remaining true to the mission of IIT Kharagpur. “From grassroots to skyrockets, that is the new IIT Kharagpur,” Professor Suman Chakraborty said. He also added that IIT Kharagpur alumni and Google CEO Sundar Pichai have offered a 5 million dollar support for applied Artificial Intelligence research.

articles.title: Kannada writer Ravi Hanj arrested at Kochi airport amid Basava Mantapa book controversy
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Ravi Hanj was detained during security checks while attempting to travel abroad, say Kerala Police sources. He will be handed over to Karnataka Police

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Kannada writer Ravi Hanj, who is at the centre of a major controversy over alleged derogatory remarks against 12th-century social reformer Basavanna in his book Basava Mantapa and in interviews around the book , has been detained by Central Industrial Security Force (CISF) personnel at Cochin International Airport in Keralam. Mr. Hanj was detained during security checks on Saturday (November 21, 2026) while attempting to travel abroad, State police sources said. He was being taken for medical examinations, the sources said. The CISF took Mr. Hanj into custody acting on a lookout notice issued against him by the Belagavi police. He will be handed over to the Karnataka Police, sources added. Mr. Hanj was recently booked by the police in Bengaluru, Belagavi, Bagewadi and Vijayapura following complaints alleged derogatory remarks against Basavanna and the Lingayat community. The Karnataka Cabinet on Thursday decided to confiscate his book following complaints by Veerashiva-Lingayat groups. The book’s publisher, Vishweshwar Bhat, has also been named in the Bengaluru and Vijayapura FIRs. The book is a compilation of columns published in the Viswavani newspaper under the same title Basava Mantapa . It was released as a book in Bengaluru on November 15. The government decided to confiscate the book following representations from Basava Samiti that alleged that the writer made the derogatory remarks in the book and in an interview published on Viswavani’s social media channels on November 13. The complaints have sought legal action against the writer, editor and others allegedly involved, and requested authorities to prevent further circulation of the book and content that could hurt religious sentiments. The BJP also demanded action against the writer.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Karnataka Deputy Chief Minister G. Parameshwara, briefing the media after Thursday’s Cabinet meeting, had said they were not banning the book but “forfeiting all copies”, and there was a provision for the same under the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023. However, there had been no notification from the government till November 21 afternoon to empower the police to forfeit the books.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Kannada writer Ravi Hanj arrested at Kochi airport amid Basava Mantapa book controversy

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 02:07:16 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Ravi Hanj was detained during security checks while attempting to travel abroad, say Kerala Police sources. He will be handed over to Karnataka Police

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Kannada writer Ravi Hanj, who is at the centre of a major controversy over alleged derogatory remarks against 12th-century social reformer Basavanna in his book Basava Mantapa and in interviews around the book , has been detained by Central Industrial Security Force (CISF) personnel at Cochin International Airport in Keralam. Mr. Hanj was detained during security checks on Saturday (November 21, 2026) while attempting to travel abroad, State police sources said. He was being taken for medical examinations, the sources said. The CISF took Mr. Hanj into custody acting on a lookout notice issued against him by the Belagavi police. He will be handed over to the Karnataka Police, sources added. Mr. Hanj was recently booked by the police in Bengaluru, Belagavi, Bagewadi and Vijayapura following complaints alleged derogatory remarks against Basavanna and the Lingayat community. The Karnataka Cabinet on Thursday decided to confiscate his book following complaints by Veerashiva-Lingayat groups. The book’s publisher, Vishweshwar Bhat, has also been named in the Bengaluru and Vijayapura FIRs. The book is a compilation of columns published in the Viswavani newspaper under the same title Basava Mantapa . It was released as a book in Bengaluru on November 15. The government decided to confiscate the book following representations from Basava Samiti that alleged that the writer made the derogatory remarks in the book and in an interview published on Viswavani’s social media channels on November 13. The complaints have sought legal action against the writer, editor and others allegedly involved, and requested authorities to prevent further circulation of the book and content that could hurt religious sentiments. The BJP also demanded action against the writer.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Karnataka Deputy Chief Minister G. Parameshwara, briefing the media after Thursday’s Cabinet meeting, had said they were not banning the book but “forfeiting all copies”, and there was a provision for the same under the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023. However, there had been no notification from the government till November 21 afternoon to empower the police to forfeit the books.

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Kannada writer Ravi Hanj arrested at Kochi airport amid Basava Mantapa book controversy", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Ravi Hanj was detained during security checks while attempting to travel abroad, say Kerala Police sources.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Kannada writer Ravi Hanj arrested at Kochi airpo' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Kannada writer Ravi Hanj arrested at Kochi ai' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Kannada writer Ravi Hanj arrested at Kochi ai' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Ravi Hanj was detained during security checks while attempting to travel abroad, say Kerala Police sources." (Hinglish Arth: केरल पुलिस के सूत्रों का कहना है कि रवि हंज को विदेश यात्रा की कोशिश के दौरान सुरक्षा जांच के दौरान हिरासत में लिया गया था।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Kannada writer Ravi Hanj arrested at Kochi airport amid Basava Mantapa book controversy"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. However, there had been no notification from the government till November 21 afternoon to empower the police to forfeit the books.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "However, there had been no notification from the government till November 21 afternoon to empower the police to forfeit the books." (Hinglish Arth: हालाँकि, पुलिस को किताबें जब्त करने का अधिकार देने के लिए 21 नवंबर की दोपहर तक सरकार की ओर से कोई अधिसूचना नहीं आई थी।)

articles.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon taking on Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.2 Sol
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Google said the new model was built for complex coding, analytical reasoning, and enterprise workflows

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Google has launched a new AI model, Gemini 4 Neon, that it said was primed for complex software engineering, knowledge work, and science workflows. According to the company, Neon ranked ahead of comparable models, including Anthropic’s Claude Opus 5.5 and OpenAI’s GPT-6.2 Sol, on several benchmarks. Gemini 4 Neon is priced at $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens with a million-token context window. Google noted that the new model was designed to support long-running agentic workflows and ensure that tasks are completed, while balancing out costs. Meanwhile users of the Gemini app could expect better writing and knowledge work, reliable research, and faster responses when faced with challenging tasks, per the company. “Get more done while stretching usage limits further when handing off tedious to-dos, like analysing billing statements to spot why a utility charge spiked or cross-checking multiple receipts and documents to negotiate a refund,” suggested Google in a blog post. The search giant affirmed that its new model maintained Gemini 4 Carbon-level safeguards against severe misuse and prompt injection, and also advanced model alignment.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “Neon is built for complex coding, analytical reasoning, and production-grade enterprise workflows. While Carbon tackles your hardest, long-horizon projects, and Hydrogen handles fast everyday execution, Neon balances depth and efficiency. Neon delivers frontier-level reasoning for complex, high-frequency workflows faster and more cost efficiently,” stated Koray Kavukcuoglu, SVP, Google DeepMind and Chief AI Architect at Google.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #30 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Google launches Gemini 4 Neon taking on Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.2 Sol

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 02:03:51 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Google said the new model was built for complex coding, analytical reasoning, and enterprise workflows

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Google has launched a new AI model, Gemini 4 Neon, that it said was primed for complex software engineering, knowledge work, and science workflows. According to the company, Neon ranked ahead of comparable models, including Anthropic’s Claude Opus 5.5 and OpenAI’s GPT-6.2 Sol, on several benchmarks. Gemini 4 Neon is priced at $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens with a million-token context window. Google noted that the new model was designed to support long-running agentic workflows and ensure that tasks are completed, while balancing out costs. Meanwhile users of the Gemini app could expect better writing and knowledge work, reliable research, and faster responses when faced with challenging tasks, per the company. “Get more done while stretching usage limits further when handing off tedious to-dos, like analysing billing statements to spot why a utility charge spiked or cross-checking multiple receipts and documents to negotiate a refund,” suggested Google in a blog post. The search giant affirmed that its new model maintained Gemini 4 Carbon-level safeguards against severe misuse and prompt injection, and also advanced model alignment.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “Neon is built for complex coding, analytical reasoning, and production-grade enterprise workflows. While Carbon tackles your hardest, long-horizon projects, and Hydrogen handles fast everyday execution, Neon balances depth and efficiency. Neon delivers frontier-level reasoning for complex, high-frequency workflows faster and more cost efficiently,” stated Koray Kavukcuoglu, SVP, Google DeepMind and Chief AI Architect at Google.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Analytical (Adjective)
विश्लेषणात्मक — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Analytical' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

Anthropic (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Anthropic' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Injection (Adjective / Verb)
इंजेक्शन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Injection' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🚀 Science, Tech & Environment passage on "Google launches Gemini 4 Neon taking on Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.2 Sol", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Google said the new model was built for complex coding, analytical reasoning, and enterprise workflows.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Google launches Gemini 4 Neon taking on Claude O' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Google launches Gemini 4 Neon taking on Claud' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Google launches Gemini 4 Neon taking on Claud' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Google said the new model was built for complex coding, analytical reasoning, and enterprise workflows." (Hinglish Arth: Google ने कहा कि नया मॉडल जटिल कोडिंग, विश्लेषणात्मक तर्क और एंटरप्राइज़ वर्कफ़्लो के लिए बनाया गया था)

B. Neon delivers frontier-level reasoning for complex, high-frequency workflows faster and more cost efficiently,” stated Koray Kavukcuoglu, SVP, Google...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Neon delivers frontier-level reasoning for complex, high-frequency workflows faster and more cost efficiently,” stated Koray Kavukcuoglu, SVP, Google..." articles.title: Why a shortage of clinical psychologists in Keralam govt hospitals is leaving people with intellectual disabilities waiting for certificates
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: As per the last Kerala Disability Census in 2015, there are about 80,000 persons with various intellectual challenges. However, government hospitals and medical college hospitals in the State currently have only 22 clinical psychologists to conduct IQ assessment tests

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: People with intellectual disabilities in Keralam are struggling to obtain and renew disability certificates due to a severe shortage of clinical psychologists in government hospitals to conduct Intelligence Quotient (IQ) assessment tests.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: As per the latest disability assessment guidelines issued by the Union government’s Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, differently-abled children must undergo assessment tests at least thrice before they turn 18 to obtain permanent disability certificates. During all these assessment phases, an IQ test is a must. However, there are only 22 clinical psychologists under the Directorate of Health Services (DHS) and the Directorate of Medical Education (DME) put together – 17 under the DHS and the rest under the DME.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #26 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Why a shortage of clinical psychologists in Keralam govt hospitals is leaving people with intellectual disabilities waiting for certificates

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 01:40:28 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: As per the last Kerala Disability Census in 2015, there are about 80,000 persons with various intellectual challenges. However, government hospitals and medical college hospitals in the State currently have only 22 clinical psychologists to conduct IQ assessment tests

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: People with intellectual disabilities in Keralam are struggling to obtain and renew disability certificates due to a severe shortage of clinical psychologists in government hospitals to conduct Intelligence Quotient (IQ) assessment tests.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: As per the latest disability assessment guidelines issued by the Union government’s Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, differently-abled children must undergo assessment tests at least thrice before they turn 18 to obtain permanent disability certificates. During all these assessment phases, an IQ test is a must. However, there are only 22 clinical psychologists under the Directorate of Health Services (DHS) and the Directorate of Medical Education (DME) put together – 17 under the DHS and the rest under the DME.

articles.title: This 2D rhythm platformer video game is an ode to India’s multiplicities
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Suri: The Seventh Note by Tathvamasi Studios is set in a universe controlled by evil music. The game was launched in October

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The story of Suri: The Seventh Note, a 2D video game by Bengaluru-based Tathvamasi Studios, is set in a world corrupted by an evil version of music. Everything in this universe moves in tune with that nefarious sonic presence. The protagonist, Ajira, must find a fruit located at the centre of the island to save her mother from certain death. Soon, she realises her actions shall determine the fate of the island itself. Suri: The Seventh Note is the brainchild of Glen Martin from Kochi, founder of Tathvamasi Studios, who is also the game director of the video. He is joined by Chitrak Srivastava, co-founder and the game’s art director. The game was launched on Playstation Store and Steam in October. Glen, formerly a data scientist, found himself immersed in game-making during the pandemic. He began by making smaller games, with friends from different places joining him on a Discord server to help. “When we started to build the game, it was not meant to be a project. But once we realised its potential, we began to think about what could be unique about this game,” says Glen. Glen Martin and Chitrak Srivastava | Photo Credit: SPECIAL ARRANGEMENT “At that point, I was playing a parry-focused combat game called Sekiro. It’s a very hard game, and I am not good at it. But then I saw a lot of streamers play the game skilfully, without even taking a single hit, and I realised that when the game is played at that level, it has a certain rhythmic quality to it,” he adds. “The sounds of the sword clinking, the jumps and movements, everything felt choreographed.” This ultimately led him to turn Suri… into a rhythm platformer game. Suri... is a mix of two different games: rhythm and platformer. Rhythm games are music-themed action games that assess a player’s sense of timing and metre, while platformers are a sub-genre where a main character moves through uneven terrain and suspended platforms. “There are very few games that have done this before, so our well of references was limited. In Suri..., the world moves to the rhythm. All the things that you would normally interact with in a regular platformer, like traps, obstacles, etc., are all tied to the rhythm in our game. You have to listen to the music to understand when a thing would move up and down or when a leaf would open or close and so on,” explains Glen. “When played well, it feels like dancing through levels.” In 2024, Suri was one of five games at the inaugural edition of PlayStation’s India Hero Project, an incubator programme from Sony Interactive Entertainment. This ultimately allowed Glen to quit his job and hire more people.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: A still from Suri: The Seventh Note | Photo Credit: SPECIAL ARRANGEMENT

hinglishTracks.en: Glen, formerly a data scientist, found himself immersed in game-making during the pandemic.

hinglishTracks.en: He began by making smaller games, with friends from different places joining him on a Discord server to help.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — उन्होंने छोटे-छोटे गेम बनाकर शुरुआत की, जिसमें विभिन्न स्थानों से उनके दोस्त मदद के लिए डिस्कॉर्ड सर्वर पर शामिल हुए।।

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #28 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 This 2D rhythm platformer video game is an ode to India’s multiplicities

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 12:36:10 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Suri: The Seventh Note by Tathvamasi Studios is set in a universe controlled by evil music. The game was launched in October

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The story of Suri: The Seventh Note, a 2D video game by Bengaluru-based Tathvamasi Studios, is set in a world corrupted by an evil version of music. Everything in this universe moves in tune with that nefarious sonic presence. The protagonist, Ajira, must find a fruit located at the centre of the island to save her mother from certain death. Soon, she realises her actions shall determine the fate of the island itself. Suri: The Seventh Note is the brainchild of Glen Martin from Kochi, founder of Tathvamasi Studios, who is also the game director of the video. He is joined by Chitrak Srivastava, co-founder and the game’s art director. The game was launched on Playstation Store and Steam in October. Glen, formerly a data scientist, found himself immersed in game-making during the pandemic. He began by making smaller games, with friends from different places joining him on a Discord server to help. “When we started to build the game, it was not meant to be a project. But once we realised its potential, we began to think about what could be unique about this game,” says Glen. Glen Martin and Chitrak Srivastava | Photo Credit: SPECIAL ARRANGEMENT “At that point, I was playing a parry-focused combat game called Sekiro. It’s a very hard game, and I am not good at it. But then I saw a lot of streamers play the game skilfully, without even taking a single hit, and I realised that when the game is played at that level, it has a certain rhythmic quality to it,” he adds. “The sounds of the sword clinking, the jumps and movements, everything felt choreographed.” This ultimately led him to turn Suri… into a rhythm platformer game. Suri... is a mix of two different games: rhythm and platformer. Rhythm games are music-themed action games that assess a player’s sense of timing and metre, while platformers are a sub-genre where a main character moves through uneven terrain and suspended platforms. “There are very few games that have done this before, so our well of references was limited. In Suri..., the world moves to the rhythm. All the things that you would normally interact with in a regular platformer, like traps, obstacles, etc., are all tied to the rhythm in our game. You have to listen to the music to understand when a thing would move up and down or when a leaf would open or close and so on,” explains Glen. “When played well, it feels like dancing through levels.” In 2024, Suri was one of five games at the inaugural edition of PlayStation’s India Hero Project, an incubator programme from Sony Interactive Entertainment. This ultimately allowed Glen to quit his job and hire more people.

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: Suri: The Seventh Note by Tathvamasi Studios is set in a universe controlled by evil music. The game was launched in October
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The story of Suri: The Seventh Note, a 2D video game by Bengaluru-based Tathvamasi Studios, is set in a world corrupted by an evil version of music. Everything in this universe moves in tune with that nefarious sonic presence. The protagonist, Ajira, must find a fruit located at the centre of the island to save her mother from certain death. Soon, she realises her actions shall determine the fate of the island itself. Suri: The Seventh Note is the brainchild of Glen Martin from Kochi, founder of Tathvamasi Studios, who is also the game director of the video. He is joined by Chitrak Srivastava, co-founder and the game’s art director. The game was launched on Playstation Store and Steam in October. Glen, formerly a data scientist, found himself immersed in game-making during the pandemic. He began by making smaller games, with friends from different places joining him on a Discord server to help. “When we started to build the game, it was not meant to be a project. But once we realised its potential, we began to think about what could be unique about this game,” says Glen. Glen Martin and Chitrak Srivastava | Photo Credit: SPECIAL ARRANGEMENT “At that point, I was playing a parry-focused combat game called Sekiro. It’s a very hard game, and I am not good at it. But then I saw a lot of streamers play the game skilfully, without even taking a single hit, and I realised that when the game is played at that level, it has a certain rhythmic quality to it,” he adds. “The sounds of the sword clinking, the jumps and movements, everything felt choreographed.” This ultimately led him to turn Suri… into a rhythm platformer game. Suri... is a mix of two different games: rhythm and platformer. Rhythm games are music-themed action games that assess a player’s sense of timing and metre, while platformers are a sub-genre where a main character moves through uneven terrain and suspended platforms. “There are very few games that have done this before, so our well of references was limited. In Suri..., the world moves to the rhythm. All the things that you would normally interact with in a regular platformer, like traps, obstacles, etc., are all tied to the rhythm in our game. You have to listen to the music to understand when a thing would move up and down or when a leaf would open or close and so on,” explains Glen. “When played well, it feels like dancing through levels.” In 2024, Suri was one of five games at the inaugural edition of PlayStation’s India Hero Project, an incubator programme from Sony Interactive Entertainment. This ultimately allowed Glen to quit his job and hire more people.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: A still from Suri: The Seventh Note | Photo Credit: SPECIAL ARRANGEMENT

articles.title: CCMB team identifies genes that spur nerve repair, raise possibility of paralysis treatment
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Scientists at the CSIR-Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology (CCMB) , Hyderabad, have identified two genes that can restore damaged nerve cells’ ability to regenerate, raising the possibility of new gene-based treatments for paralysis caused by spinal cord injuries.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The study, led by Ishwariya Venkatesh, found that activating two developmental genes, NR2F1 and NR2F6, enabled severed nerve fibres to regrow across completely injured spinal cords in mice, leading to measurable improvements in movement. The spinal cord transmits signals from the brain to the rest of the body, enabling movement and sensation. Damage to it can cause paralysis because nerve cells in adult mammals generally lose their ability to regenerate. Despite decades of research, there is no treatment that can restore the lost neural connections. The researchers sought to understand why young neurons can grow and regenerate while adult neurons cannot. Their investigation focused on proteins that activate growth-related genes during development but become less active as the brain matures. The team discovered that the genes NR2F1 and NR2F6, which had not previously been linked to nerve regeneration, decline by 70-80% in adult brains. Restoring either gene in adult mice prompted damaged nerve fibres to regenerate across the injury site and extend beyond it. Untreated animals, by contrast, showed little or no regrowth. The treated mice also showed improved mobility, including better hind-limb movement and grip strength. Recovery became evident about five weeks after the injury and continued thereafter. The two genes, however, triggered regeneration through different mechanisms. NR2F1 activated genes involved in remodelling DNA and rebuilding cellular structures needed for growth. NR2F6, meanwhile, suppressed several routine cellular activities, allowing neurons to redirect resources towards repairing damaged nerve fibres. The team also found that NR2F6 reorganises the three-dimensional structure of DNA in injured neurons, bringing growth-related genes closer to the regulatory elements that control their activity. Researchers said this was the first evidence linking large-scale genome reorganisation to nerve regeneration in the brain or spinal cord.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Published in The EMBO Journal , the study is still at the preclinical stage. The genes were delivered before the injury in mice, and the recovery was partial. The findings, however, offer a potential framework for developing gene-based therapies to repair spinal cord damage, said a press release.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #29 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 CCMB team identifies genes that spur nerve repair, raise possibility of paralysis treatment

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 12:34:36 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Scientists at the CSIR-Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology (CCMB) , Hyderabad, have identified two genes that can restore damaged nerve cells’ ability to regenerate, raising the possibility of new gene-based treatments for paralysis caused by spinal cord injuries.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The study, led by Ishwariya Venkatesh, found that activating two developmental genes, NR2F1 and NR2F6, enabled severed nerve fibres to regrow across completely injured spinal cords in mice, leading to measurable improvements in movement. The spinal cord transmits signals from the brain to the rest of the body, enabling movement and sensation. Damage to it can cause paralysis because nerve cells in adult mammals generally lose their ability to regenerate. Despite decades of research, there is no treatment that can restore the lost neural connections. The researchers sought to understand why young neurons can grow and regenerate while adult neurons cannot. Their investigation focused on proteins that activate growth-related genes during development but become less active as the brain matures. The team discovered that the genes NR2F1 and NR2F6, which had not previously been linked to nerve regeneration, decline by 70-80% in adult brains. Restoring either gene in adult mice prompted damaged nerve fibres to regenerate across the injury site and extend beyond it. Untreated animals, by contrast, showed little or no regrowth. The treated mice also showed improved mobility, including better hind-limb movement and grip strength. Recovery became evident about five weeks after the injury and continued thereafter. The two genes, however, triggered regeneration through different mechanisms. NR2F1 activated genes involved in remodelling DNA and rebuilding cellular structures needed for growth. NR2F6, meanwhile, suppressed several routine cellular activities, allowing neurons to redirect resources towards repairing damaged nerve fibres. The team also found that NR2F6 reorganises the three-dimensional structure of DNA in injured neurons, bringing growth-related genes closer to the regulatory elements that control their activity. Researchers said this was the first evidence linking large-scale genome reorganisation to nerve regeneration in the brain or spinal cord.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Published in The EMBO Journal , the study is still at the preclinical stage. The genes were delivered before the injury in mice, and the recovery was partial. The findings, however, offer a potential framework for developing gene-based therapies to repair spinal cord damage, said a press release.

D. The author contends that 'CCMB team identifies genes that spur nerve re' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. articles.title: New AICC in-charge B.M. Sandeep to face challenges in Telangana Congress on his maiden visit
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Telangana Congress MLAs are openly criticising the government, senior Ministers over disproportioonate fund allocations

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The newly appointed All India Congress Committee (AICC) secretary in-charge of Telangana, B.M. Sandeep, will make his maiden visit to Hyderabad on Sunday (November 22, 2026) , at a time when the ruling Congress is grappling with an unusual challenge of some of its own MLAs openly criticising the government and targeting senior Ministers. Mr. Sandeep, who is relatively unfamiliar to most Congress leaders in Telangana, has his task cut out for him as he seeks to establish his authority and restore discipline in a party whose internal differences have increasingly spilled into the public domain. One of his immediate challenges will be to deal with senior leaders such as Munugode MLA Komatireddy Rajgopal Reddy, who has made personal remarks against Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy, while claiming that he was compelled to speak out in the party’s and his constituency interests. Interestingly, the party high command is understood to have asked Mr. Rajgopal Reddy to meet Mr. Sandeep personally during the latter’s visit. Whether the senior MLA responds to the invitation and attends the meeting remains to be seen. Jadcherla MLA Anirudh Reddy has also been openly expressing his dissatisfaction with certain Ministers and has even written to the Congress high command seeking action against them. The public criticism by the two legislators has put the party leadership in an uncomfortable position, particularly as the government is approaching the completion of three years in office. Chief Minister A Revanth Reddy responded strongly, albeit indirectly, to Mr. Rajgopal Reddy’s criticism and personal attack. Addressing a public meeting in Siddipet, Mr. Revanth Reddy sent a strong message in his inimitable style, choosing harsh words, and warning that such forces would be dealt with by Congress workers themselves. TPCC president Mahesh Kumar Goud has sought to play down the developments, saying the party high command would take appropriate action at the right time against the dissenting voices. Behind the public exchanges is understood to be growing discontent among MLAs over the distribution of government development funds. Several legislators feel that influential Ministers and senior leaders are cornering a disproportionate share of funds for their constituencies, leaving other elected representatives struggling. The MLAs do not necessarily object to the Chief Minister giving funds to his own constituency, Kodangal, as such a practice was followed by successive Chief Ministers. N. Chandrababu Naidu, Y.S. Rajasekhara Reddy and N. Kiran Kumar Reddy in the undivided Andhra Pradesh, and K. Chandrashekar Rao after the formation of Telangana, had all prioritised development in their respective constituencies over others. The trend has continued under Mr. Revanth Reddy.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: However, the complaint among some Congress legislators is directed more at a few senior Ministers, who they believe are able to secure a larger share of development resources for their constituencies. Resolving this discontent could therefore be among the important issues confronting the new AICC in-charge.

Jadcherla MLA Anirudh Reddy has also been openly expressing his dissatisfaction with certain Ministers and has even written to the Congress high command seeking action against them. The public criticism by the two legislators has put the party leadership in an uncomfortable position, particularly as the government is approaching the completion of three years in office. Chief Minister A Revanth Reddy responded strongly, albeit indirectly, to Mr. Rajgopal Reddy’s criticism and personal attack. Addressing a public meeting in Siddipet, Mr. Revanth Reddy sent a strong message in his inimitable style, choosing harsh words, and warning that such forces would be dealt with by Congress workers themselves. TPCC president Mahesh Kumar Goud has sought to play down the developments, saying the party high command would take appropriate action at the right time against the dissenting voices. Behind the public exchanges is understood to be growing discontent among MLAs over the distribution of government development funds. Several legislators feel that influential Ministers and senior leaders are cornering a disproportionate share of funds for their constituencies, leaving other elected representatives struggling. The MLAs do not necessarily object to the Chief Minister giving funds to his own constituency, Kodangal, as such a practice was followed by successive Chief Ministers. N. Chandrababu Naidu, Y.S. Rajasekhara Reddy and N. Kiran Kumar Reddy in the undivided Andhra Pradesh, and K. Chandrashekar Rao after the formation of Telangana, had all prioritised development in their respective constituencies over others. The trend has continued under Mr. Revanth Reddy.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: However, the complaint among some Congress legislators is directed more at a few senior Ministers, who they believe are able to secure a larger share of development resources for their constituencies. Resolving this discontent could therefore be among the important issues confronting the new AICC in-charge.
