🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #8 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 New AICC in-charge B.M. Sandeep to face challenges in Telangana Congress on his maiden visit

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 03:26:30 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Telangana Congress MLAs are openly criticising the government, senior Ministers over disproportioonate fund allocations

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The newly appointed All India Congress Committee (AICC) secretary in-charge of Telangana, B.M. Sandeep, will make his maiden visit to Hyderabad on Sunday (November 22, 2026) , at a time when the ruling Congress is grappling with an unusual challenge of some of its own MLAs openly criticising the government and targeting senior Ministers. Mr. Sandeep, who is relatively unfamiliar to most Congress leaders in Telangana, has his task cut out for him as he seeks to establish his authority and restore discipline in a party whose internal differences have increasingly spilled into the public domain. One of his immediate challenges will be to deal with senior leaders such as Munugode MLA Komatireddy Rajgopal Reddy, who has made personal remarks against Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy, while claiming that he was compelled to speak out in the party’s and his constituency interests. Interestingly, the party high command is understood to have asked Mr. Rajgopal Reddy to meet Mr. Sandeep personally during the latter’s visit. Whether the senior MLA responds to the invitation and attends the meeting remains to be seen. Jadcherla MLA Anirudh Reddy has also been openly expressing his dissatisfaction with certain Ministers and has even written to the Congress high command seeking action against them. The public criticism by the two legislators has put the party leadership in an uncomfortable position, particularly as the government is approaching the completion of three years in office. Chief Minister A Revanth Reddy responded strongly, albeit indirectly, to Mr. Rajgopal Reddy’s criticism and personal attack. Addressing a public meeting in Siddipet, Mr. Revanth Reddy sent a strong message in his inimitable style, choosing harsh words, and warning that such forces would be dealt with by Congress workers themselves. TPCC president Mahesh Kumar Goud has sought to play down the developments, saying the party high command would take appropriate action at the right time against the dissenting voices. Behind the public exchanges is understood to be growing discontent among MLAs over the distribution of government development funds. Several legislators feel that influential Ministers and senior leaders are cornering a disproportionate share of funds for their constituencies, leaving other elected representatives struggling. The MLAs do not necessarily object to the Chief Minister giving funds to his own constituency, Kodangal, as such a practice was followed by successive Chief Ministers. N. Chandrababu Naidu, Y.S. Rajasekhara Reddy and N. Kiran Kumar Reddy in the undivided Andhra Pradesh, and K. Chandrashekar Rao after the formation of Telangana, had all prioritised development in their respective constituencies over others. The trend has continued under Mr. Revanth Reddy.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: However, the complaint among some Congress legislators is directed more at a few senior Ministers, who they believe are able to secure a larger share of development resources for their constituencies. Resolving this discontent could therefore be among the important issues confronting the new AICC in-charge.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Constitutional (Adjective)
संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप।
✓ Syn: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful  |  ✖ Ant: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary
Dissatisfaction (Adjective / Verb)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Dissatisfaction' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Distribution (Adjective / Verb)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Distribution' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Development (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Development' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "New AICC in-charge B.M. Sandeep to face challenges in Telangana Congress on his maiden visit", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Telangana Congress MLAs are openly criticising the government, senior Ministers over disproportioonate fund allocations.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'New AICC in-charge B.M. Sandeep to face challeng' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'New AICC in-charge B.M. Sandeep to face chall' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'New AICC in-charge B.M. Sandeep to face chall' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Telangana Congress MLAs are openly criticising the government, senior Ministers over disproportioonate fund allocations." (Hinglish Arth: तेलंगाना कांग्रेस के विधायक बेहिसाब फंड आवंटन को लेकर सरकार, वरिष्ठ मंत्रियों की खुलेआम आलोचना कर रहे हैं)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "New AICC in-charge B.M. Sandeep to face challenges in Telangana Congress on his maiden visit"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Resolving this discontent could therefore be among the important issues confronting the new AICC in-charge.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Resolving this discontent could therefore be among the important issues confronting the new AICC in-charge." (Hinglish Arth: इसलिए इस असंतोष को हल करना नए एआईसीसी प्रभारी के सामने महत्वपूर्ण मुद्दों में से एक हो सकता है।)

articles.title: Tamil Nadu government clears another ₹387 crore for urban infrastructure works
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Of the total projects approved, the majority relates to roads; 1,540 road works have been approved across Tamil Nadu

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Less than a month after sanctioning 2,880 infrastructure works worth ₹376.65 crore across urban local bodies , the Tamil Nadu government has approved another 1,604 projects worth ₹386.91 crore for 2026-27. The recent Government Orders issued by the State cover road improvements, water supply, parks, and gasifier crematoriums in municipalities, corporations, and town panchayats. The projects were approved at the second meeting of the Common Project Sanctioning and Monitoring Committee held on October 27, 2026. The Municipal Administration and Water Supply Department issued two Government Orders on November 18, according administrative sanction to these works under the Chief Minister’s Integrated Urban Development Mission (CMIUDM). Of the total, 730 projects worth ₹132.333 crore will be taken up in municipalities and corporations, excluding Greater Chennai Corporation. Of the total projects approved, the majority relates to roads — 1,540 road works have been approved across Tamil Nadu. Over 253 km of roads in municipalities, corporations, and town panchayats and are set to be laid or renewed under the fresh ₹386.91-crore infrastructure package. However, the orders sanctioning the works do not specify a completion schedule. Of the 1,540 road works, 851 are in town panchayats, covering 140.02 km, while 689 are in municipalities and corporation (113.202 km). The town panchayat works include 112 conversions of earthen roads into bituminous roads and 132 into cement concrete roads. The remaining works in this category involve renewal of existing bituminous and cement concrete roads. In municipalities and corporations, the approved works include renewal of 469 bituminous roads, 199 cement concrete roads, and 21 interlocking paver block roads. Notably, the G.O.s do not specify the criteria used to select the roads, whether condition surveys were conducted by the local bodies, or when they were last carried out. They also do not provide project-wise details of progress, expenditure or quality inspections, including how many of the works sanctioned in October have commenced. The package also includes 39 parks and two water supply projects, in Cumbum and Cuddalore, at a combined cost of ₹78.60 crore. The town panchayat package further includes 10 water supply projects costing ₹169.27 crore, seven gasifier crematoriums worth ₹12.45 crore, and six parks costing ₹1.02 crore.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The CMIUDM will contribute ₹354.416 crore towards the combined project cost, while the respective urban local bodies will contribute ₹32.497 crore.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Tamil Nadu government clears another ₹387 crore for urban infrastructure works

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 03:25:47 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Of the total projects approved, the majority relates to roads; 1,540 road works have been approved across Tamil Nadu

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Less than a month after sanctioning 2,880 infrastructure works worth ₹376.65 crore across urban local bodies , the Tamil Nadu government has approved another 1,604 projects worth ₹386.91 crore for 2026-27. The recent Government Orders issued by the State cover road improvements, water supply, parks, and gasifier crematoriums in municipalities, corporations, and town panchayats. The projects were approved at the second meeting of the Common Project Sanctioning and Monitoring Committee held on October 27, 2026. The Municipal Administration and Water Supply Department issued two Government Orders on November 18, according administrative sanction to these works under the Chief Minister’s Integrated Urban Development Mission (CMIUDM). Of the total, 730 projects worth ₹132.333 crore will be taken up in municipalities and corporations, excluding Greater Chennai Corporation. Of the total projects approved, the majority relates to roads — 1,540 road works have been approved across Tamil Nadu. Over 253 km of roads in municipalities, corporations, and town panchayats and are set to be laid or renewed under the fresh ₹386.91-crore infrastructure package. However, the orders sanctioning the works do not specify a completion schedule. Of the 1,540 road works, 851 are in town panchayats, covering 140.02 km, while 689 are in municipalities and corporation (113.202 km). The town panchayat works include 112 conversions of earthen roads into bituminous roads and 132 into cement concrete roads. The remaining works in this category involve renewal of existing bituminous and cement concrete roads. In municipalities and corporations, the approved works include renewal of 469 bituminous roads, 199 cement concrete roads, and 21 interlocking paver block roads. Notably, the G.O.s do not specify the criteria used to select the roads, whether condition surveys were conducted by the local bodies, or when they were last carried out. They also do not provide project-wise details of progress, expenditure or quality inspections, including how many of the works sanctioned in October have commenced. The package also includes 39 parks and two water supply projects, in Cumbum and Cuddalore, at a combined cost of ₹78.60 crore. The town panchayat package further includes 10 water supply projects costing ₹169.27 crore, seven gasifier crematoriums worth ₹12.45 crore, and six parks costing ₹1.02 crore.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The CMIUDM will contribute ₹354.416 crore towards the combined project cost, while the respective urban local bodies will contribute ₹32.497 crore.

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Administration' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Development' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Corporation (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Corporation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Department (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Department' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।

🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Tamil Nadu government clears another ₹387 crore for urban infrastructure works", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Of the total projects approved, the majority relates to roads; 1,540 road works have been approved across Tamil Nadu.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Tamil Nadu government clears another ₹387 crore ' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Tamil Nadu government clears another ₹387 cro' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Tamil Nadu government clears another ₹387 cro' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Of the total projects approved, the majority relates to roads; 1,540 road works have been approved across Tamil Nadu." (Hinglish Arth: स्वीकृत कुल परियोजनाओं में से अधिकांश सड़कों से संबंधित हैं; पूरे तमिलनाडु में 1,540 सड़क कार्यों को मंजूरी दी गई है)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Tamil Nadu government clears another ₹387 crore for urban infrastructure works"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. The CMIUDM will contribute ₹354.416 crore towards the combined project cost, while the respective urban local bodies will contribute ₹32.497 crore.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The CMIUDM will contribute ₹354.416 crore towards the combined project cost, while the respective urban local bodies will contribute ₹32.497 crore." (Hinglish Arth: सीएमआईयूडीएम संयुक्त परियोजना लागत के लिए ₹354.416 करोड़ का योगदान देगा, जबकि संबंधित शहरी स्थानीय निकाय ₹32.497 करोड़ का योगदान देंगे।)

articles.title: Karnataka Cabinet clears 15 lakh free sites, one lakh houses
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The decisions were taken at the Cabinet meeting chaired by Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar on November 19

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Karnataka Cabinet has approved the distribution of 15 lakh free residential sites to landless families and construction of one lakh houses during 2026-27 at an estimated cost of ₹2,241 crore. The decisions were taken at the Cabinet meeting chaired by Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar on November 19. The initiatives aim to provide housing security to families without residential sites and those unable to afford house construction. Under the proposed Bhooguarantee scheme of the Karnataka government, the first phase will cover five lakh sites at an estimated cost of ₹1,000 crore. The government plans to develop nine lakh sites in rural areas, requiring around 45,000 acres, while five lakh urban beneficiaries will be accommodated through a G+3 housing model, according to a press release. The government has identified 23,500 acres of government land across 31 districts, sufficient for about 4.70 lakh sites. District administrations have been asked to identify additional land. The first-phase development cost is estimated at ₹20,000 per site. The proposed Niveshana Yojane will provide sites to eligible landless families, including ex-servicemen, with a 3% reservation for former defence personnel. Priority will also be given to senior citizens, widows, divorced persons, single mothers, persons with disabilities and transgender persons. The proposed reservation includes 19.5% for Scheduled Castes and 7.5% for Scheduled Tribes. The Chief Minister has also directed officials to provide for reservation for Backward Classes. Eligible families must hold a Priority Household or Antyodaya Anna Yojana ration card. Annual family income should not exceed ₹1.20 lakh in rural areas and ₹2 lakh in urban areas. Applications will be invited online through Nadakacheri, Grama One and other government service centres, with Aadhaar-based verification to prevent duplication. The government has also decided to waive stamp duty and registration charges for beneficiaries. Digital ownership documents will be issued through the respective Tahsildars. Separately, the Cabinet approved one lakh houses under various schemes, including Basava Vasati Yojane, Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Nivas Yojane and Vajpayee Urban Housing Scheme.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Under the Beneficiary-Led Construction model, assistance for general category beneficiaries has been increased from ₹1.20 lakh to ₹2 lakh, while SC/ST beneficiaries will receive ₹3 lakh against the earlier ₹2 lakh.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Karnataka Cabinet clears 15 lakh free sites, one lakh houses

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 03:23:45 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The decisions were taken at the Cabinet meeting chaired by Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar on November 19

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Karnataka Cabinet has approved the distribution of 15 lakh free residential sites to landless families and construction of one lakh houses during 2026-27 at an estimated cost of ₹2,241 crore. The decisions were taken at the Cabinet meeting chaired by Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar on November 19. The initiatives aim to provide housing security to families without residential sites and those unable to afford house construction. Under the proposed Bhooguarantee scheme of the Karnataka government, the first phase will cover five lakh sites at an estimated cost of ₹1,000 crore. The government plans to develop nine lakh sites in rural areas, requiring around 45,000 acres, while five lakh urban beneficiaries will be accommodated through a G+3 housing model, according to a press release. The government has identified 23,500 acres of government land across 31 districts, sufficient for about 4.70 lakh sites. District administrations have been asked to identify additional land. The first-phase development cost is estimated at ₹20,000 per site. The proposed Niveshana Yojane will provide sites to eligible landless families, including ex-servicemen, with a 3% reservation for former defence personnel. Priority will also be given to senior citizens, widows, divorced persons, single mothers, persons with disabilities and transgender persons. The proposed reservation includes 19.5% for Scheduled Castes and 7.5% for Scheduled Tribes. The Chief Minister has also directed officials to provide for reservation for Backward Classes. Eligible families must hold a Priority Household or Antyodaya Anna Yojana ration card. Annual family income should not exceed ₹1.20 lakh in rural areas and ₹2 lakh in urban areas. Applications will be invited online through Nadakacheri, Grama One and other government service centres, with Aadhaar-based verification to prevent duplication. The government has also decided to waive stamp duty and registration charges for beneficiaries. Digital ownership documents will be issued through the respective Tahsildars. Separately, the Cabinet approved one lakh houses under various schemes, including Basava Vasati Yojane, Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Nivas Yojane and Vajpayee Urban Housing Scheme.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Under the Beneficiary-Led Construction model, assistance for general category beneficiaries has been increased from ₹1.20 lakh to ₹2 lakh, while SC/ST beneficiaries will receive ₹3 lakh against the earlier ₹2 lakh.

articles.title: Kerala Pradesh Mahila Congress stages ‘Kerala Jantar Mantar’ protest outside Lok Bhavan demanding resignation of CEC Gyanesh Kumar
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Deepa Dasmunsi, AICC general secretary in charge of the State, said Congress party will continue with its protests until Gyanesh Kumar resigns as CEC

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Kerala Pradesh Mahila Congress, the women’s wing of the Congress party in Keralam, on Saturday put an effigy of Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar on public trial outside the Keralam Lok Bhavan, demanding Mr. Kumar’s resignation in connection with the contentious Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of the electoral roll. Inaugurating the event titled ‘Kerala Jantar Mantar,’ Deepa Dasmunsi, the AICC general secretary in charge of the State, said the Congress party will continue with its protests until Mr. Kumar resigns as CEC. “The Congress will continue to stand for democracy, the people of India and the Constitution,” Ms. Dasmunsi said. Congress workers, she said, have the responsibility to stand with the people whose names have been deleted. Adoor Prakash MP, convener of the Congress-led United Democratic Front (UDF), underscored the need for concerted efforts to protect democracy and the Constitution. “It is impossible to turn a blind eye towards attempts being made by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Home Minister Amit Shah and CEC Gyanesh Kumar to overturn the nation’s democratic system,” he said. Minister for Culture and KPCC working president P.C. Vishnunadh said the “success” of the ongoing struggle of the Congress party led by Rahul Gandhi was “important to prevent Indian democracy from being imperilled.” Mahila Congress State president Jebi Mather described the fight against SIR as “a second freedom struggle” led by Mr. Gandhi and Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge. The Congress has recreated Jantar Mantar outside the Lok Bhavan in Thiruvananthapuram against the backdrop of the BJP government suppressing protests in Jantar Mantar in New Delhi, she said. Mahila Congress State general secretary Jayalakshmi Dathan read out a pledge to the assembled workers that they will continue to work for the protection of the Constitution.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: KSU State president Aloshious Xavier, former Minister V.S. Sivakumar and KPCC general secretary Neyyatinkara Sanal were among those present.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Kerala Pradesh Mahila Congress stages ‘Kerala Jantar Mantar’ protest outside Lok Bhavan demanding resignation of CEC Gyanesh Kumar

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 03:08:30 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Deepa Dasmunsi, AICC general secretary in charge of the State, said Congress party will continue with its protests until Gyanesh Kumar resigns as CEC

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Kerala Pradesh Mahila Congress, the women’s wing of the Congress party in Keralam, on Saturday put an effigy of Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar on public trial outside the Keralam Lok Bhavan, demanding Mr. Kumar’s resignation in connection with the contentious Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of the electoral roll. Inaugurating the event titled ‘Kerala Jantar Mantar,’ Deepa Dasmunsi, the AICC general secretary in charge of the State, said the Congress party will continue with its protests until Mr. Kumar resigns as CEC. “The Congress will continue to stand for democracy, the people of India and the Constitution,” Ms. Dasmunsi said. Congress workers, she said, have the responsibility to stand with the people whose names have been deleted. Adoor Prakash MP, convener of the Congress-led United Democratic Front (UDF), underscored the need for concerted efforts to protect democracy and the Constitution. “It is impossible to turn a blind eye towards attempts being made by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Home Minister Amit Shah and CEC Gyanesh Kumar to overturn the nation’s democratic system,” he said. Minister for Culture and KPCC working president P.C. Vishnunadh said the “success” of the ongoing struggle of the Congress party led by Rahul Gandhi was “important to prevent Indian democracy from being imperilled.” Mahila Congress State president Jebi Mather described the fight against SIR as “a second freedom struggle” led by Mr. Gandhi and Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge. The Congress has recreated Jantar Mantar outside the Lok Bhavan in Thiruvananthapuram against the backdrop of the BJP government suppressing protests in Jantar Mantar in New Delhi, she said. Mahila Congress State general secretary Jayalakshmi Dathan read out a pledge to the assembled workers that they will continue to work for the protection of the Constitution.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: KSU State president Aloshious Xavier, former Minister V.S. Sivakumar and KPCC general secretary Neyyatinkara Sanal were among those present.

Constitutional (Adjective)
संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप।
✓ Syn: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful  |  ✖ Ant: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary
Responsibility (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Responsibility' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Resignation (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Resignation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Contentious (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Contentious' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Kerala Pradesh Mahila Congress stages ‘Kerala Jantar Mantar’ protest outside Lok Bhavan demanding resignation of CEC Gyanesh Kumar", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Deepa Dasmunsi, AICC general secretary in charge of the State, said Congress party will continue with its protests until Gyanesh Kumar resigns as CEC.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Kerala Pradesh Mahila Congress stages ‘Kerala Ja' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Kerala Pradesh Mahila Congress stages ‘Kerala' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Kerala Pradesh Mahila Congress stages ‘Kerala' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Deepa Dasmunsi, AICC general secretary in charge of the State, said Congress party will continue with its protests until Gyanesh Kumar resigns as CEC." (Hinglish Arth: एआईसीसी की राज्य प्रभारी महासचिव दीपा दासमुंशी ने कहा कि जब तक ज्ञानेश कुमार सीईसी पद से इस्तीफा नहीं दे देते, तब तक कांग्रेस पार्टी अपना विरोध प्रदर्शन जारी रखेगी।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Kerala Pradesh Mahila Congress stages ‘Kerala Jantar Mantar’ protest outside Lok Bhavan demanding resignation of CEC Gyanesh Kumar"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Sivakumar and KPCC general secretary Neyyatinkara Sanal were among those present.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Sivakumar and KPCC general secretary Neyyatinkara Sanal were among those present." (Hinglish Arth: शिवकुमार और केपीसीसी महासचिव नेय्यातिनकारा सनल भी उपस्थित थे।)

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: In its letter to the Chief Minister, the Commission said his statement was directly relevant to its mandate of examining whether eligible electors were unfairly removed from the rolls during the SIR exercise

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Independent Commission on the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls, a civil society initiative, wrote to Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath on Saturday (November 21), requesting him to share supporting material or data relating to his reported public statement that about 1.27 crore Hindus from the State have been excluded from the voters’ list. Lokur. The members of the Commission include former Supreme Court judge, Justice A.K. Patnaik; Justice Badar Durrez Ahmad, former Chief Justice of the Jammu and Kashmir High Court; Justice Rekha Sharma, former judge of the Delhi High Court; and Justice Anjana Prakash, former judge of the Patna High Court. In its letter to the Chief Minister, the Commission said his statement was directly relevant to its mandate of examining whether eligible electors were unfairly removed from the rolls during the SIR exercise. The five-member Commission is independently evaluating the “constitutional and statutory validity, methodology, and overall impact of the SIR exercise on eligible voters”. “Your public statement, which was widely reported in the media, to the effect that 1.27 crore Hindus from Uttar Pradesh have been excluded from the voters’ list is particularly relevant to the mandate. The Commission requests you to kindly furnish any supporting material, or any substantive data, or anything that may indicate the gaps in methodology, which may have resulted in such alleged deletions. We will examine the material with complete autonomy and impartiality to arrive at our final findings,” the Commission’s letter said. It urged the Chief Minister not to delay his response owing to the urgency of the issue because of impending elections in Uttar Pradesh, and the possible denial of voting rights of millions of electors. “The Commission is working with a tight timeline and would appreciate it if the necessary material is provided at the earliest,” the Commission said, providing its email to Chief Minister Adityanath.

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: In its letter to the Chief Minister, the Commission said his statement was directly relevant to its mandate of examining whether eligible electors were unfairly removed from the rolls during the SIR exercise
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Independent Commission on the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls, a civil society initiative, wrote to Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath on Saturday (November 21), requesting him to share supporting material or data relating to his reported public statement that about 1.27 crore Hindus from the State have been excluded from the voters’ list. The Commission, which was initiated by a body of Supreme Court and High Court lawyers called the Lawyers Association for Constitution (LAFC) to respond to widespread concerns about the SIR, is chaired by former apex court judge, Justice Madan B. Lokur. The members of the Commission include former Supreme Court judge, Justice A.K. Patnaik; Justice Badar Durrez Ahmad, former Chief Justice of the Jammu and Kashmir High Court; Justice Rekha Sharma, former judge of the Delhi High Court; and Justice Anjana Prakash, former judge of the Patna High Court. In its letter to the Chief Minister, the Commission said his statement was directly relevant to its mandate of examining whether eligible electors were unfairly removed from the rolls during the SIR exercise. The five-member Commission is independently evaluating the “constitutional and statutory validity, methodology, and overall impact of the SIR exercise on eligible voters”. “Your public statement, which was widely reported in the media, to the effect that 1.27 crore Hindus from Uttar Pradesh have been excluded from the voters’ list is particularly relevant to the mandate. The Commission requests you to kindly furnish any supporting material, or any substantive data, or anything that may indicate the gaps in methodology, which may have resulted in such alleged deletions. We will examine the material with complete autonomy and impartiality to arrive at our final findings,” the Commission’s letter said. It urged the Chief Minister not to delay his response owing to the urgency of the issue because of impending elections in Uttar Pradesh, and the possible denial of voting rights of millions of electors. “The Commission is working with a tight timeline and would appreciate it if the necessary material is provided at the earliest,” the Commission said, providing its email to Chief Minister Adityanath.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: India / Uttar Pradesh / election / Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls / politics / government

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Humaiun Kobir said law enforcement agencies were working to bring those responsible to justice and alleged that the Awami League’s leadership, including those based abroad, was encouraging the attacks

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Bangladesh will take firm legal action against those behind recent arson and petrol bomb attacks, State Minister for Foreign Affairs Humaiun Kobir has said, blaming groups linked to the banned Awami League for the violence amid escalating political unrest in the country, according to local media reports. Mr. Kobir, on Friday (November 20, 2026), said law enforcement agencies were working to bring those responsible to justice and alleged that the Awami League's leadership, including those based abroad, was encouraging the attacks. "We will go after these terrorists, and the long arm of justice will reach them," he said, responding to questions from reporters on the sidelines of a media briefing, according to the state-run BSS news agency. Mr. Kobir alleged that the Awami League leadership was encouraging the attacks from abroad and that others based overseas were also involved in efforts to instigate violence. The Minister’s remarks come amid a spate of political violence and arson attacks across Bangladesh. At least four people were killed in separate incidents earlier this week, including three leaders of the ruling BNP and its affiliated organisations and a bus helper who was burnt alive after unidentified assailants set fire to parked buses, the Dhaka Tribune reported. In separate remarks at the Foreign Ministry, Mr. Kobir described the Awami League, whose political activities remain banned, as a "terrorist organisation" and warned of strong action against those involved in petrol bomb attacks, arson and other violence, The Daily Star reported. 📰 Bangladesh Minister vows action against those behind arson, blames Awami League-linked groups, says reports

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 03:25:13 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Humaiun Kobir said law enforcement agencies were working to bring those responsible to justice and alleged that the Awami League’s leadership, including those based abroad, was encouraging the attacks

Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Bangladesh will take firm legal action against those behind recent arson and petrol bomb attacks, State Minister for Foreign Affairs Humaiun Kobir has said, blaming groups linked to the banned Awami League for the violence amid escalating political unrest in the country, according to local media reports. Mr. Kobir, on Friday (November 20, 2026), said law enforcement agencies were working to bring those responsible to justice and alleged that the Awami League's leadership, including those based abroad, was encouraging the attacks. "We will go after these terrorists, and the long arm of justice will reach them," he said, responding to questions from reporters on the sidelines of a media briefing, according to the state-run BSS news agency. Mr. Kobir alleged that the Awami League leadership was encouraging the attacks from abroad and that others based overseas were also involved in efforts to instigate violence. The Minister’s remarks come amid a spate of political violence and arson attacks across Bangladesh. At least four people were killed in separate incidents earlier this week, including three leaders of the ruling BNP and its affiliated organisations and a bus helper who was burnt alive after unidentified assailants set fire to parked buses, the Dhaka Tribune reported. In separate remarks at the Foreign Ministry, Mr. Kobir described the Awami League, whose political activities remain banned, as a "terrorist organisation" and warned of strong action against those involved in petrol bomb attacks, arson and other violence, The Daily Star reported. articles.title: Kozhikode DIET launches ‘Munnettu’ to bridge academic gap among tribal students
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: ‘Action plans are being devised and executed to enhance the quality of the students’ education, while also encouraging their participation in non-academic activities.’

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The District Institute of Education and Training (DIET), Kozhikode, has launched an initiative titled ‘Munnettu’ to ensure comprehensive academic support for students from Scheduled Tribe communities, who are residents of pre-matric hostels in the district. According to U.K. Abdunnasar, Principal, DIET, Kozhikode, the project was conceived after a study by the DIET found serious academic and learning gaps and other social-emotional challenges among the residents of these hostels. Mr. Abdunnasar says that between 25 and 50 students are each staying in pre-matric hostels located at Kozhikode city, Vadakara, Eengappuzha, and Kunnamangalam. The DIET study found that most of the students up to Class VII have severe deficiencies related to functional literacy and functional numeracy. Those in higher classes were finding it difficult to clear written exams. They were found to have been lagging behind in subjects like English, Mathematics, Social Studies, and Malayalam. Though tutors have been appointed to take care of their academic performance, quite often they lack specific skills to address the situation, Mr. Abdunnasar says. According to sources, some of the schools are also deploying scribes to help these students clear board exams, which is also affecting their morale and confidence levels. Mr. Abdunnasar says that action plans are being devised and executed to enhance the quality of the students’ education, while also encouraging their participation in non-academic activities. In the first phase, a programme aimed at ensuring foundational skills in Mathematics and languages was launched at the pre-matric hostel, Vadakara, to mark Children’s Day on November 14. The Scheduled Tribes Development department is collaborating with the initiative.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: A month-long special study programme will soon be implemented across all tribal hostels in the district, by empowering the tutors stationed at each of these hostels. At every stage, relevant learning support modules will be utilised for the training of the tutors, Mr. Abdunnasar says. The effort is to bring about a marked improvement in the next two months, he adds.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #7 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Kozhikode DIET launches ‘Munnettu’ to bridge academic gap among tribal students

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 05:23:42 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: ‘Action plans are being devised and executed to enhance the quality of the students’ education, while also encouraging their participation in non-academic activities.’

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The District Institute of Education and Training (DIET), Kozhikode, has launched an initiative titled ‘Munnettu’ to ensure comprehensive academic support for students from Scheduled Tribe communities, who are residents of pre-matric hostels in the district. According to U.K. Abdunnasar, Principal, DIET, Kozhikode, the project was conceived after a study by the DIET found serious academic and learning gaps and other social-emotional challenges among the residents of these hostels. Mr. Abdunnasar says that between 25 and 50 students are each staying in pre-matric hostels located at Kozhikode city, Vadakara, Eengappuzha, and Kunnamangalam. The DIET study found that most of the students up to Class VII have severe deficiencies related to functional literacy and functional numeracy. Those in higher classes were finding it difficult to clear written exams. They were found to have been lagging behind in subjects like English, Mathematics, Social Studies, and Malayalam. Though tutors have been appointed to take care of their academic performance, quite often they lack specific skills to address the situation, Mr. Abdunnasar says. According to sources, some of the schools are also deploying scribes to help these students clear board exams, which is also affecting their morale and confidence levels. Mr. Abdunnasar says that action plans are being devised and executed to enhance the quality of the students’ education, while also encouraging their participation in non-academic activities. In the first phase, a programme aimed at ensuring foundational skills in Mathematics and languages was launched at the pre-matric hostel, Vadakara, to mark Children’s Day on November 14. The Scheduled Tribes Development department is collaborating with the initiative.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: A month-long special study programme will soon be implemented across all tribal hostels in the district, by empowering the tutors stationed at each of these hostels. At every stage, relevant learning support modules will be utilised for the training of the tutors, Mr. Abdunnasar says. The effort is to bring about a marked improvement in the next two months, he adds.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Implementation (Noun)
क्रियान्वयन / ज़मीनी स्तर पर लागू करना — किसी योजना या फैसले को असलियत में पूरा करना।
✓ Syn: Execution, Enforcement, Fulfillment  |  ✖ Ant: Abandonment, Neglect, Cancellation
Institutional (Adjective)
संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।
✓ Syn: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional  |  ✖ Ant: Individual, Informal, Unorganized
Participation (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Participation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Comprehensive (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Comprehensive' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Kozhikode DIET launches ‘Munnettu’ to bridge academic gap among tribal students", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. ‘Action plans are being devised and executed to enhance the quality of the students’ education, while also encouraging their participation in...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Kozhikode DIET launches ‘Munnettu’ to bridge aca' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Kozhikode DIET launches ‘Munnettu’ to bridge ' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Kozhikode DIET launches ‘Munnettu’ to bridge ' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "‘Action plans are being devised and executed to enhance the quality of the students’ education, while also encouraging their participation in..." (Hinglish Arth: 'छात्रों की शिक्षा की गुणवत्ता बढ़ाने के साथ-साथ गैर-शैक्षणिक गतिविधियों में उनकी भागीदारी को प्रोत्साहित करने के लिए कार्य योजनाएँ तैयार और क्रियान्वित की जा रही हैं।')
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Kozhikode DIET launches ‘Munnettu’ to bridge academic gap among tribal students"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. The effort is to bring about a marked improvement in the next two months, he adds.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The effort is to bring about a marked improvement in the next two months, he adds." (Hinglish Arth: उन्होंने कहा कि अगले दो महीनों में उल्लेखनीय सुधार लाने का प्रयास किया जा रहा है।)

articles.title: Nobody in India faces religious discrimination: Rijiju amid Siraj row
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The remarks of the Minister and BJP leaders came after Masood, the MP from Saharanpur and U.P. Congress working president, allegedly said that Siraj was not given a place in the side because of his name

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Minority Affairs Minister Kiren Rijiju and Uttar Pradesh BJP leaders on Friday (November 20, 2026) slammed Congress MP Imran Masood, dismissing his insinuation of communal bias in dropping fast bowler Mohammed Siraj from the playing XI in the ongoing cricket Test match against New Zealand. They said nobody in India is discriminated against or overlooked on the basis of their religion. The remarks of the Minister and BJP leaders came after Mr. Masood, the MP from Saharanpur and U.P. Congress working president, allegedly said that Mr. Siraj was not given a place in the side because of his name. One's religion or caste has nothing to do with it, he added. "If someone feels this way, it is not right. The PM said that we are all one and we have a goal of 'Sabka Saath, Sabka Vikas' and 'Ek Bharat Shreshth Bharat', then there is no need to create divides on the basis of caste or religion," Mr. Rijiju said. Slamming the Congress over Mr. Masood's remarks, BJP national spokesperson Pradeep Bhandari said on X, "Shame on Congress party! Congress party did not even leave the Indian cricket team from its vote bank politics! Congress party is communal!" "A person wearing Indian jersey is Indian! Congress party always chooses vote bank politics over India's National interest!" Mr. Bhandari said. Mr. Masood's remarks drew a sharp rebuttal from the U.P. BJP leaders who accused the Congress MP of engaging in appeasement politics. "He is playing the dangerous game of polarisation and appeasement politics. In India, people aren't selected for national teams on the basis of their religion," U.P. Minister of State for Minority Welfare and Haj Danish Azad Ansari told PTI.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Accusing the Congress party of stirring the pot of communal polarisation, he said, "The Congress is unable to digest that the country is moving forward with the motto of 'sabka saath, sabka vikas', and thus, it (the Opposition party) is busy playing its divisive game."

Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Minority Affairs Minister Kiren Rijiju and Uttar Pradesh BJP leaders on Friday (November 20, 2026) slammed Congress MP Imran Masood, dismissing his insinuation of communal bias in dropping fast bowler Mohammed Siraj from the playing XI in the ongoing cricket Test match against New Zealand. They said nobody in India is discriminated against or overlooked on the basis of their religion. The remarks of the Minister and BJP leaders came after Mr. Masood, the MP from Saharanpur and U.P. Congress working president, allegedly said that Mr. Siraj was not given a place in the side because of his name. One's religion or caste has nothing to do with it, he added. "If someone feels this way, it is not right. The PM said that we are all one and we have a goal of 'Sabka Saath, Sabka Vikas' and 'Ek Bharat Shreshth Bharat', then there is no need to create divides on the basis of caste or religion," Mr. Rijiju said. Slamming the Congress over Mr. Masood's remarks, BJP national spokesperson Pradeep Bhandari said on X, "Shame on Congress party! Congress party did not even leave the Indian cricket team from its vote bank politics! Congress party is communal!" "A person wearing Indian jersey is Indian! Congress party always chooses vote bank politics over India's National interest!" Mr. Bhandari said. Mr. Masood's remarks drew a sharp rebuttal from the U.P. BJP leaders who accused the Congress MP of engaging in appeasement politics. "He is playing the dangerous game of polarisation and appeasement politics. In India, people aren't selected for national teams on the basis of their religion," U.P. Minister of State for Minority Welfare and Haj Danish Azad Ansari told PTI.

3. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Minority Affairs Minister Kiren Rijiju and Uttar Pradesh BJP leaders on Friday (November 20, 2026) slammed Congress MP Imran Masood, dismissing his insinuation of communal bias in dropping fast bowler Mohammed Siraj from the playing XI in the ongoing cricket Test match against New Zealand. They said nobody in India is discriminated against or overlooked on the basis of their religion. The remarks of the Minister and BJP leaders came after Mr. Masood, the MP from Saharanpur and U.P. Congress working president, allegedly said that Mr. Siraj was not given a place in the side because of his name. One's religion or caste has nothing to do with it, he added. "If someone feels this way, it is not right. The PM said that we are all one and we have a goal of 'Sabka Saath, Sabka Vikas' and 'Ek Bharat Shreshth Bharat', then there is no need to create divides on the basis of caste or religion," Mr. Rijiju said. Slamming the Congress over Mr. Masood's remarks, BJP national spokesperson Pradeep Bhandari said on X, "Shame on Congress party! Congress party did not even leave the Indian cricket team from its vote bank politics! Congress party is communal!" "A person wearing Indian jersey is Indian! Congress party always chooses vote bank politics over India's National interest!" Mr. Bhandari said. Mr. Masood's remarks drew a sharp rebuttal from the U.P. BJP leaders who accused the Congress MP of engaging in appeasement politics. "He is playing the dangerous game of polarisation and appeasement politics. In India, people aren't selected for national teams on the basis of their religion," U.P. Minister of State for Minority Welfare and Haj Danish Azad Ansari told PTI.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Accusing the Congress party of stirring the pot of communal polarisation, he said, "The Congress is unable to digest that the country is moving forward with the motto of 'sabka saath, sabka vikas', and thus, it (the Opposition party) is busy playing its divisive game."

articles.title: Hyderabad’s original IIT-wallah turns 100, Telangana CM pays him a visit
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Before Anand Kumar’s Super 30, before YouTube tutorials and online classes that now bring physics, chemistry and mathematics to IIT aspirants at the click of a button, there was Chukka Ramaiah. For generations of students, the man in the crisp white shirt and dhoti, and an indulgent smile was synonymous with IIT coaching. On Friday, the legendary mathematics teacher turned 100, even as Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy paid him a visit at his Vidyanagar residence.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Chukka Ramaiah, popular IIT coaching expert, flanked by K. Anji Reddy of Dr. Reddy's Laboratories and S. Sadasiva, Urdu scholar, at a convocation. File “The 100th birthday of Chukka Ramaiah is a momentous occasion for the people of Telangana and the education system,” said Mr. Reddy, summing up the contribution of the man who single-handedly pushed hundreds of youth into the rarified world of Indian Institute of Technology (IIT). Chukka Ramaiah, IIT masetro, watching the students writing the exams at the Osmania University campus in Hyderabad on May 06, 2007. Over 14,000 students from all parts of the State appeared for the renowned IIT Ramaiah examination held at Osmania University campus. Only 125 seats in the IIT Ramaiah coaching centre were up for grabs. File | Photo Credit: THE HINDU Born in Gudur village of Warangal district, Ramaiah’s early years took a political turn when he joined Osmania University and got involved in activism, following which he was thrown into Aurangabad district jail. After retiring as a schoolteacher at the AP Residential School in Nagarjunasagar, he turned to coaching IIT aspirants in 1985. Word soon spread about the teacher whose students began arriving at his home before dawn for lessons. As his reputation grew, admission itself became competitive, with aspirants having to clear an entrance test for a place in his classes . His fees, however, remained modest compared to those charged by coaching centres that relied on mailing study material to students. Chukka Ramaiah, MLC and educationist addressing a meeting of the a conference of the United teachers federation (UTF ) in Khammam. File | Photo Credit: G.N. RAO When the Telangana statehood movement gathered momentum in the late 2000s, Ramaiah emerged as one of its intellectual voices. In 2007, he was elected to the Legislative Council. Recalling his contribution as an MLC, Mr. Revanth Reddy said: “Chukka Ramaiah and Professor Nageshwar during their stints as MLCs, held the government accountable by raising questions on social issues and the challenges faced by the public, while also offering constructive solutions.”
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The Chief Minister said the State government would continue to draw on Ramaiah’s thoughts and suggestions as it moves forward.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Hyderabad’s original IIT-wallah turns 100, Telangana CM pays him a visit

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 05:07:06 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Before Anand Kumar’s Super 30, before YouTube tutorials and online classes that now bring physics, chemistry and mathematics to IIT aspirants at the click of a button, there was Chukka Ramaiah. For generations of students, the man in the crisp white shirt and dhoti, and an indulgent smile was synonymous with IIT coaching. On Friday, the legendary mathematics teacher turned 100, even as Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy paid him a visit at his Vidyanagar residence.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Chukka Ramaiah, popular IIT coaching expert, flanked by K. Anji Reddy of Dr. Reddy's Laboratories and S. Sadasiva, Urdu scholar, at a convocation. File “The 100th birthday of Chukka Ramaiah is a momentous occasion for the people of Telangana and the education system,” said Mr. Reddy, summing up the contribution of the man who single-handedly pushed hundreds of youth into the rarified world of Indian Institute of Technology (IIT). Chukka Ramaiah, IIT masetro, watching the students writing the exams at the Osmania University campus in Hyderabad on May 06, 2007. Over 14,000 students from all parts of the State appeared for the renowned IIT Ramaiah examination held at Osmania University campus. Only 125 seats in the IIT Ramaiah coaching centre were up for grabs. File | Photo Credit: THE HINDU Born in Gudur village of Warangal district, Ramaiah’s early years took a political turn when he joined Osmania University and got involved in activism, following which he was thrown into Aurangabad district jail. After retiring as a schoolteacher at the AP Residential School in Nagarjunasagar, he turned to coaching IIT aspirants in 1985. Word soon spread about the teacher whose students began arriving at his home before dawn for lessons. As his reputation grew, admission itself became competitive, with aspirants having to clear an entrance test for a place in his classes . His fees, however, remained modest compared to those charged by coaching centres that relied on mailing study material to students. Chukka Ramaiah, MLC and educationist addressing a meeting of the a conference of the United teachers federation (UTF ) in Khammam. File | Photo Credit: G.N. RAO When the Telangana statehood movement gathered momentum in the late 2000s, Ramaiah emerged as one of its intellectual voices. In 2007, he was elected to the Legislative Council. Recalling his contribution as an MLC, Mr. Revanth Reddy said: “Chukka Ramaiah and Professor Nageshwar during their stints as MLCs, held the government accountable by raising questions on social issues and the challenges faced by the public, while also offering constructive solutions.”

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The Chief Minister said the State government would continue to draw on Ramaiah’s thoughts and suggestions as it moves forward.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Institutional (Adjective)
संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।
✓ Syn: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional  |  ✖ Ant: Individual, Informal, Unorganized
Accountability (Noun)
जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता।
✓ Syn: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability  |  ✖ Ant: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility
Contribution (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Contribution' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Intellectual (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Intellectual' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Hyderabad’s original IIT-wallah turns 100, Telangana CM pays him a visit", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Before Anand Kumar’s Super 30, before YouTube tutorials and online classes that now bring physics, chemistry and mathematics to IIT aspirants at the...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Hyderabad’s original IIT-wallah turns 100, Telan' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Hyderabad’s original IIT-wallah turns 100, Te' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Hyderabad’s original IIT-wallah turns 100, Te' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Before Anand Kumar’s Super 30, before YouTube tutorials and online classes that now bring physics, chemistry and mathematics to IIT aspirants at the..." (Hinglish Arth: आनंद कुमार के सुपर 30 से पहले, यूट्यूब ट्यूटोरियल और ऑनलाइन कक्षाओं से पहले, जो अब एक बटन के क्लिक पर आईआईटी उम्मीदवारों के लिए भौतिकी, रसायन विज्ञान और गणित लाते हैं, चुक्का रमैया थे।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Hyderabad’s original IIT-wallah turns 100, Telangana CM pays him a visit"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. The Chief Minister said the State government would continue to draw on Ramaiah’s thoughts and suggestions as it moves forward.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The Chief Minister said the State government would continue to draw on Ramaiah’s thoughts and suggestions as it moves forward." (Hinglish Arth: मुख्यमंत्री ने कहा कि राज्य सरकार आगे बढ़ने के साथ-साथ रमैया के विचारों और सुझावों को अपनाती रहेगी।)

articles.title: After BJP exit, Padmaja Venugopal apologises to Congress workers, says ‘not seeking any post’
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Her remarks came amid strong criticism from a section of young Congress leaders against her proposed return to the Congress

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Two days after quitting the BJP and announcing her decision to return to the Congress, Padmaja Venugopal on Saturday (November 21, 2026) apologised to Congress workers for joining the saffron party, saying she wished to return only as an ordinary party worker without aspiring for any post. Her remarks came amidst strong criticism from a section of young Congress leaders against her proposed return to the Congress. In a Facebook post, Ms. Venugopal said her decision to join the BJP was a “mistake” made in an emotional moment and that her statement when quitting the party came straight from her heart. She decided to return after realising her move had deeply hurt several Congress workers who loved her father, veteran Congress leader K Karunakaran, as well as her. “I am not returning with any desire for a position. The only thing in my mind is to become a Congress worker,” she said. Ms. Venugopal said she fully accepted the criticism raised by Congress workers from different parts of the State and wished to use the opportunity to sincerely apologise to everyone for the hurt caused to the party and its workers. She added that her only aim was to pay homage at her father’s memorial next month, on his death anniversary, along with her beloved Congress workers. Kerala Students’ Union (KSU) president Aloshious Xavier on Friday cautioned the party leadership against offering prominent positions and privileges to returning leaders without making them work at the grassroots level. Congress spokesperson Jinto John also strongly opposed her return, saying the era of “nepo kids” in the party was over.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Expressing similar displeasure, Congress leader Deepthi Mary Varghese on Saturday said the party leadership should consider the sentiments of its workers before deciding on Ms. Ms. Venugopal return.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 After BJP exit, Padmaja Venugopal apologises to Congress workers, says ‘not seeking any post’

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 05:04:52 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Her remarks came amid strong criticism from a section of young Congress leaders against her proposed return to the Congress

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Two days after quitting the BJP and announcing her decision to return to the Congress, Padmaja Venugopal on Saturday (November 21, 2026) apologised to Congress workers for joining the saffron party, saying she wished to return only as an ordinary party worker without aspiring for any post. Her remarks came amidst strong criticism from a section of young Congress leaders against her proposed return to the Congress. In a Facebook post, Ms. Venugopal said her decision to join the BJP was a “mistake” made in an emotional moment and that her statement when quitting the party came straight from her heart. She decided to return after realising her move had deeply hurt several Congress workers who loved her father, veteran Congress leader K Karunakaran, as well as her. “I am not returning with any desire for a position. The only thing in my mind is to become a Congress worker,” she said. Ms. Venugopal said she fully accepted the criticism raised by Congress workers from different parts of the State and wished to use the opportunity to sincerely apologise to everyone for the hurt caused to the party and its workers. She added that her only aim was to pay homage at her father’s memorial next month, on his death anniversary, along with her beloved Congress workers. Kerala Students’ Union (KSU) president Aloshious Xavier on Friday cautioned the party leadership against offering prominent positions and privileges to returning leaders without making them work at the grassroots level. Congress spokesperson Jinto John also strongly opposed her return, saying the era of “nepo kids” in the party was over.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Expressing similar displeasure, Congress leader Deepthi Mary Varghese on Saturday said the party leadership should consider the sentiments of its workers before deciding on Ms. Ms. Venugopal return.

articles.title: Some government officials working as 'BJP functionaries' ahead of Uttar Pradesh polls: Akhilesh Yadav
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Akhilesh Yadav said discussions are under way with the Congress on seat-sharing and his party would suggest constituencies where the Congress had a chance of winning

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Samajwadi Party president Akhilesh Yadav on Saturday (November 21, 2026) alleged that some government officials were working as "BJP functionaries" ahead of the elections and said that seat-sharing talks are under way with the Congress . Addressing a press conference at the party headquarters in Lucknow, Mr. Yadav said discussions were under way with the Congress on seat-sharing and his party would suggest constituencies where the Congress had a chance of winning. "There are still several seats where the Congress can win. We will make suggestions accordingly. I have said this from the very first day and reiterate it today that discussions are underway. Winnability on seats is the only basis," he said. Asserting that the BJP's removal is necessary to save the democracy and the Constitution, he said, "Winning elections is the only way to achieve this." The former Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister said that getting justice, receiving respect and protecting people's dignity under the Constitution have become a major challenge in the BJP's regime. "If the BJP is removed, these problems will end," he said. He alleged that some police personnel and government officials were working as "BJP functionaries". He said the party would submit a detailed complaint to the Election Commission after consulting its leaders. "We will write to the Election Commission with examples of officials who have continuously worked as BJP functionaries for the last 10 years. The letter will carry signatures of our MLAs, MLCs and members of Parliament from both Houses," he said. 🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Akhilesh Yadav said discussions are under way with the Congress on seat-sharing and his party would suggest constituencies where the Congress had a chance of winning

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Samajwadi Party president Akhilesh Yadav on Saturday (November 21, 2026) alleged that some government officials were working as "BJP functionaries" ahead of the elections and said that seat-sharing talks are under way with the Congress . Addressing a press conference at the party headquarters in Lucknow, Mr. Yadav said discussions were under way with the Congress on seat-sharing and his party would suggest constituencies where the Congress had a chance of winning. "There are still several seats where the Congress can win. We will make suggestions accordingly. I have said this from the very first day and reiterate it today that discussions are underway. Winnability on seats is the only basis," he said. Asserting that the BJP's removal is necessary to save the democracy and the Constitution, he said, "Winning elections is the only way to achieve this." The former Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister said that getting justice, receiving respect and protecting people's dignity under the Constitution have become a major challenge in the BJP's regime. "If the BJP is removed, these problems will end," he said. He alleged that some police personnel and government officials were working as "BJP functionaries". He said the party would submit a detailed complaint to the Election Commission after consulting its leaders. "We will write to the Election Commission with examples of officials who have continuously worked as BJP functionaries for the last 10 years. The letter will carry signatures of our MLAs, MLCs and members of Parliament from both Houses," he said. Alleging that officials were not being transferred despite complaints, Mr. Yadav cited the example of an officer without taking a name who, he claimed, was involved in irregularities during the bypoll in the past. Questioning Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath's reported claim that 1.27 crore Hindu voters had been deleted from electoral rolls, he asked, "What is this divine vision? What is this heavenly information through which he came to know that only 1.27 crore Hindu votes have been deleted", raising questions about the Election Commission.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He alleged that voters belonging to the PDA (Backward, Dalit and Minority) communities were being targeted and claimed that the Election Commission was colluding with the BJP.

articles.title: Convicts’ lawyer rejects claims of Bilkis Bano being kept in dark, warns against media trial
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Supreme Court’s order for the duo’s release on bail came in an appeal filed by them against a 2017 Bombay High Court judgment upholding a CBI court decision of 2008, convicting the men and sentencing them to life terms in prison

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The counsel for the two convicts granted bail by the Supreme Court in the 2002 Bilkis Bano gangrape and murder case issued a statement on November 21 rejected her allegation that she was kept in the dark about the proceedings while warning against an attempt to sensationalise a sub-judice matter through a media trial. The rebuttal by advocate Ayush Anand, counsel for Bipinchand Kanaiyalal Joshi and Pradip Ramanlal Modhiya, followed a public statement issued by Ms. Bano, through her counsel and senior advocate Shobha Gupta, that she was neither informed nor heard before the apex court allowed bail to the two men in an order on October 28. Joshi and Modhiya were two of the 11 men convicted in the 2002 case. The then 19-year-old Ms. Bano was gang-raped and 14 members of her family, including her infant daughter, were killed in 2002 during the riots. The apex court order for the duo’s release on bail came in an appeal filed by them against a 2017 Bombay High Court judgment upholding a CBI court decision of 2008, convicting the men and sentencing them to life terms in prison. Mr. Anand, in his statement, said the allegations of suppression issued by Ms. Bano’s side was factually incorrect. “The matter had been listed on ten occasions before bail was granted and had taken more than a year. In these circumstances, the allegation of suppression by the legal team of the prosecutrix [Ms. Bano], according to the petitioners [Joshi and Modhiya], is entirely misconceived,” the statement said. Mr. Anand said Ms. Bano’s legal team had been both aware of the court proceedings on the appeals and observing them. The lawyer said notice in the case was issued in March 2026, and was reported in the media. “Therefore, the allegation that the prosecutrix was unaware of the proceedings is, according to the petitioners, factually incorrect. The legal team of the prosecutrix did not initiate any proceedings at that stage, despite the matter being pending and notice having been issued, and raised the issue subsequently,” the statement read. The counsel said Ms. Bano had not been a party before the Bombay High Court, and was accordingly not impleaded in the appeal filed in the Supreme Court. He pointed out that she had not filed a caveat seeking to be heard in the appeal before the apex court.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “The legal team representing the prosecutrix could have exercised the available procedural remedies, including seeking impleadment, and the absence of such action cannot be attributed to the petitioners or the court.

📰 Convicts’ lawyer rejects claims of Bilkis Bano being kept in dark, warns against media trial

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 05:00:23 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Supreme Court’s order for the duo’s release on bail came in an appeal filed by them against a 2017 Bombay High Court judgment upholding a CBI court decision of 2008, convicting the men and sentencing them to life terms in prison

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The counsel for the two convicts granted bail by the Supreme Court in the 2002 Bilkis Bano gangrape and murder case issued a statement on November 21 rejected her allegation that she was kept in the dark about the proceedings while warning against an attempt to sensationalise a sub-judice matter through a media trial. The rebuttal by advocate Ayush Anand, counsel for Bipinchand Kanaiyalal Joshi and Pradip Ramanlal Modhiya, followed a public statement issued by Ms. Bano, through her counsel and senior advocate Shobha Gupta, that she was neither informed nor heard before the apex court allowed bail to the two men in an order on October 28. Joshi and Modhiya were two of the 11 men convicted in the 2002 case. The then 19-year-old Ms. Bano was gang-raped and 14 members of her family, including her infant daughter, were killed in 2002 during the riots. The apex court order for the duo’s release on bail came in an appeal filed by them against a 2017 Bombay High Court judgment upholding a CBI court decision of 2008, convicting the men and sentencing them to life terms in prison. Mr. Anand, in his statement, said the allegations of suppression issued by Ms. Bano’s side was factually incorrect. “The matter had been listed on ten occasions before bail was granted and had taken more than a year. In these circumstances, the allegation of suppression by the legal team of the prosecutrix [Ms. Bano], according to the petitioners [Joshi and Modhiya], is entirely misconceived,” the statement said. Mr. Anand said Ms. Bano’s legal team had been both aware of the court proceedings on the appeals and observing them. The lawyer said notice in the case was issued in March 2026, and was reported in the media. “Therefore, the allegation that the prosecutrix was unaware of the proceedings is, according to the petitioners, factually incorrect. The legal team of the prosecutrix did not initiate any proceedings at that stage, despite the matter being pending and notice having been issued, and raised the issue subsequently,” the statement read. The counsel said Ms. Bano had not been a party before the Bombay High Court, and was accordingly not impleaded in the appeal filed in the Supreme Court. He pointed out that she had not filed a caveat seeking to be heard in the appeal before the apex court.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “The legal team representing the prosecutrix could have exercised the available procedural remedies, including seeking impleadment, and the absence of such action cannot be attributed to the petitioners or the court.

✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

आरोप — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Allegation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

कनैयालाल — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Kanaiyalal' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
