🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #23 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 European Union proposes tax on Big Tech to boost budget

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 06:03:16 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: European Council president Antonio Costa unveiled a new spending proposal that slashes by 204 billion euros a plan initially put forward by the European Commission

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The European Union (EU) put forward plans to tax the world's biggest digital companies to fund its next budget on Saturday (November 21, 2026), as it seeks to bridge divisions among member states over the bloc's long-term funding. European Council president Antonio Costa unveiled a new spending proposal that slashes by 204 billion euros ($224 billion) a plan initially put forward by the European Commission, which some countries had slammed as too onerous. "I believe this proposal can bring us closer to a final agreement," Mr. Costa told a press conference in Brussels. EU countries have been squabbling over the size of the next budget, with Germany leading calls for major cuts after the Commission last year proposed a two-trillion-euro budget for the 2028-2034 period. Berlin criticised a revised proposal published last month that suggested slashing the bloc's future seven-year budget by 140 billion euros. Mr. Costa, who represents the EU's 27 states, is seeking to reach a deal by the end of the year balancing contributions from member states with new sources of revenue for the bloc. Among these could be a tax on digital firms that the draft Mr. Costa presented on Saturday says will concern companies with an annual turnover for digital activities of at least 50 million euros in the EU as well as a global turnover of more than 750 million euros. They would be subjected to "an annual contribution corresponding to 3% of the annual net turnover from online advertising, digital intermediation services and user-generated data", according to documents shared by the council. The plan is likely to provoke U.S. President Donald Trump's ire since his administration has reacted angrily to EU fines and moves against Big Tech under its content and competition rules in recent years. The draft also includes plans for a levy on electronic waste and higher tobacco taxes.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The document will be at the centre of hours of fraught talks when EU leaders meet in Brussels next week.

articles.title: HPV vaccination: one crore doses administered in nine months
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Nearly 87% of its annual target cohort of 14-year-old girls has been covered under the national cervical cancer prevention campaign. Uttar Pradesh leads with more than 29.33 lakh girls vaccinated, followed by Bihar (13.70 lakh) and Gujarat (7.75 lakh)

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: India has administered more than one crore doses of the human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine in less than nine months, covering nearly 87% of its annual target cohort of 14-year-old girls under the national cervical cancer prevention campaign launched in February 2026, noted a release issued by the Union Health Ministry on Saturday (November 21, 2026). It added that Uttar Pradesh leads with more than 29.33 lakh girls vaccinated, followed by Bihar (13.70 lakh) and Gujarat (7.75 lakh). Six States — Gujarat, Uttar Pradesh, Andhra Pradesh, Mizoram, Madhya Pradesh and Bihar — have achieved 100% coverage of their identified target populations. The government provides the single-dose vaccine free of cost and voluntarily to eligible girls at designated government health facilities, with parental consent. The U-WIN digital platform facilitates beneficiary tracking, real-time monitoring, slot booking and digital certificates. Vaccination sessions are conducted under medical supervision, with arrangements for managing adverse events following immunisation, the Ministry said. Among other high-performing States, Assam has recorded 95.63% coverage, followed by Telangana (95.28%), Karnataka (93.16%) and Uttarakhand (90.17%). Chhattisgarh (86.21%) and Rajasthan (85.23%) have crossed the 80% coverage mark, while Kerala (77.02%), Tamil Nadu (76.12%), Odisha (74.90%) and the Union Territory of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu (72.99%) have achieved more than 70% coverage. In terms of absolute numbers, Uttar Pradesh leads the country with more than 29.33 lakh 14-year-old girls vaccinated, followed by Bihar with more than 13.70 lakh and Gujarat with more than 7.75 lakh girls vaccinated. “School teachers, Accredited Social Health Activists (ASHAs), Auxiliary Nurse Midwives (ANMs) and other frontline healthcare workers have worked closely with parents and communities to encourage informed participation and counter misinformation,’’ the Ministry added. It stated that digital health infrastructure has been an important enabler of the nationwide campaign, with the U-WIN platform supporting real-time monitoring, beneficiary tracking and digital vaccination records. The platform also enables parents to book HPV vaccination slots for their daughters and download digital vaccination certificates, making the vaccination process more accessible, convenient and transparent.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: vaccines / health / cancer / public health/community medicine

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #30 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 HPV vaccination: one crore doses administered in nine months

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 09:23:37 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Nearly 87% of its annual target cohort of 14-year-old girls has been covered under the national cervical cancer prevention campaign. Uttar Pradesh leads with more than 29.33 lakh girls vaccinated, followed by Bihar (13.70 lakh) and Gujarat (7.75 lakh)

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: India has administered more than one crore doses of the human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine in less than nine months, covering nearly 87% of its annual target cohort of 14-year-old girls under the national cervical cancer prevention campaign launched in February 2026, noted a release issued by the Union Health Ministry on Saturday (November 21, 2026). It added that Uttar Pradesh leads with more than 29.33 lakh girls vaccinated, followed by Bihar (13.70 lakh) and Gujarat (7.75 lakh). Six States — Gujarat, Uttar Pradesh, Andhra Pradesh, Mizoram, Madhya Pradesh and Bihar — have achieved 100% coverage of their identified target populations. The government provides the single-dose vaccine free of cost and voluntarily to eligible girls at designated government health facilities, with parental consent. The U-WIN digital platform facilitates beneficiary tracking, real-time monitoring, slot booking and digital certificates. Vaccination sessions are conducted under medical supervision, with arrangements for managing adverse events following immunisation, the Ministry said. Among other high-performing States, Assam has recorded 95.63% coverage, followed by Telangana (95.28%), Karnataka (93.16%) and Uttarakhand (90.17%). Chhattisgarh (86.21%) and Rajasthan (85.23%) have crossed the 80% coverage mark, while Kerala (77.02%), Tamil Nadu (76.12%), Odisha (74.90%) and the Union Territory of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu (72.99%) have achieved more than 70% coverage. In terms of absolute numbers, Uttar Pradesh leads the country with more than 29.33 lakh 14-year-old girls vaccinated, followed by Bihar with more than 13.70 lakh and Gujarat with more than 7.75 lakh girls vaccinated. “School teachers, Accredited Social Health Activists (ASHAs), Auxiliary Nurse Midwives (ANMs) and other frontline healthcare workers have worked closely with parents and communities to encourage informed participation and counter misinformation,’’ the Ministry added. It stated that digital health infrastructure has been an important enabler of the nationwide campaign, with the U-WIN platform supporting real-time monitoring, beneficiary tracking and digital vaccination records. The platform also enables parents to book HPV vaccination slots for their daughters and download digital vaccination certificates, making the vaccination process more accessible, convenient and transparent.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: vaccines / health / cancer / public health/community medicine

articles.title: Kannada writer Ravi Hanj tracked to Kochi airport, served notice to appear for probe amid Basava Mantapa book controversy
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Ravi Hanj was detained during security checks while attempting to travel abroad, say Kerala Police sources.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Kannada writer Ravi Hanj, who is at the centre of a major controversy over alleged derogatory remarks against 12th-century social reformer Basavanna in his book Basava Mantapa and in interviews around the book , was tracked down to Cochin International Airport in Keralam. He was stopped by Central Industrial Security Force (CISF) personnel while attempting to travel abroad. The CISF stopped Mr. Hanj acting on a lookout notice issued against him by the Belagavi police. There are four FIRs pending against him in Bengaluru, Belagavi, Bagewadi, and Vijayapura. “He [Ravi Hunj] initially attempted to create the impression that he had left India for the United States. However, verification by the Home Department established that he was in a neighbouring State. He has been traced and a formal notice has been issued directing him to appear before the investigating authorities,” said Karnataka Home Minister Priyank Kharge. Sources said the Karnataka Police have questioned him and the Bengaluru City Police have served him a notice to appear before them for questioning before November 24, Tuesday. “Since Mr. Hanj is a U.S. citizen, we have also formally informed the U.S. Embassy about the FIR registered against him and the requirement for his questioning in connection with the investigation. Foreign citizenship does not place anyone above Indian law. It also does not provide immunity from investigation or accountability,” Mr. Kharge said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The Karnataka Cabinet on Thursday decided to forfeit his book following complaints by Veerashiva-Lingayat groups. The book’s publisher, Vishweshwar Bhat, has also been named in the Bengaluru and Vijayapura FIRs. The book is a compilation of columns published in the Viswavani newspaper under the same title Basava Mantapa . It was released as a book in Bengaluru on November 15.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Kannada writer Ravi Hanj tracked to Kochi airport, served notice to appear for probe amid Basava Mantapa book controversy

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 09:22:25 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Ravi Hanj was detained during security checks while attempting to travel abroad, say Kerala Police sources.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Kannada writer Ravi Hanj, who is at the centre of a major controversy over alleged derogatory remarks against 12th-century social reformer Basavanna in his book Basava Mantapa and in interviews around the book , was tracked down to Cochin International Airport in Keralam. He was stopped by Central Industrial Security Force (CISF) personnel while attempting to travel abroad. The CISF stopped Mr. Hanj acting on a lookout notice issued against him by the Belagavi police. There are four FIRs pending against him in Bengaluru, Belagavi, Bagewadi, and Vijayapura. “He [Ravi Hunj] initially attempted to create the impression that he had left India for the United States. However, verification by the Home Department established that he was in a neighbouring State. He has been traced and a formal notice has been issued directing him to appear before the investigating authorities,” said Karnataka Home Minister Priyank Kharge. Sources said the Karnataka Police have questioned him and the Bengaluru City Police have served him a notice to appear before them for questioning before November 24, Tuesday. “Since Mr. Hanj is a U.S. citizen, we have also formally informed the U.S. Embassy about the FIR registered against him and the requirement for his questioning in connection with the investigation. Foreign citizenship does not place anyone above Indian law. It also does not provide immunity from investigation or accountability,” Mr. Kharge said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The Karnataka Cabinet on Thursday decided to forfeit his book following complaints by Veerashiva-Lingayat groups. The book’s publisher, Vishweshwar Bhat, has also been named in the Bengaluru and Vijayapura FIRs. The book is a compilation of columns published in the Viswavani newspaper under the same title Basava Mantapa . It was released as a book in Bengaluru on November 15.

✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Investigation (Adjective / Verb)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Investigation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable

सत्यापन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Verification' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Kannada writer Ravi Hanj tracked to Kochi airport, served notice to appear for probe amid Basava Mantapa book controversy", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Ravi Hanj was detained during security checks while attempting to travel abroad, say Kerala Police sources.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Kannada writer Ravi Hanj tracked to Kochi airpor' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.

✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Kannada writer Ravi Hanj tracked to Kochi airport, served notice to appear for probe amid Basava Mantapa book controversy"?

articles.title: Mirwaiz Umar Farooq hails Pakistan accepting India’s SCO invite, terms it ‘positive step’
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Ties between India and Pakistan nosedived after the Pahalgam attack triggered a war between the two neighbours in 2025

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Kashmir chief cleric Mirwaiz Umar Farooq on Saturday (November 21, 2026) welcomed a Pakistani minister accepting the Indian government’s invitation to attend the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Cultural Dialogue Forum in New Delhi, saying “every opportunity to increase engagement and improve relations between India and Pakistan is a positive step”. “Although this is a multilateral forum, it is welcome that Pakistan’s representative accepted the Indian government’s invitation and attended this meeting. We hope that contacts of this kind will promote dialogue and engagement between the two countries and also create a favourable environment for improving bilateral relations,” said the Mirwaiz. Ties between India and Pakistan nosedived after the Pahalgam attack triggered a war between the two neighbours in 2025. Pakistan Climate Minister Musadik Masood Malik attending the SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum has been widely welcomed in Jammu and Kashmir “Dialogue and sustained engagement are essential for progress towards mutual understanding and peaceful relations. Every opportunity to increase engagement and improve relations between India and Pakistan is a positive step,” said the Mirwaiz. Peoples Democratic Party legislator Muntazir Mehdi termed the Pakistan minister’s visit to India “a welcome development” and urged the resumption of dialogue between India and Pakistan. “The two countries share a common history and several mutual concerns, including political issues, climate change and water-related matters, which could only be addressed through engagement and dialogue. Hostility and non-engagement cannot resolve these issues. Both the countries should come to the table and resume dialogue for peace and development in the subcontinent,” he said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Jammu and Kashmir Deputy Chief Minister Surinder Choudhary on Friday said the BJP-led government’s move to invite the Pakistan minister “vindicated the stand of National Conference (NC)”.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Mirwaiz Umar Farooq hails Pakistan accepting India’s SCO invite, terms it ‘positive step’

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 09:19:50 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Ties between India and Pakistan nosedived after the Pahalgam attack triggered a war between the two neighbours in 2025

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Kashmir chief cleric Mirwaiz Umar Farooq on Saturday (November 21, 2026) welcomed a Pakistani minister accepting the Indian government’s invitation to attend the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Cultural Dialogue Forum in New Delhi, saying “every opportunity to increase engagement and improve relations between India and Pakistan is a positive step”. “Although this is a multilateral forum, it is welcome that Pakistan’s representative accepted the Indian government’s invitation and attended this meeting. We hope that contacts of this kind will promote dialogue and engagement between the two countries and also create a favourable environment for improving bilateral relations,” said the Mirwaiz. Ties between India and Pakistan nosedived after the Pahalgam attack triggered a war between the two neighbours in 2025. Pakistan Climate Minister Musadik Masood Malik attending the SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum has been widely welcomed in Jammu and Kashmir “Dialogue and sustained engagement are essential for progress towards mutual understanding and peaceful relations. Every opportunity to increase engagement and improve relations between India and Pakistan is a positive step,” said the Mirwaiz. Peoples Democratic Party legislator Muntazir Mehdi termed the Pakistan minister’s visit to India “a welcome development” and urged the resumption of dialogue between India and Pakistan. “The two countries share a common history and several mutual concerns, including political issues, climate change and water-related matters, which could only be addressed through engagement and dialogue. Hostility and non-engagement cannot resolve these issues. Both the countries should come to the table and resume dialogue for peace and development in the subcontinent,” he said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Jammu and Kashmir Deputy Chief Minister Surinder Choudhary on Friday said the BJP-led government’s move to invite the Pakistan minister “vindicated the stand of National Conference (NC)”.

✓ Syn: Plurilateral, International, Coalition-based  |  ✖ Ant: Unilateral, One-sided, Isolated
Bilateral (Adjective)
द्विपक्षीय — दो देशों के बीच आपसी समझौता, व्यापार या कूटनीतिक बातचीत।
✓ Syn: Reciprocal, Two-sided, Mutual  |  ✖ Ant: Unilateral, Multilateral, One-way
Sustainability (Noun)
सतत विकास — पर्यावरण और भविष्य की पीढ़ियों को नुकसान पहुँचाए बिना लंबे समय तक चलने वाला विकास।

articles.title: Kidney ailment from using face cream: child rights panel registers case
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Kerala State Commission for Protection of Child Rights has registered a suo motu case on the basis of media reports that a 17-year-old girl in Malappuram developed acute kidney ailment following mercury poisoning through use of a fairness cream.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The teenager used the cream, which was purchased online, for almost a year. When she went to hospital following physical discomfort, it was found that mercury levels in her body were dangerously high. Laboratory tests revealed excessive levels of mercury in the fairness cream. Use of the cream resulted in her developing severe kidney ailment, the girl told mediapersons. According to the doctors treating the teenager, she ordered the cream after watching promotional videos by social media influencers who claimed it could remove pimples, dark spots, and pigmentation. The girl told mediapersons that she contacted the sellers through a WhatsApp number provided on Instagram and ordered the product.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The child rights panel has sought explanations from the Director of Health Services, State Police Chief, Drugs Controller, Central Consumer Protection Authority, and the hospital superintendent.

📰 Kidney ailment from using face cream: child rights panel registers case

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 09:18:01 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The Kerala State Commission for Protection of Child Rights has registered a suo motu case on the basis of media reports that a 17-year-old girl in Malappuram developed acute kidney ailment following mercury poisoning through use of a fairness cream.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The teenager used the cream, which was purchased online, for almost a year. When she went to hospital following physical discomfort, it was found that mercury levels in her body were dangerously high. Laboratory tests revealed excessive levels of mercury in the fairness cream. Use of the cream resulted in her developing severe kidney ailment, the girl told mediapersons. According to the doctors treating the teenager, she ordered the cream after watching promotional videos by social media influencers who claimed it could remove pimples, dark spots, and pigmentation. The girl told mediapersons that she contacted the sellers through a WhatsApp number provided on Instagram and ordered the product.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The child rights panel has sought explanations from the Director of Health Services, State Police Chief, Drugs Controller, Central Consumer Protection Authority, and the hospital superintendent.

articles.title: Two die, three injured after car plunges into gorge in Yercaud
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Around 10.30 p.m. on Friday, when the passengers were near Keeraikadu, the car went out of the driver’s control and plunged into a 100-foot-deep gorge along Yercaud-Kuppanur Ghat Road

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Two persons died and three sustained grievous injuries after a car plunged into a gorge in Yercaud on Friday (November 20, 2026) night. The deceased were identified as K. Sabareesh (26), a resident of Angalamman Kovil Street in Edappadi, who worked at a jewellery shop in Edappadi, and S. Alagiri, alias Alagesan (47), a resident of Edappadi, who drove the car. According to the police, on Friday, Sabareesh, along with his relatives K. Jeeva (26), N. Balaji (47), and P. Devan (55), residents of Edappadi, went to Yercaud in a car. After visiting various spots in Yercaud, they were headed to a resort at Keeraikadu. Around 10.30 p.m., when they were near Keeraikadu, the car went out of Alagiri’s control and plunged into a 100-foot-deep gorge along Yercaud-Kuppanur Ghat Road.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: All five occupants sustained grievous injuries in the accident. On receiving information, the Yercaud police rushed to the spot, rescued the five occupants and shifted them to Yercaud Government Hospital. They were later referred to Salem Government Hospital. Sabareesh died on the way to the hospital. Alagiri who was admitted in a critical stage succumbed to injuries on Saturday evening (November 21, 2026). The Yercaud police registered a case and are investigating further.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Two die, three injured after car plunges into gorge in Yercaud

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 09:17:08 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Around 10.30 p.m. on Friday, when the passengers were near Keeraikadu, the car went out of the driver’s control and plunged into a 100-foot-deep gorge along Yercaud-Kuppanur Ghat Road

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Two persons died and three sustained grievous injuries after a car plunged into a gorge in Yercaud on Friday (November 20, 2026) night. The deceased were identified as K. Sabareesh (26), a resident of Angalamman Kovil Street in Edappadi, who worked at a jewellery shop in Edappadi, and S. Alagiri, alias Alagesan (47), a resident of Edappadi, who drove the car. According to the police, on Friday, Sabareesh, along with his relatives K. Jeeva (26), N. Balaji (47), and P. Devan (55), residents of Edappadi, went to Yercaud in a car. After visiting various spots in Yercaud, they were headed to a resort at Keeraikadu. Around 10.30 p.m., when they were near Keeraikadu, the car went out of Alagiri’s control and plunged into a 100-foot-deep gorge along Yercaud-Kuppanur Ghat Road.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: All five occupants sustained grievous injuries in the accident. On receiving information, the Yercaud police rushed to the spot, rescued the five occupants and shifted them to Yercaud Government Hospital. They were later referred to Salem Government Hospital. Sabareesh died on the way to the hospital. Alagiri who was admitted in a critical stage succumbed to injuries on Saturday evening (November 21, 2026). The Yercaud police registered a case and are investigating further.

A. on Friday, when the passengers were near Keeraikadu, the car went out of the driver’s control and plunged into a 100-foot-deep gorge along...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Two die, three injured after car plunges into go' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.

D. The author contends that 'Two die, three injured after car plunges into' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. articles.title: Zelenskiy says China summit was ‘very unsuccessful’ for Russia
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Ukrainian President said Vladimir Putin had failed to recreate the Yalta conference, and that it is not clear to Kyiv whether it will be able to join NATO

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said on Saturday (November 21, 2026) that this week’s trilateral summit between the leaders of China, Russia and the United States was “very unsuccessful” for Russian President Vladimir Putin, who he said had failed to recreate the Yalta conference that decided Europe’s fate in 1945.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Asked separately about the possibility of Ukraine joining NATO at the end of the war, Mr. Zelenskiy said that although the topic had been raised at this week’s Coalition of the Willing meeting in Berlin, it was not currently clear to Kyiv whether it would be able to join the alliance, something it has long sought.

articles.title: World needs skilled youth, not merely degree-holders, says PM Modi
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: ITI students deserve the same respect as IIT students, he says at ITIs convocation ceremony; the skills acquired at ITIs are not merely a means of securing employment but also an opportunity to participate directly in nation-building, PM Modi says

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The world needs skilled youth, not merely degree-holders, Prime Minister Narendra Modi said at the fifth Kaushal Deekshant Samaroh, a national-level convocation ceremony for graduating Industrial Training Institutes (ITI) trainees, in Lucknow on Saturday (November 21, 2026). “The entire sky is before you right now. Dream big, develop your skills and put in all your strength to fulfil your dreams. Never feel that you are alone. Whenever you feel alone, just remember that I am standing with you,” Mr. Modi said at the ceremony held at Indira Gandhi Pratishthan in Lucknow. Trainees from across the country participated in it. The Prime Minister described youth’s skills, hard work and capabilities as the greatest assets of Viksit Bharat. “The skills acquired at ITIs are not merely a means of securing employment but also an opportunity to participate directly in nation-building. India’s future will take shape through the hands and skills of its youth,” he said. He said that IITs and ITIs represented the country’s assets, capabilities and future. “ITI students deserve the same respect as IIT students,” he said. He cited craftworks that require skills such as Lucknow’s Chikankari, Banaras and Kanchipuram silk, Kashmir’s Pashmina, Muslin, Kalamkari, cotton textiles, exquisite metalwork, glasswork and sculptures made of Panchdhatu (five metals). ALSO WATCH Watch: PM Modi to inaugurate ₹5,500-crore Nitish Setu in Bihar Referring to Gujarat’s ‘Vasvaya’ tradition, he said that whenever a village was established, people with different skills needed to sustain life there also settled in the village. He called for changing the prevailing mindset in society that considers young people enrolling in ITIs inferior. “While some people in large companies may work with paper qualifications, hundreds of skilled technical workers are required to run those companies,” he said. Mr. Modi said invaders attacked the skills of Indian artisans to weaken their craftsmanship. “At the same time, the British, through Macaulay’s education system, pushed skill-based traditions to the background and promoted a system that produced clerks with paper qualifications. Even after Independence, degrees and certificates were given greater importance, while young people engaged in manual work did not receive the respect they deserved,” he said. Amid concerns about artificial intelligence (AI) taking away jobs, the Prime Minister said young people must understand that no one can take away the employment of someone who possesses skills. “During the COVID period, the whole world realised the importance of skilled workers. Today, India has moved beyond being a country that imported mobile phones and has become a country that manufactures them. The skills of young people have played an important role in increasing the country’s manufacturing capabilities,” he said. He highlighted that nearly 5,000 new ITIs had been established across the country in the decade after 2014. “The number of students receiving training at ITIs has increased by more than five lakh, while the number of female students has grown more than two and a half times. Along with strengthening training quality, faculty, and infrastructure, more than 30 new-age trades have been introduced in ITIs such as AI Assistant, Cyber Security Assistant, Drone Technician, Green Hydrogen Technician, Industrial Robotics, Electric Vehicle, Animation and Special Effects, and Semiconductor Technician. Skill development has also been given special importance under the new National Education Policy,” he said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Modi said that ITI-trained youth played an important role in everything from operating medical equipment in hospitals to increasing industries’ production capacity. “The government endeavours to ensure that ITI curricula, machinery, and trainers’ knowledge remain aligned with new technologies and that training is directly connected with industries,” he said.

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — उन्होंने आईटीआई के दीक्षांत समारोह में कहा, आईटीआई के छात्र आईआईटी के छात्रों के समान ही सम्मान के पात्र हैं; पीएम मोदी ने कहा कि आईटीआई में हासिल किए गए कौशल न केवल रोजगार हासिल करने का साधन हैं, बल्कि राष्ट्र निर्माण में सीधे भाग लेने का अवसर भी हैं।।

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी ने शनिवार (21 नवंबर, 2026) को लखनऊ में औद्योगिक प्रशिक्षण संस्थानों (आईटीआई) के प्रशिक्षुओं को स्नातक करने के लिए राष्ट्रीय स्तर के दीक्षांत समारोह, पांचवें कौशल दीक्षांत समारोह में कहा कि दुनिया को केवल डिग्री धारकों की नहीं बल्कि कुशल युवाओं की जरूरत है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Institutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ। इसके Synonyms हैं: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional और Antonyms हैं: Individual, Informal, Unorganized।

hinglishTracks.en: “The entire sky is before you right now.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — “इस समय पूरा आकाश आपके सामने है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Dream big, develop your skills and put in all your strength to fulfil your dreams.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — बड़े सपने देखें, अपना कौशल विकसित करें और अपने सपनों को पूरा करने के लिए अपनी पूरी ताकत लगा दें।।

hinglishTracks.en: Never feel that you are alone.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — कभी भी यह महसूस न करें कि आप अकेले हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: Whenever you feel alone, just remember that I am standing with you,” Mr.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — जब भी आप अकेला महसूस करें तो बस याद रखें कि मैं आपके साथ खड़ा हूं।''।

hinglishTracks.en: Modi said at the ceremony held at Indira Gandhi Pratishthan in Lucknow.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — मोदी ने लखनऊ के इंदिरा गांधी प्रतिष्ठान में आयोजित समारोह में ये बात कही.।

hinglishTracks.en: Trainees from across the country participated in it.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — इसमें देशभर से प्रशिक्षुओं ने भाग लिया।।

hinglishTracks.en: The Prime Minister described youth’s skills, hard work and capabilities as the greatest assets of Viksit Bharat.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — प्रधानमंत्री ने युवाओं के कौशल, कड़ी मेहनत और क्षमताओं को विकसित भारत की सबसे बड़ी संपत्ति बताया।।

hinglishTracks.en: “The skills acquired at ITIs are not merely a means of securing employment but also an opportunity to participate directly in nation-building.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — “आईटीआई में हासिल किए गए कौशल न केवल रोजगार हासिल करने का साधन हैं, बल्कि राष्ट्र निर्माण में सीधे भाग लेने का अवसर भी हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: India’s future will take shape through the hands and skills of its youth,” he said.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — भारत का भविष्य उसके युवाओं के हाथों और कौशल से आकार लेगा, ”उन्होंने कहा।।

hinglishTracks.en: He said that IITs and ITIs represented the country’s assets, capabilities and future.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — उन्होंने कहा कि आईआईटी और आईटीआई देश की संपत्ति, क्षमताओं और भविष्य का प्रतिनिधित्व करते हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: “ITI students deserve the same respect as IIT students,” he said.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — उन्होंने कहा, "आईटीआई के छात्र आईआईटी के छात्रों के समान ही सम्मान के पात्र हैं।"।

hinglishTracks.en: He cited craftworks that require skills such as Lucknow’s Chikankari, Banaras and Kanchipuram silk, Kashmir’s Pashmina, Muslin, Kalamkari, cotton textiles, exquisite metalwork, glasswork and sculptures made of Panchdhatu (five metals).
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — उन्होंने उन शिल्पकलाओं का हवाला दिया जिनमें कौशल की आवश्यकता होती है जैसे कि लखनऊ की चिकनकारी, बनारस और कांचीपुरम रेशम, कश्मीर की पश्मीना, मलमल, कलमकारी, सूती वस्त्र, उत्तम धातु का काम, कांच का काम और पंचधातु (पांच धातुओं) से बनी मूर्तियां।।

hinglishTracks.en: ALSO WATCH Watch: PM Modi to inaugurate ₹5,500-crore Nitish Setu in Bihar
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — यह भी देखें देखें: पीएम मोदी बिहार में ₹5,500 करोड़ के नीतीश सेतु का उद्घाटन करेंगे।

hinglishTracks.en: Referring to Gujarat’s ‘Vasvaya’ tradition, he said that whenever a village was established, people with different skills needed to sustain life there also settled in the village.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — गुजरात की 'वासवय' परंपरा का जिक्र करते हुए उन्होंने कहा कि जब भी कोई गांव स्थापित होता था, तो वहां जीवन को बनाए रखने के लिए आवश्यक विभिन्न कौशल वाले लोग भी गांव में बस जाते थे।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Sustainability' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: सतत विकास — पर्यावरण और भविष्य की पीढ़ियों को नुकसान पहुँचाए बिना लंबे समय तक चलने वाला विकास। इसके Synonyms हैं: Viability, Eco-balance, Durability और Antonyms हैं: Depletion, Unsustainability, Destruction।

hinglishTracks.en: He called for changing the prevailing mindset in society that considers young people enrolling in ITIs inferior.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — उन्होंने समाज में प्रचलित उस मानसिकता को बदलने का आह्वान किया जो आईटीआई में दाखिला लेने वाले युवाओं को कमतर मानती है।।

hinglishTracks.en: “While some people in large companies may work with paper qualifications, hundreds of skilled technical workers are required to run those companies,” he said.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — उन्होंने कहा, "हालांकि बड़ी कंपनियों में कुछ लोग कागजी योग्यता के साथ काम कर सकते हैं, लेकिन उन कंपनियों को चलाने के लिए सैकड़ों कुशल तकनीकी कर्मचारियों की आवश्यकता होती है।"।

hinglishTracks.en: Modi said invaders attacked the skills of Indian artisans to weaken their craftsmanship.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — मोदी ने कहा कि आक्रमणकारियों ने भारतीय कारीगरों की शिल्प कौशल को कमजोर करने के लिए उनके कौशल पर हमला किया।।

hinglishTracks.en: “At the same time, the British, through Macaulay’s education system, pushed skill-based traditions to the background and promoted a system that produced clerks with paper qualifications.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — “उसी समय, मैकाले की शिक्षा प्रणाली के माध्यम से, अंग्रेजों ने कौशल-आधारित परंपराओं को पृष्ठभूमि में धकेल दिया और एक ऐसी प्रणाली को बढ़ावा दिया जो कागजी योग्यता वाले क्लर्क पैदा करती थी।।

hinglishTracks.en: Even after Independence, degrees and certificates were given greater importance, while young people engaged in manual work did not receive the respect they deserved,” he said.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — आजादी के बाद भी, डिग्री और प्रमाणपत्रों को अधिक महत्व दिया गया, जबकि शारीरिक काम में लगे युवाओं को वह सम्मान नहीं मिला जिसके वे हकदार थे, ”उन्होंने कहा।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Independence' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: आज़ादी — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Independence' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: Amid concerns about artificial intelligence (AI) taking away jobs, the Prime Minister said young people must understand that no one can take away the employment of someone who possesses skills.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता (एआई) द्वारा नौकरियां छीनने की चिंताओं के बीच, प्रधान मंत्री ने कहा कि युवाओं को यह समझना चाहिए कि जिनके पास कौशल है, उनका रोजगार कोई नहीं छीन सकता।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Intelligence' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Intelligence' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: “During the COVID period, the whole world realised the importance of skilled workers.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — “कोविड काल के दौरान, पूरी दुनिया को कुशल श्रमिकों के महत्व का एहसास हुआ।।

hinglishTracks.en: Today, India has moved beyond being a country that imported mobile phones and has become a country that manufactures them.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — आज भारत मोबाइल फोन आयात करने वाले देश से आगे बढ़कर उन्हें बनाने वाला देश बन गया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The skills of young people have played an important role in increasing the country’s manufacturing capabilities,” he said.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — युवाओं के कौशल ने देश की विनिर्माण क्षमताओं को बढ़ाने में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई है, ”उन्होंने कहा।।

hinglishTracks.en: He highlighted that nearly 5,000 new ITIs had been established across the country in the decade after 2014.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — उन्होंने इस बात पर प्रकाश डाला कि 2014 के बाद के दशक में देश भर में लगभग 5,000 नए आईटीआई स्थापित किए गए थे।।

hinglishTracks.en: “The number of students receiving training at ITIs has increased by more than five lakh, while the number of female students has grown more than two and a half times.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — “आईटीआई में प्रशिक्षण प्राप्त करने वाले छात्रों की संख्या पांच लाख से अधिक बढ़ गई है, जबकि महिला छात्रों की संख्या ढाई गुना से अधिक हो गई है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Along with strengthening training quality, faculty, and infrastructure, more than 30 new-age trades have been introduced in ITIs such as AI Assistant, Cyber Security Assistant, Drone Technician, Green Hydrogen Technician, Industrial Robotics, Electric Vehicle, Animation and Special Effects, and Semiconductor Technician.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — प्रशिक्षण की गुणवत्ता, संकाय और बुनियादी ढांचे को मजबूत करने के साथ-साथ, आईटीआई में एआई सहायक, साइबर सुरक्षा सहायक, ड्रोन तकनीशियन, ग्रीन हाइड्रोजन तकनीशियन, औद्योगिक रोबोटिक्स, इलेक्ट्रिक वाहन, एनीमेशन और विशेष प्रभाव, और सेमीकंडक्टर तकनीशियन जैसे 30 से अधिक नए-पुराने ट्रेड शुरू किए गए हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: Skill development has also been given special importance under the new National Education Policy,” he said.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — नई राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति में कौशल विकास को भी विशेष महत्व दिया गया है।”।

hinglishTracks.en: Modi said that ITI-trained youth played an important role in everything from operating medical equipment in hospitals to increasing industries’ production capacity.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — मोदी ने कहा कि आईटीआई प्रशिक्षित युवाओं ने अस्पतालों में चिकित्सा उपकरणों के संचालन से लेकर उद्योगों की उत्पादन क्षमता बढ़ाने तक हर काम में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई है।।

hinglishTracks.en: “The government endeavours to ensure that ITI curricula, machinery, and trainers’ knowledge remain aligned with new technologies and that training is directly connected with industries,” he said.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — उन्होंने कहा, "सरकार यह सुनिश्चित करने का प्रयास कर रही है कि आईटीआई पाठ्यक्रम, मशीनरी और प्रशिक्षकों का ज्ञान नई प्रौद्योगिकियों के साथ जुड़ा रहे और प्रशिक्षण सीधे उद्योगों से जुड़ा रहे।"।

articles.newspaperPrintHtml:
🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #7 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 World needs skilled youth, not merely degree-holders, says PM Modi

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 10:34:44 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: ITI students deserve the same respect as IIT students, he says at ITIs convocation ceremony; the skills acquired at ITIs are not merely a means of securing employment but also an opportunity to participate directly in nation-building, PM Modi says

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The world needs skilled youth, not merely degree-holders, Prime Minister Narendra Modi said at the fifth Kaushal Deekshant Samaroh, a national-level convocation ceremony for graduating Industrial Training Institutes (ITI) trainees, in Lucknow on Saturday (November 21, 2026). “The entire sky is before you right now. articles.title: Raichur is a treasure trove of Kannada literature, says Rajappa Dalawai
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Raichur is a rich repository of Kannada literature and culture, having produced several eminent writers who have made significant contributions to the literary world, said Rajappa Dalawai, chairperson of the State-level Selection Committee of the Department of Public Libraries, Bengaluru.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Speaking at the 71st Karnataka Rajyotsava celebrations organised at the Adikavi Sri Maharshi Valmiki University in Raichur on Friday, he said Kannada was not merely a medium of communication but also a symbol of the State’s culture and identity. Writers such as Channanna Walikar and Shantarasa, who transformed the course of Kannada literature, hailed from Raichur, he noted. Referring to the rich literary heritage of Kannada, he said the language had won eight Jnanpith Awards and had been accorded classical language status in recognition of its antiquity and literary tradition. The recent Booker Prize recognition for a work by Banu Mushtaq was another achievement for Kannada literature, he said. Pointing out that Kannada had been among the first Indian languages to be incorporated into computer technology and ATMs, he urged students to cultivate the habit of reading books rather than spending excessive time on mobile phones and social media reels. Senior writer from Raichur and Rajyotsava awardee Veera Hanuman said the real architects of literature were often the ancestors and folk artistes who had created and preserved literary traditions despite not having formal education. Razak Ustad, newly appointed member of the Karnataka State Higher Education Council, expressed concern that Kalyana Karnataka, despite having fertile land, 10 rivers and abundant natural resources, continued to lag behind other regions in per capita income. Regional disparities persisted even seven decades after the unification of Karnataka, he said, urging people to develop the habit of questioning and undertake introspection. Presiding over the programme, Vice-Chancellor of the university Shivanand Kelaginamani said writers, artistes and activists who had worked for the development of Kannada should be remembered. He said the benefits of Article 371(J) should extend beyond government employment and reach the private sector and industries as well, creating more job opportunities for local people. University Registrar A. Chennappa said the people of Raichur should recognise and build upon the region’s rich cultural, literary, artistic and agricultural resources.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Evaluation Registrar Virupakshaiah D.B.M., Finance Officer Latha M.S., deans, faculty members, representatives of academic associations, teaching and non-teaching staff and students were present.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #8 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Raichur is a treasure trove of Kannada literature, says Rajappa Dalawai

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 10:25:30 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Raichur is a rich repository of Kannada literature and culture, having produced several eminent writers who have made significant contributions to the literary world, said Rajappa Dalawai, chairperson of the State-level Selection Committee of the Department of Public Libraries, Bengaluru.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Speaking at the 71st Karnataka Rajyotsava celebrations organised at the Adikavi Sri Maharshi Valmiki University in Raichur on Friday, he said Kannada was not merely a medium of communication but also a symbol of the State’s culture and identity. Writers such as Channanna Walikar and Shantarasa, who transformed the course of Kannada literature, hailed from Raichur, he noted. Referring to the rich literary heritage of Kannada, he said the language had won eight Jnanpith Awards and had been accorded classical language status in recognition of its antiquity and literary tradition. The recent Booker Prize recognition for a work by Banu Mushtaq was another achievement for Kannada literature, he said. Pointing out that Kannada had been among the first Indian languages to be incorporated into computer technology and ATMs, he urged students to cultivate the habit of reading books rather than spending excessive time on mobile phones and social media reels. Senior writer from Raichur and Rajyotsava awardee Veera Hanuman said the real architects of literature were often the ancestors and folk artistes who had created and preserved literary traditions despite not having formal education. Razak Ustad, newly appointed member of the Karnataka State Higher Education Council, expressed concern that Kalyana Karnataka, despite having fertile land, 10 rivers and abundant natural resources, continued to lag behind other regions in per capita income. Regional disparities persisted even seven decades after the unification of Karnataka, he said, urging people to develop the habit of questioning and undertake introspection. Presiding over the programme, Vice-Chancellor of the university Shivanand Kelaginamani said writers, artistes and activists who had worked for the development of Kannada should be remembered. He said the benefits of Article 371(J) should extend beyond government employment and reach the private sector and industries as well, creating more job opportunities for local people. University Registrar A. Chennappa said the people of Raichur should recognise and build upon the region’s rich cultural, literary, artistic and agricultural resources.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Evaluation Registrar Virupakshaiah D.B.M., Finance Officer Latha M.S., deans, faculty members, representatives of academic associations, teaching and non-teaching staff and students were present.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Communication (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Communication' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।

Introspection (Adjective / Verb)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Introspection' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Agricultural (Adjective)
कृषि — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Agricultural' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Recognition (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Recognition' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Raichur is a treasure trove of Kannada literature, says Rajappa Dalawai", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Raichur is a rich repository of Kannada literature and culture, having produced several eminent writers who have made significant contributions to...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Raichur is a treasure trove of Kannada literatur' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Raichur is a treasure trove of Kannada litera' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Raichur is a treasure trove of Kannada litera' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Raichur is a rich repository of Kannada literature and culture, having produced several eminent writers who have made significant contributions to..." (Hinglish Arth: राज्य स्तरीय समिति के अध्यक्ष राजप्पा दलवई ने कहा, रायचूर कन्नड़ साहित्य और संस्कृति का एक समृद्ध भंडार है, जिसने कई प्रतिष्ठित लेखकों को जन्म दिया है, जिन्होंने साहित्य जगत में महत्वपूर्ण योगदान दिया है।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Raichur is a treasure trove of Kannada literature, says Rajappa Dalawai"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Evaluation Registrar Virupakshaiah D.B.M., Finance Officer Latha M.S., deans, faculty members, representatives of academic associations, teaching and...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Evaluation Registrar Virupakshaiah D.B.M., Finance Officer Latha M.S., deans, faculty members, representatives of academic associations, teaching and..." (Hinglish Arth: मूल्यांकन रजिस्ट्रार विरुपक्षैया डी.बी.एम., वित्त अधिकारी लता एम.एस., डीन, संकाय सदस्य, शैक्षणिक संघों के प्रतिनिधि, शिक्षण और गैर-शिक्षण कर्मचारी और छात्र उपस्थित थे।)

articles.title: Dharwad to host State-level 10K cross-country run on Nov. 29
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The District Olympics Association is organising the event as part of the Rajyotsava celebrations

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The District Olympics Association will organise a State-level 10K cross-country run in Dharwad on November 29 as part of the Rajyotsava celebrations. Announcing this at a press conference on Thursday, association president Shivu Hiremath said that the event is being organised jointly with the Hubballi-Dharwad Municipal Corporation and the Department of Youth Empowerment and Sports. The competition will feature separate 10-km races for men and women, held in memory of late S.S. Agadi, a retired Sports Authority of India coach, and late athlete Kallavva Sindhogi, respectively. The winners in both categories will receive cash prizes of ₹10,000, ₹8,000 and ₹7,000 for the first three places, besides trophies and certificates. The event will also feature district-level 4-km cross-country races for participants below 16 years and those above 60 years. In each category, the first, second and third-place winners will receive ₹6,000, ₹5,000 and ₹4,000, respectively, along with trophies and certificates.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Association general secretary B.S. Talikoti said the races would commence at 7 a.m. Participation is free. Interested runners can register online by November 25 or enrol at R.N. Shetty Stadium before 5 a.m. on the day of the event. The prize distribution ceremony would be held at 10 a.m., he said.

📰 Dharwad to host State-level 10K cross-country run on Nov. 29

🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The District Olympics Association is organising the event as part of the Rajyotsava celebrations

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The District Olympics Association will organise a State-level 10K cross-country run in Dharwad on November 29 as part of the Rajyotsava celebrations. Announcing this at a press conference on Thursday, association president Shivu Hiremath said that the event is being organised jointly with the Hubballi-Dharwad Municipal Corporation and the Department of Youth Empowerment and Sports. The competition will feature separate 10-km races for men and women, held in memory of late S.S. Agadi, a retired Sports Authority of India coach, and late athlete Kallavva Sindhogi, respectively. The winners in both categories will receive cash prizes of ₹10,000, ₹8,000 and ₹7,000 for the first three places, besides trophies and certificates. The event will also feature district-level 4-km cross-country races for participants below 16 years and those above 60 years. In each category, the first, second and third-place winners will receive ₹6,000, ₹5,000 and ₹4,000, respectively, along with trophies and certificates.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Association general secretary B.S. Talikoti said the races would commence at 7 a.m. Participation is free. Interested runners can register online by November 25 or enrol at R.N. Shetty Stadium before 5 a.m. on the day of the event. The prize distribution ceremony would be held at 10 a.m., he said.

articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Indian Hotels Company Limited (IHCL), the hospitality arm of the Tata Group, founded by Jamsetji Tata, has opened its 400th hotel property, Taj Yelahanka, in Bengaluru. articles.title: Amid cold wave, students’ indefinite strike against J&K recruitment board scam gathers steam
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Protesting government job aspirants on Saturday (November 21, 2026) launched an indefinite strike in Srinagar amid a cold wave over the government’s failure to act against the J&K Service Selection Board (JKSSB), the main recruitment agency of J&K that has become mired in a cheating scam that has led to 16 arrests so far.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: While former Member of Parliament (MP) Aga Syed Ruhullah joined the protesters in Srinagar, other regional parties also demanded the cancellation of all examinations held by the Board and called for “fixing the responsibility”. Speaking at the Sher-i-Kashmir Park, Mr. Ruhullah said the protest is a “rare effort to open up space where youth could fight for their rights”. “We demand that heads must roll. We have the elected government and an unelected government ruling J&K. Both share responsibility for it. Unfortunately, there is a sense of complacency. The examinations should be postponed, responsibility for the irregularities fixed and reforms carried out. The administration should engage students and address their concerns,” said Mr. Ruhullah. Mr. Ruhullah joined scores of students and aspirants who held a sit-in all day in Srinagar. With evening temperature dipping, a spokesman of Mr. Ruhullah said, “There was no food or blankets. No entry. Students on a peaceful sit-in are being frozen out on a bitter Srinagar night. Their only crime is asking for justice over the alleged Finance Accounts Assistant (FAA) recruitment rigging.” The night temperature has dipped to around zero degrees Celsius in Srinagar amid a severe cold wave. On November 15, the J&K Police busted four “cheating modules” in Jammu during the Board’s examination for the FAA posts. Nearly 1.62 lakh aspirants had appeared for around 600 posts across J&K. Besides 16 arrests made in the case, the police said it filed three First Information Reports (FIRs) and recovered eight wireless devices, 22 mobile phones and four vehicles of the accused. However, Board chairman Shrikant Balasaheb Suse said the “examination was not compromised by a paper leak or mass malpractice” and announced that the upcoming exams will be held “as per the schedule”.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Facing a growing public outcry, J&K Education Minister Shamim Firdous said strict action should be taken “if any irregularities or rigging are found”.

articles.newspaperPrintHtml:
🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Amid cold wave, students’ indefinite strike against J&K recruitment board scam gathers steam

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 10:08:11 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Protesting government job aspirants on Saturday (November 21, 2026) launched an indefinite strike in Srinagar amid a cold wave over the government’s failure to act against the J&K Service Selection Board (JKSSB), the main recruitment agency of J&K that has become mired in a cheating scam that has led to 16 arrests so far.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: While former Member of Parliament (MP) Aga Syed Ruhullah joined the protesters in Srinagar, other regional parties also demanded the cancellation of all examinations held by the Board and called for “fixing the responsibility”. Speaking at the Sher-i-Kashmir Park, Mr. Ruhullah said the protest is a “rare effort to open up space where youth could fight for their rights”. “We demand that heads must roll. We have the elected government and an unelected government ruling J&K. Both share responsibility for it. Unfortunately, there is a sense of complacency. The examinations should be postponed, responsibility for the irregularities fixed and reforms carried out. The administration should engage students and address their concerns,” said Mr. Ruhullah. Mr. Ruhullah joined scores of students and aspirants who held a sit-in all day in Srinagar. With evening temperature dipping, a spokesman of Mr. Ruhullah said, “There was no food or blankets. No entry. Students on a peaceful sit-in are being frozen out on a bitter Srinagar night. Their only crime is asking for justice over the alleged Finance Accounts Assistant (FAA) recruitment rigging.” The night temperature has dipped to around zero degrees Celsius in Srinagar amid a severe cold wave. On November 15, the J&K Police busted four “cheating modules” in Jammu during the Board’s examination for the FAA posts. Nearly 1.62 lakh aspirants had appeared for around 600 posts across J&K. Besides 16 arrests made in the case, the police said it filed three First Information Reports (FIRs) and recovered eight wireless devices, 22 mobile phones and four vehicles of the accused. However, Board chairman Shrikant Balasaheb Suse said the “examination was not compromised by a paper leak or mass malpractice” and announced that the upcoming exams will be held “as per the schedule”.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Facing a growing public outcry, J&K Education Minister Shamim Firdous said strict action should be taken “if any irregularities or rigging are found”.

✓ Syn: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability  |  ✖ Ant: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility

• 1. Core Context & Background: Protesting government job aspirants on Saturday (November 21, 2026) launched an indefinite strike in Srinagar amid a cold wave over the government’s failure to act against the J&K Service Selection Board (JKSSB), the main recruitment agency of J&K that has become mired in a cheating scam that has led to 16 arrests so far.
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: While former Member of Parliament (MP) Aga Syed Ruhullah joined the protesters in Srinagar, other regional parties also demanded the cancellation of all examinations held by the Board and called for “fixing the responsibility”. Speaking at the Sher-i-Kashmir Park, Mr. Ruhullah said the protest is a “rare effort to open up space where youth could fight for their rights”. “We demand that heads must roll. We have the elected government and an unelected government ruling J&K. Both share responsibility for it. Unfortunately, there is a sense of complacency. The examinations should be postponed, responsibility for the irregularities fixed and reforms carried out. The administration should engage students and address their concerns,” said Mr. Ruhullah. Mr. Ruhullah joined scores of students and aspirants who held a sit-in all day in Srinagar. With evening temperature dipping, a spokesman of Mr. Ruhullah said, “There was no food or blankets. No entry. Students on a peaceful sit-in are being frozen out on a bitter Srinagar night. Their only crime is asking for justice over the alleged Finance Accounts Assistant (FAA) recruitment rigging.” The night temperature has dipped to around zero degrees Celsius in Srinagar amid a severe cold wave. On November 15, the J&K Police busted four “cheating modules” in Jammu during the Board’s examination for the FAA posts. Nearly 1.62 lakh aspirants had appeared for around 600 posts across J&K. Besides 16 arrests made in the case, the police said it filed three First Information Reports (FIRs) and recovered eight wireless devices, 22 mobile phones and four vehicles of the accused. However, Board chairman Shrikant Balasaheb Suse said the “examination was not compromised by a paper leak or mass malpractice” and announced that the upcoming exams will be held “as per the schedule”.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Facing a growing public outcry, J&K Education Minister Shamim Firdous said strict action should be taken “if any irregularities or rigging are found”.

articles.title: NEET paper leak case: Delhi court frames charges against 14 accused
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Special Judge Ajay Gupta framed the charges after noting the accused pleaded ‘not guilty’, with the trial set to begin on a day-to-day basis from November 25

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A Delhi court on Saturday (November 21, 2026) formally framed charges against 14 accused in the NEET paper leak case, setting the stage for trial. Special Judge Ajay Gupta framed the charges after noting that the accused had pleaded ‘not guilty’. The court had earlier said there was a prima facie case against them for various offences, including cheating, criminal breach of trust, corruption and exam-related wrongdoing. The three main accused, Manisha Gurunath Mandhare, P.V. Kulkarni and Manisha Sanjay Havaldar, were public servants as they were engaged by the National Testing Agency (NTA), and had procured confidential questions illegally in conspiracy with the co-accused, the court had said. It had ordered that charges be framed against the trio for criminal conspiracy, criminal breach of trust, cheating, and criminal misconduct by a public servant under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) and the Prevention of Corruption Act. Of the other 11 accused, Tejas Harshadkumar Shah, Shivraj Motegaonkar, Manoj Shirure, Manisha Waghmare, Dhananjay Lokhande, Shubham Khairnar, Yash Yadav, Mangilal Biwal, Dinesh Biwal, Vikas Biwal and Sheshrao Suryawanshi, the court had said these private individuals would face charges under the Prevention of Corruption Act, and of breach of trust, because they were part of the chain of illegal distribution or exploitation of the confidential material connected to the three subject experts. The trial will begin on a day-to-day basis from November 25, 2026. The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) had earlier filed a chargesheet against 13 accused in a fast-track court dealing with criminal cases arising from paper leaks and the use of other unfair means in public examinations. It also filed a supplementary chargesheet against the 14th accused, Sheshrao Suryawanshi alias Raj Suryawanshi, a resident of Nanded in Maharashtra, who was arrested on September 2, 2026.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The NTA conducts the NEET-UG for medical aspirants. On May 12, 2026, it cancelled the exam held on May 3, 2026, amid allegations of paper leaks. A re-examination was conducted on June 21, 2026.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 NEET paper leak case: Delhi court frames charges against 14 accused

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 09:57:02 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Special Judge Ajay Gupta framed the charges after noting the accused pleaded ‘not guilty’, with the trial set to begin on a day-to-day basis from November 25

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A Delhi court on Saturday (November 21, 2026) formally framed charges against 14 accused in the NEET paper leak case, setting the stage for trial. Special Judge Ajay Gupta framed the charges after noting that the accused had pleaded ‘not guilty’. The court had earlier said there was a prima facie case against them for various offences, including cheating, criminal breach of trust, corruption and exam-related wrongdoing. The three main accused, Manisha Gurunath Mandhare, P.V. Kulkarni and Manisha Sanjay Havaldar, were public servants as they were engaged by the National Testing Agency (NTA), and had procured confidential questions illegally in conspiracy with the co-accused, the court had said. It had ordered that charges be framed against the trio for criminal conspiracy, criminal breach of trust, cheating, and criminal misconduct by a public servant under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) and the Prevention of Corruption Act. Of the other 11 accused, Tejas Harshadkumar Shah, Shivraj Motegaonkar, Manoj Shirure, Manisha Waghmare, Dhananjay Lokhande, Shubham Khairnar, Yash Yadav, Mangilal Biwal, Dinesh Biwal, Vikas Biwal and Sheshrao Suryawanshi, the court had said these private individuals would face charges under the Prevention of Corruption Act, and of breach of trust, because they were part of the chain of illegal distribution or exploitation of the confidential material connected to the three subject experts. The trial will begin on a day-to-day basis from November 25, 2026. The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) had earlier filed a chargesheet against 13 accused in a fast-track court dealing with criminal cases arising from paper leaks and the use of other unfair means in public examinations. It also filed a supplementary chargesheet against the 14th accused, Sheshrao Suryawanshi alias Raj Suryawanshi, a resident of Nanded in Maharashtra, who was arrested on September 2, 2026.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The NTA conducts the NEET-UG for medical aspirants. On May 12, 2026, it cancelled the exam held on May 3, 2026, amid allegations of paper leaks. A re-examination was conducted on June 21, 2026.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Investigation (Adjective / Verb)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Investigation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Confidential (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Confidential' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Distribution (Adjective / Verb)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Distribution' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Exploitation (Noun)
शोषण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Exploitation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "NEET paper leak case: Delhi court frames charges against 14 accused", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Special Judge Ajay Gupta framed the charges after noting the accused pleaded ‘not guilty’, with the trial set to begin on a day-to-day basis from...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'NEET paper leak case: Delhi court frames charges' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'NEET paper leak case: Delhi court frames char' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'NEET paper leak case: Delhi court frames char' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Special Judge Ajay Gupta framed the charges after noting the accused pleaded ‘not guilty’, with the trial set to begin on a day-to-day basis from..." (Hinglish Arth: विशेष न्यायाधीश अजय गुप्ता ने आरोपी के खुद को 'दोषी नहीं' मानने पर गौर करने के बाद आरोप तय किए, सुनवाई 25 नवंबर से दिन-प्रतिदिन के आधार पर शुरू होगी।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "NEET paper leak case: Delhi court frames charges against 14 accused"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. A re-examination was conducted on June 21, 2026.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "A re-examination was conducted on June 21, 2026." (Hinglish Arth: 21 जून 2026 को दोबारा परीक्षा आयोजित की गई।)

articles.title: Israeli strike kills three in vehicle distributing aid in Gaza, witnesses say
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Afterwards, meals of cooked rice were scattered around the vehicle, which was partially covered in the blood of the victims of the attack

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: An Israeli strike killed three Palestinians ​in a vehicle carrying papers and food for the World ⁠Central Kitchen charity in Gaza City on Saturday (November 21, 2026), Gaza's Health Ministry and witnesses said. World Central Kitchen, an aid organisation that distributes food in the Gaza Strip, said, however, ‌that the vehicle was not affiliated with it. The Israeli military said several militants had been targeted in the area without providing ‌further details. It did not immediately respond to questions on why ‌it ⁠had hit a vehicle that appeared to be distributing aid. A ⁠Reuters witness said the vehicle appeared to be carrying packaged foodstuffs, and that papers inside carried World Central Kitchen's logo. "It was just about to stop to distribute the food and ​drink to children when it was ‌hit by a missile," said Abu Zein Al-Daya, who witnessed the strike. Afterwards, meals of cooked rice were scattered around the vehicle, which was partially covered in the blood of the victims of the attack. The Israeli military killed seven World Central Kitchen workers ​in a 2024 strike, including citizens of Australia, Britain and Poland. At the time, the military said there had been "serious errors and ⁠breaches of procedure" but in 2026 it said it had found no basis on which to open criminal investigations into the incident. Israel briefly launched a ‌ground operation in Gaza earlier this week and killed six people in a strike on a hospital that it said was targeting a commander for the Palestinian militant group Hamas.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: An October 2025 U.S.-backed ceasefire halted major fighting in the shattered territory but has not stopped Israeli attacks on Gaza or secured Hamas' disarmament.

hinglishTracks.en: Afterwards, meals of cooked rice were scattered around the vehicle, which was partially covered in the blood of the victims of the attack.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — बाद में, पके हुए चावल का भोजन वाहन के चारों ओर बिखरा हुआ था, जो आंशिक रूप से हमले के पीड़ितों के खून से लथपथ था।।

hinglishTracks.en: The Israeli military killed seven World Central Kitchen workers ​in a 2024 strike, including citizens of Australia, Britain and Poland.

hinglishTracks.en: An October 2025 U.S.-backed ceasefire halted major fighting in the shattered territory but has not stopped Israeli attacks on Gaza or secured Hamas' disarmament.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — अक्टूबर 2025 में अमेरिका समर्थित युद्धविराम ने टूटे हुए क्षेत्र में बड़ी लड़ाई रोक दी, लेकिन गाजा पर इजरायली हमलों को नहीं रोका या हमास के निरस्त्रीकरण को सुरक्षित नहीं किया।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Disarmament' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: निरस्त्रीकरण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Disarmament' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।
